TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_SEQ_00: Minfilia would have you assist Alphinaud in his new station as commander of the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_SEQ_01: Conscious of the many practical difficulties facing the newly formed Crystal Braves, Minfilia asks that you place yourself at Alphinaud's disposal. Find the boy commander within the Rising Stones, and offer him your aid.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_SEQ_02: Grateful for your offer of aid, Alphinaud bids you speak with Captain Ilberd, his second-in-command, to be briefed on the sensitive matter in which he requires your assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_SEQ_03: Ilberd reveals that a Garlean spy known as the Ivy has infiltrated one of the Grand Companies. A suspect was identified among the Immortal Flames, but the man proved to be but one of many in the agent's employ. Accompany Ilberd to his meeting with Raubahn at the Hall of Flames, and remain on hand in the event that the Ivy chooses to make a move.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_SEQ_04: You learn that Raubahn and Ilberd have been friends and rivals since before the fall of Ala Mhigo. Under the guise of a long-awaited reunion, the two men discuss the matter of the Garlean spy. At the meeting's conclusion, it is agreed that both parties will continue their inquiries.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_TODO_02: Speak with Raubahn at the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_000: <sigh> Try as I might, I cannot shake a creeping sense of dark foreboding... But it avails us naught to fret about the unknown. We must concentrate instead on the problems of the present.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_001: The primals have been relatively quiet of late, and the beast tribes who summon them are under constant surveillance by the Grand Companies.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_002: Should any suspicious activity be afoot, you may be certain that we will hear of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_003: And until such time as a permanent solution to the primal problem has been found, we can do little but wait and observe.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_004: As for the Ascians, Urianger is wholly dedicated to finding the means by which we may defeat the dark beings. Let us pray for good tidings on that front.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_005: ...But all of this you knew already. Let us speak then of more current matters─in particular, the state of the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_006: Alphinaud did well to found the organization, but ensuring its smooth operation is another matter entirely.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_007: Though I doubt not that he is doing his best, I felt that a helping hand or two would not go astray.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_008: To this end, I offered to send one of the Archons to assist him, but he declined. You know how he can be─independent to a fault, and singularly loath to accept help...
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_009: ...Save, of course, when that help comes from you. Alphinaud has entrusted countless matters of import to your care in the past, and I believe he would not hesitate to do so again...were you to offer.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_010: I should be most grateful if you would go to him, and support him in whatever manner you are able.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_MINFILIA_000_020: Alphinaud refused the Archons' help, but I believe that he would welcome yours. I should be most grateful if you would place yourself at his disposal.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_030: What is it, ? And do be concise. I am rather busy.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_031: ...Hm? You would lend a hand, you say? I see. Well...now that you mention it, there is a matter that wants for attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Given its sensitive nature, I was hesitant to entrust it to my Braves, but the demands upon my time are such that I had little choice.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Which is not to say that my men want for labor. Though we are but newly formed, there is already a great demand for our services, and we are hard-pressed to answer all petitions. But I digress...
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_034: The fact is, I would sooner attend to this particular matter myself, but my presence is required elsewhere.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_035: That being the case, I have entrusted its resolution to my second-in-command, Captain Ilberd.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Tell him that I sent you, and he will furnish you with the particulars. My thanks in advance, .
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I have given Captain Ilberd charge of the matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Tell him that I sent you, and he will furnish you with the particulars. My thanks in advance, .
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ILBERD_000_042: Dispatch the 1st Unit to Ul'dah. The 2nd and 4th are to stand by for further orders.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ROAILLE_000_050: Ever a pleasure, my friend. Nary a day passes by that I do not hear of your valorous exploits.
TEXT_GAIUSE401_00052_ILBERD_000_050: We must begin by apprising General Raubahn of our findings. Pray meet me at the Hall of Flames, and remain on hand to see that things go smoothly.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_00: Ilberd is eager to continue his investigation into the Garlean spy known as the Ivy.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_01: With Raubahn now informed of the Garlean spy in his midst, your business in Ul'dah is concluded. Accompany Ilberd back to the Rising Stones and report to Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_02: Upon returning to the Rising Stones, Alphinaud informs you that a unit of Crystal Braves was ambushed by Garlean forces during your absence. Worse, it seems that one of the unit's members was captured and taken to Castrum Centri. With no time to form a rescue party, Ilberd asks that you lead a mission to free the prisoner. Make your way to the Tangle, by the entrance to the imperial stronghold, and receive further instructions from Alianne.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_03: Alianne fears that her wounded comrade may not survive the rough treatment of her Garlean captors. Accompany her and the 4th Unit as they infiltrate Castrum Centri, and find Crystal Brave Rhesh Polaali.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_04: You find Rhesh Polaali alive, but in no condition to move unaided. Seeing this, Alianne asks you to create a diversion, that her comrade might be borne away unmolested. Make your way around the castrum, striking down any imperial forces you encounter, and thereby ensuring that all eyes are on you.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_05: You have wreaked considerable havoc within Castrum Centri, hopefully affording the 4th Unit a chance to bear away their wounded comrade. Head outside the stronghold and search for Alianne.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_06: You are relieved to find that Alianne and the others made it to safety. Return to the Rising Stones and report the mission's success to Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_SEQ_07: Back at the Rising Stones, Alphinaud and Ilberd take turns congratulating you on the success of the rescue mission. You have little time to glory in your triumph, however, as Alphinaud goes on to reveal that your work for him is not yet done. It is time to set down your weapon and don the hat of diplomacy, for your presence has been requested at a meeting with an Ishgardian dignitary...
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_TODO_00: Speak with Alphinaud at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_TODO_01: Speak with Alianne in the Tangle.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_TODO_02: Find Rhesh Polaali in Castrum Centri.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_TODO_03: Defeat imperial troops who appear at specified locations in Castrum Centri.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_TODO_04: Speak with Alianne in the Tangle.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_TODO_05: Report to Alphinaud at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_000: Our hunt for the Ivy begins in earnest, Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_001: Suffice it to say, we must tread warily. But one misstep may well cost us our lives.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_002: Our business here is concluded for the time being. Let us return to the Rising Stones and report to Commander Leveilleur.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_010: Our business here is concluded for the time being. Let us return to the Rising Stones and report to Commander Leveilleur.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_020: We are returned from Ul'dah, Commander.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_021: And not a moment too soon. Something has happened.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_023: You will recall that the 4th was tasked with reconnoitering the rendezvous site used by the Ivy's minion and his imperial contacts. Soon after you left, we received word that the unit was ambushed en route to its destination.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_025: According to the report, one of ours has been taken captive. The Garleans are not wont to treat their foemen with dignity, and I have grave fears for her safety.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_026: We must dispatch a rescue party at once. Recall those Braves who are afield.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_027: Begging your pardons, Commander, but we have not the time.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_028: I'm afraid I must ask for your aid once more, Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_029: An ill-prepared rescue party will only serve to provide the Garleans with more captives, yet time is of the essence. Simply put, you are the best chance we have.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Captain Ilberd has the right of it. I trust you are willing? But of course you are. Now, Alianne of the 4th lies in wait in the Tangle, near the entrance to Castrum Centri. Seek her out, and she will apprise you of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Alianne of the 4th lies in wait in the Tangle, near the entrance to Castrum Centri. Seek her out, and she will apprise you of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_050: You are the best chance we have of rescuing our comrade. I shall pray for your success.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_CRYSTALSOLDIER00053: Hang in there, Rhesh... We'll free you yet...
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_070: ...You would aid us in the rescue mission? We are in your debt, Warrior of Light! Now, time is against us, so allow me to brief you on the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_071: The Garleans fell upon us without warning, wounding poor Rhesh and hauling her away to the castrum yonder. Outnumbered as we were, it was all we could do to flee and regroup.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_072: Even as we speak, the Garleans may be interrogating Rhesh...or worse. With her hurts, I fear that she will not long survive their attentions. We must rescue her without delay.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_073: Our order may yet be in its infancy, but the bond that binds us is strong as mythril. None of us will stand by while a comrade suffers.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_074: We, the remnants of the 4th, will infiltrate Castrum Centri. Please help us find Rhesh before it is too late!
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_081: Rhesh! Thank the gods we found you!
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_082: And thank you, Warrior of Light!
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_083: Now, to quit this accursed place... Rhesh cannot move with those wounds. She will need to be carried out. I believe a diversion is in order. Might we trouble you to provide one? Given your reputation, I suspect the Garleans will be only too happy to grant you their undivided attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_084: If you were to create a commotion within the castrum, we should be able to steal away unnoticed. Let us speak again once we are safely outside these walls.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_100: Rhesh cannot move with those wounds. She will need to be carried out. And for that to work, we will require some manner of diversion.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_101: If you were to create a commotion within the castrum, we should be able to steal away unnoticed. Let us speak again once we are safely outside these walls.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_110: I have awaited your return most anxiously, my friend. You have done us a great service indeed. Thanks to your aid, our comrade Rhesh is safe, and we suffered no further casualties. Words cannot well express my gratitude.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALIANNE_000_111: All that is left is to report the mission's success to Commander Leveilleur. I shall go on ahead to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Ah, it does me well to see you thus returned. Though I doubt not your prowess, entering an enemy stronghold is generally considered to be a risky venture, and I must confess to having been a trifle anxious.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_121: But here you are, hale and whole, having succeeded in your mission as is your wont.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_122: Lest you wonder, the woman you rescued is being cared for by the Domans. Thanks to their expert ministrations, the danger is past. You have my gratitude, .
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_123: Allow me to thank you also, Scion. Rhesh owes you her life.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_124: We escaped with minimal casualties this time, but we can ill afford to be caught off guard again. The Empire is not an opponent to be trifled with.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_125: As you say, Commander. I will see to it that the men keep their wits about them.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ILBERD_000_126: And it may yet take time, but I will not rest until we have identified and apprehended the Ivy.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_127: I have every confidence that you will succeed, Captain.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_128: As for you, ─I realize you have scarce caught your breath, but I'm afraid there is no rest for the weary. I require that you accompany me to Coerthas.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_129: I have been granted an audience with an Ishgardian dignitary, you see, and the man expressly requested your presence.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ALPHINAUD_000_130: Oh, do not look so surprised. You should be familiar with the trappings of fame by now. We shall depart as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_ACCESS_MESSAGE: There are more pressing matters at hand!
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_BALLOON_000_140: Come for the maiden fair, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSE402_00053_BALLOON_000_160: You'll not leave this place alive!
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_SEQ_00: An influential Ishgardian wishes to meet the Warrior of Light, and Alphinaud would like nothing more than to oblige him.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_SEQ_01: Alphinaud has been granted an audience with Ser Aymeric, lord commander of the Ishgardian Temple Knights, who will be acting as a representative of the Holy See. Keen to ingratiate himself, Alphinaud has asked you to accompany him to the meeting, as Ser Aymeric has expressed a desire to meet the famous Warrior of Light. Minfilia will surely give you her blessing once she learns of the plan.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_SEQ_02: Ever since the Battle of Silvertear Skies, the city-state of Ishgard has kept her neighbors at arm's length. Not even the threat posed by the VIIth Legion was enough to coax the reclusive nation back to the negotiating table. Now, however, after two decades of near silence, they have reached out─but to what end? Regardless of Ser Aymeric's agenda, Alphinaud is resolved to advance his own. Travel with him to Camp Dragonhead and speak with Lord Haurchefant upon your arrival.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_SEQ_03: As always, you receive a warm welcome in Camp Dragonhead, and are informed that Ser Aymeric is already present and ready to meet with you and Alphinaud. Weary though you may be from your travels, make your way to the intercessory and prepare to meet the Ishgardian ambassador.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_SEQ_04: After favoring you with a few kind words, Ser Aymeric and Alphinaud proceed to debate Ishgardian policies at length. Alas, the ambassador is not easily swayed, and it becomes apparent that the Holy See has no intention of rejoining the Eorzean Alliance. However, Ser Aymeric eventually reveals that he came to the meeting with a different purpose in mind... You learn that the astrologians of Ishgard have foretold the return of Midgardsormr─the fallen guardian of Silvertear Falls─and that Ser Aymeric wishes to enlist the Scions' aid in keeping watch over the great wyrm's remains. In exchange, he will ensure that the shipments of aid from House Fortemps to Revenant's Toll will continue unabated. Content with the arrangement, Alphinaud agrees─only to learn moments after that the latest shipment has been waylaid by Iceheart and her followers...
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_TODO_01: Speak with Haurchefant at Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_TODO_02: Speak with the House Fortemps guard.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_031: We have been blessed with a rare opportunity, ─an audience with an ambassador of the Holy See of Ishgard.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_032: We are to treat with Ser Aymeric, lord commander of the Temple Knights, in Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_033: It is considered a great honor to serve the Holy See directly as a Temple Knight. Needless to say, their leader wields tremendous political influence. We would be wise to court his favor.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_034: For that reason, I consider your attendance essential. If Ser Aymeric wishes to meet the  behind the legend, I would not deny him the pleasure of your company.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_035: The Antecedent should see the wisdom of this plan when you request her permission to accompany me to Coerthas.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_036: ...Mayhap you feel this to be a waste of your talents, which could doubtless be put to nobler use? If so, I should remind you that more good can be accomplished with the stroke of a pen than the thrust of a sword.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_040: If my many “adventures” in diplomacy have taught me anything, it is the importance of humoring those who have something one wants.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Not every victory is won on a battlefield, my friend. 'Tis the lot of legendary heroes to be paraded about from time to time.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_000_050: ...A meeting with an Ishgardian ambassador? By all means, I think it a wonderful idea.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_000_051: We have received no reports of aetheric disturbances or unusual beast tribe activity of late.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_000_052: If Alphinaud believes your presence may help him to secure more favorable terms, I see no reason to deny him.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Antecedent. I take it  has explained the situation?
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_000_002: has. Yet welcome though these overtures are, I cannot help but wonder what prompted them. The Ishgardians have spurned all contact with the other city-states for decades. Why reach out now?
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Would that I knew... The question of their motives is one to which I have given no small amount of thought. Alas, I know no more than is generally known.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_004: The notoriously reclusive nation of Ishgard, situated at the center of Abalathia's Spine...
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_005: ...Ruled by the Ishgardian Orthodox Church, at the head of which presides the archbishop.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_006: ...Members of the original Eorzean Alliance, formed in the wake of Ala Mhigo's fall some two decades ago.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_007: ...Friends of convenience who withdrew from the Alliance as soon as the imperial fleet was routed at the Battle of Silvertear Skies.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_000_008: ...Since which time, their borders have remained closed to all outsiders.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_009: They have rejected every one of their former allies' calls to reopen dialogue, turning a deaf ear to their neighbors' pleas even when the Calamity loomed large.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_010: And on the fields of Carteneau, where brave men and women laid down their lives in defense of the realm, their banners were conspicuously absent...
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_011: I have tried to convince Ishgard to rejoin the Alliance at every opportunity.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_012: I have explained over and over again that unless Eorzea stands united, we cannot hope to preserve our freedom. One by one, our nations will fall, as once fell Ala Mhigo...
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_013: ...And what have mine efforts yielded? Why, naught.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_000_014: Surely this can be considered a step in the right direction?
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_015: I should hope so. Rather than the lowly messengers we have been fobbed off with in the past, this time we shall meet with a man of genuine influence.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Of course, I am not so naive as to think that they come to us out of the goodness of their hearts. We have something they desire, though I have yet to find out what.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_017: But such is the nature of diplomacy. They will bring their agendas to the negotiating table, and so will I─along with a handful of incontrovertible truths.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_000_018: The Empire will soon be at our doorstep once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Indeed. You may be assured that I will expound upon this point and others.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Let us depart for Camp Dragonhead, . Our old friend Lord Haurchefant is expecting us.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Since our quest to recover the Enterprise, I understand you have further ingratiated yourself with the man. Excellent work. His fondness may prove useful to our cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_MINFILIA_100_050: Though I know but little of Ser Aymeric, I have faith that Alphinaud's efforts are about to bear fruit.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_061: Our hearths have been stoked to blazing in preparation for your arrival. It would not do for such a distinguished personage to catch cold whilst enjoying our hospitality.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_062: The gesture is much appreciated. I fear I shall ever struggle in cold climes.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_063: ...Ah, good Master Alphinaud. An honor, as always.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_064: Likewise, Lord Haurchefant. Forgive us yet another imposition─I fear we have relied overmuch on your aid since you so generously assisted us in locating the Enterprise.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_065: Nonsense! Any debts incurred have long since been repaid. Besides, who can say what the future may bring?
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_066: House Fortemps may even seek the aid of your newly formed Crystal Braves.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_100_067: In any case, I am simply delighted that the Holy See is at last willing to grant you an audience.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_068: No doubt your discoveries at Snowcloak helped to justify the decision. This recent resurgence in heretical activity is of grave concern to us all.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_069: But to the matter at hand: Ser Aymeric arrived in Camp Dragonhead earlier, and I am told he is eager to meet with you at your first convenience.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_070: You are doubtless weary from your journey and desirous to rest awhile by the warmth of our hearth...
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_071: ...But if you are willing to forgo such comforts, pray inform the knight stationed outside the intercessory. He will grant you entrance and send word to the other attendees.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_072: As inviting as your hearth sounds, I think it best we proceed to the intercessory forthwith.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_HAURCHEFANT_000_080: You will find the entrance to the intercessory outside. It's just around the corner to the right. Speak with the guard stationed there when you are ready to begin the meeting.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_ALPHINAUD_000_090: I see no reason to keep Ser Aymeric waiting, do you? Let us proceed to the intercessory.
TEXT_GAIUSE403_00054_FORTEMPSGUARD00054_: We have been expecting you, . Pray take your ease inside and I shall summon the others.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_SEQ_00: Recent developments have given Alphinaud much to consider.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_SEQ_01: Given the decidedly unfortunate timing of Iceheart's most recent attack, Alphinaud cannot help but wonder if the gods themselves are conspiring against him. Yet even if they were, he would not hesitate to defy them. Follow him and speak with Lord Haurchefant to learn more of the heretics' activities.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_SEQ_02: The route taken by the caravan was known only to a few, yet by all accounts, the ambush laid by the heretics was executed flawlessly─a fact which does not escape Aymeric's subordinate. In spite of this, Alphinaud believes that a thorough examination of the ambush site must be conducted before pursuing other avenues of inquiry. Travel to Boulder Downs and question the House Fortemps knights keeping watch there.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_SEQ_03: One of the knights investigating the scene shares his thoughts with you regarding the attack, speculating that the heretics came prepared with their own wagons to transport the crates. He also makes mention of a squire who survived the attack, who is currently receiving care at the Observatorium. With luck, he will have regained consciousness by the time you arrive.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_SEQ_04: The wounded squire's words paint a grim picture indeed. Disguised as pilgrims, Iceheart and her brethren slaughtered the caravan's guards, and the young man only survived by feigning his own death. As he lay still in the snow, he heard the heretics speak of “Shiva's resurrection”─the thought of which fills the squire with disbelief and dread in equal measure. Alphinaud must know what the squire saw.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_SEQ_05: Apostate to the Holy See, patron saint to the heretics, Shiva lay down with dragons long ago. But she is long dead, and the dead are forever lost to us...are they not? The heretics seem convinced that her resurrection is nigh, but Alphinaud believes it to be something far worse: the summoning of yet another primal, made possible with the crystals stolen from the caravan. If he is right, Iceheart's plan cannot be allowed to come to fruition.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_TODO_01: Speak with the House Fortemps knight at Boulder Downs.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_TODO_02: Speak with the surviving squire at the Observatorium.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_000: <sigh> Just when we were starting to make progress...
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_001: And to make matters worse, the caravan they spoke of was bound for Revenant's Toll of all places. Honestly, were I so inclined, I should think the gods were conspiring against us.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Happily, however, I am not. I would know more of this attack. Let us speak with Lord Haurchefant and find out what he has learned.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_100_000: We must needs find the heretics and─ <sigh> No, it will avail us naught to rush. Let us hear what Lord Haurchefant has to say first.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_LUCIA_100_001: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)I am come to hear Lord Haurchefant speak, not you.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_010: My sincerest apologies for the interruption, my friends, but the situation is such that we must act swiftly.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_011: If you would be so kind as to elaborate...
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_012: Iceheart's heretics fell upon the caravan bound for Revenant's Toll as it was passing through Boulder Downs.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_013: 'Twas an ambush─swift and ruthless. In an instant, every knight was slain, every crate seized. Then, as quickly as they had appeared, they were gone.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_LUCIA_000_014: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)'Twould be an impossible feat without knowledge of the route─knowledge to which only a select few are privy, I presume.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_015: ...Quite. We can pursue that avenue of inquiry in due course. It seems to me that examining the scene of the ambush should be our first concern.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_016: The trail is yet warm. We must act swiftly─as Lord Haurchefant said─lest crucial evidence be lost.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_017: You have a knack for discerning hidden truths, . Why don't you go and inspect the ambush site in person?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_018: An excellent idea! Inform my men of your intent upon arrival, and they will gladly share their findings.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I shall remain in Camp Dragonhead for now. Should you learn aught of interest, pray return at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_030: My men are conducting their own investigation at present. Follow the road south towards Mor Dhona and you shall find them and the wagon in due time.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_YAELLE_100_030: How brazen these heretics have become, to raid caravans escorted by knights of House Fortemps!
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_FORTEMPSGUARD00057_: Move along, adventurer. There's nothing for─ Eh? Lord Haurchefant bid you speak with us? Then you must be─ Beg your pardon, Scion.
As you can see, they left nary a crate behind. Tipped the wagon for good measure even.
Whole thing's a bit odd, if you ask me. Would've been easier to just steal it─though a damn sight harder to conceal it, I'll allow.
Reckon they came prepared, probably with wagons of their own hidden a way off... Ah, but pay no heed to my ramblings. Absent of proof, 'tis naught but speculation.

Might be as the squire receiving care at the Observatorium could tell you something more factual. That is, if he's awake. Unlike myself, he was there during the attack─not that his presence amounted to much.
Sorry, Scion, but if it's answers you want, I've got none for you. Best go and see what that squire laid up at the Observatorium remembers, if he's fit to speak.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_YAELLE_100_050: Dead? All of them? Even...even the squires?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_LUCIA_100_051: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)It takes but one pair of loose lips...
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_INJUREDSENTRY00057_: You...you've come to ask about the attack, haven't you?

...We came upon them before the entrance to the Hall of the Seven Echoes. Pilgrims, we marked them as─lost and ill equipped for a journey further north. Our leader called out to them, and one stepped forward to answer.
Slowly she approached, her silver hair flowing in the wind like melting snow. Just a young girl, I thought, some poor lost lamb in search of salvation.

Our leader must have thought the same─else why would he let her draw so close? They exchanged some words I couldn't hear, and she leaned forward as if to kiss his cheek...and then he sighed and crumpled to the ground. I didn't know what had happened till I saw the snow turn red.

And then there was red everywhere I looked. I tried to fight, but took a blow to the head, and by the time I came to, the others were dead and the heretics were unloading the wagon. I couldn't... I-I mean, they'd have killed me, so... So I just lay still and listened.
Iceheart's people spoke of deliverance and resurrection. And...they spoke of Shiva...
To hear them speak, they truly believe they can resurrect Shiva. But that can't be possible, can it...? It can't...
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Ah, you've returned. What news have you for us?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_071: It seems the Lady Iceheart does not scruple to sully her hands with blood.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_072: Who is this “Shiva” the heretics spoke of?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_LUCIA_000_073: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)...Have you not read a single line of the Enchiridion, Master Alphinaud?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_LUCIA_000_074: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)Shiva was a traitor to kith and kin─an apostate who lay down with dragons.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_075: Now, now, we cannot expect all foreigners to know Ishgardian scripture so well─particularly when it concerns the patron saints of heretics.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_076: Wait─you say she is their patron saint? Oh, no... It all makes sense now...
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_077: Lord Haurchefant─what was the caravan's cargo?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_078: Ah...if I recall correctly, the Diamond Forge had requested a rather large quantity of crystals─
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_079: Do you not see? Iceheart and her followers intend to summon Shiva, as a beast tribe would a primal! Why else would they go to such lengths to secure crystals?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_LUCIA_000_080: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)...I shall inform the lord commander at once. Lord Haurchefant, you would agree that discretion is of paramount concern?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_100_081: I trust we can count on your continued support, Master Alphinaud?
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_082: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn are sworn to combat the primal threat. Our support is a given.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_083: I will need to send word to my brethren in Revenant's Toll. Our entire order must turn its efforts to the prevention of this summoning.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_ALPHINAUD_000_084: Naturally, that includes you─though I am sure you would not miss this for the world.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_YAELLE_000_090: Halone be praised, he yet lives! I pray his recovery is swift.
TEXT_GAIUSE404_00057_HAURCHEFANT_000_100: Welcome back, old friend! I─ (Oh dear, Alphinaud's looking this way. I do not think he likes being ignored.)
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_SEQ_00: Woe betide the heretic who crosses Alphinaud Leveilleur, for they shall feel the full force of his fury.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_SEQ_01: Having discerned Iceheart's true motive for attacking the supply caravan, Alphinaud quickly devises a plan of action. You and he will journey to Whitebrim Front and speak with Lord Drillemont, whose knights have been scouring Coerthas for the heretics ever since your encounter with them near Snowcloak. With luck, he will have information which may lead you to their lair.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_SEQ_02: According to Lord Drillemont, a party of pilgrims resembling those who attacked the caravan was seen transporting a large number of crates towards Snowcloak, where they vanished without a trace. Convinced beyond a shadow of a doubt that Iceheart's followers have gone to ground somewhere in the vicinity, Ser Aymeric declares that his Temple Knights will join in the hunt for Iceheart. Not to be outdone, Alphinaud responds that he has already summoned a unit of Crystal Braves to Whitebrim Front for the same purpose. With so formidable a force devoted to the task, the heretics cannot hope to remain hidden for long. Alphinaud, however, would leave nothing to chance, and bids you explore other ways in which Iceheart might be found.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_TODO_00: Speak with Drillemont at Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_100_001: The persistent attacks on our caravans seemed little more than a nuisance at first. The heretics were a problem, to be sure, but a relatively minor one.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_100_002: That was before I discerned the purpose behind their attacks, of course... Now they have my undivided attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_003: After apprising Minfilia of the situation, I shall summon a unit of Crystal Braves to assist us. As for you, ─pray join me in Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_004: Since the incident at Snowcloak, the knights of House Durendaire have redoubled their reconnaissance efforts in the region. It is my hope that they have information which may help us to determine precisely where the heretics are hiding.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Given our mutual enemy, Lord Drillemont should be eager to oblige us. I shall see you there, then? Good.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Just so you know, my men have already started to arrive. Captain Ilberd always keeps a few Braves at the ready in case of emergencies.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_AYMERIC_000_020: Commander Leveilleur's assessment is most troubling... If he is correct, Iceheart now poses a threat to Ishgard at large.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_LUCIA_100_020: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)By what means do these heretics travel so quickly? We must know, or our every attempt to apprehend them will be doomed to fail.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_DRILLEMONT_000_030: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn wish to join in the hunt for Iceheart? Your assistance is more than welcome, my friends.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_DRILLEMONT_000_031: Considering the report I just received, I daresay your timing could be no better.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_AYMERIC_000_032: We are all ears, Lord Drillemont.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_DRILLEMONT_000_033: A band of pilgrims was seen transporting a large number of crates to the west. Their garb appears to match the description provided by the squire who survived the attack.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_DRILLEMONT_000_034: Alas, our scouts lost track of them at Snowcloak─that selfsame frozen wall which we speculated might conceal the heretics' hideaway.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_DRILLEMONT_000_035: Suffice it to say, the disappearance of these “pilgrims” and their provisions all but confirms our suspicions.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_AYMERIC_000_036: I have heard enough. My knights will join the hunt.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_037: I took the liberty of summoning a unit of Crystal Braves to Whitebrim Front. Given the gravity of the situation, I trust you will agree that we must use every resource available to us.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_AYMERIC_000_038: ...These are extraordinary circumstances, Commander. 'Twould be in our best interests to coordinate our efforts.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_039: Such was my intent from the start, Ser Aymeric.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_040: And so it begins, my friend─though I daresay it will prove an all-too-brief collaboration. Iceheart will not elude the combined forces of the Crystal Braves and the Temple Knights for long.
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Nevertheless, a wise man does not wager all upon the success of a single solution. There may yet be subtler means by which we can locate the heretics' lair. Mayhap Lord Drillemont has one in mind?
TEXT_GAIUSE405_00062_HERETIC02400_000_00: My lady, everything has been accounted for. If there is aught else you would have us do, pray speak, and it shall be done.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SEQ_00: Only the naive place all of their hope in the success of a single solution, and Lord Drillemont is anything but...
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SEQ_01: In an effort to weed out any enemy sympathizers within the ranks, Lord Drillemont ordered a covert evaluation of all stationed in Whitebrim Front. One man in his service was thus identified as a possible heretic, though these suspicions have yet to be confirmed. If the suspect is indeed in league with the heretics, Lord Drillemont believes he will attempt to warn his allies of the impending search operation. Observe the man as he reports to Ser Jeantremont in the yard and discreetly track his movements.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SEQ_02: His duty complete, the suspect makes for the southwest gate. Follow him and continue to observe at a safe distance.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SEQ_03: The suspect proceeds along the road to the east. Continue your surveillance.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SEQ_04: Straying from the road, the suspect pauses to survey his surroundings before proceeding south towards Daniffen Pass. Follow in his footsteps.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SEQ_05: From a distance, you observe the suspect meeting with a robed man. Though you cannot make out the entirety of their conversation, it is clear that the stranger is one of the heretics, and that the movements of the Temple Knights and the Crystal Braves are already known to them. Worse, it seems that the heretics have formulated a plan to prevent the allied forces from completing their search─though quite what role the tunnels in Boulder Downs will play you cannot say. Perhaps Lord Drillemont will be able to make sense of things.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SEQ_06: Lord Drillemont's face darkens as he listens to your report. Convinced that the heretics in Boulder Downs pose a genuine threat to the allied forces in Snowcloak, he declares that they must be stopped...
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_000: It seems as though we are always one step behind, our quarry ever just beyond our reach. Though I would like to believe that the tables are about to turn, I must confess to having certain doubts. A joint effort may succeed where others have failed...but it could yet yield the selfsame result.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_001: Fortunately, we are not without other options. I trust you haven't forgotten Inquisitor Guillaime?
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_002: We have not. The mystery of how the heretic remained undiscovered for so long has been much in our thoughts, as has the question of what steps might be taken to prevent a similar breach of security in future.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_003: Accordingly, we conducted an exhaustive─and covert─evaluation of everyone in Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_004: Though some were found to have committed certain minor transgressions, we identified only one possible heretic.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_005: If this man has pledged himself to Iceheart's cause, he will have taken note of the movements of the Temple Knights and the Crystal Braves. And upon recognizing their intent, he may attempt to warn the heretics.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_006: The man's watch is to end soon, at which point he must report to Ser Jeantremont in the yard. I would have you keep an eye on him. If he ventures beyond the walls, follow him discreetly.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_007: Should he meet with a heretic, do not interfere─simply watch and listen. I have seen to it that the suspect knows nothing which could endanger our plans.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_010: If the suspect shows himself to be a heretic, we will deal with him accordingly. For now, we shall merely observe, and mayhap profit from his treachery.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_ALPHINAUD_100_010: The 3rd and the Temple Knights have begun their search. All that remains is to wait.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_AYMERIC_200_010: Sending his forces to Whitebrim Front prior to his own arrival...? Your commander is certainly decisive.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_LUCIA_300_010: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)See how the skies darken... Even the weather is against us.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SYSTEM_000_020: The suspected heretic leaves through the southwest gate...
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_JEANTREMONT_100_030: We must rest when circumstances allow if we are to give of our best when the time comes to fight.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_SYSTEM_000_040: The suspected heretic follows the road east...
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_HERETICLANCER00069_: Best take care when traveling these roads. Wild beasts and worse are wont to lurk by the wayside.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_JEANTREMONT_100_050: There are whispers that the heretics are plotting something terrible. Is that what has brought the Temple Knights and the Crystal Braves to us?
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_HERETICLANCER00069_: Are you looking for a warm hearth, friend? Whitebrim Front isn't far from here. If I were you, I would...I would... I'm sorry─have we met before? You seem familiar somehow. No? Hm. My mistake.
Hey! HEY! Where in the seven hells are you!? I'm freezing my bollocks off here!
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_HERETIC00069_000_08: I'm here, you blundering oaf. Why are you late?
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_HERETICLANCER00069_: Standing on the wall, why else? I have duties to fulfill, you know!
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_HERETIC00069_000_08: Your sole duty is to the─ Hm? Bloody echo. Lower your voice, or they'll hear us in Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_HERETICLANCER00069_: Y-Yes, of course. The Temple Knights are... <mumble> <mumble> ...in Snowcloak.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_HERETIC00069_000_08: This is what you bring to me? We already knew about... <mumble> <mumble> Our comrades in Boulder Downs will use the tunnels... <mumble> <mumble> ...dead before they know what's happening. Nevertheless... <mumble> <mumble> ...if you waste my time again. Is that clear?
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_090: Well? Did your investigation bear fruit?
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_091: I see. I shall have the man detained at once. His guilt is plain.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_092: <sigh> Would that you could have heard their words more clearly...
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_093: Yet...the few snatches you were able to make out are nonetheless enlightening. It would seem the heretics are aware of our operation─and confident that they can thwart it.
TEXT_GAIUSE406_00069_DRILLEMONT_000_094: Their comrades in Boulder Downs are key to their plans─which means it is key to our plans that they be rooted out and put to the sword.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_SEQ_00: The allied forces at Snowcloak are in danger, and Lord Drillemont would have you assist him in ensuring their safety.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_SEQ_01: According to Lord Drillemont, it had long been suspected that the heretics used secret tunnels to travel throughout the highlands of Coerthas undetected. In light of the information you overheard, he is convinced that the heretics encamped in Boulder Downs now plan to make use of such tunnels to ambush the allied forces in Snowcloak. He has ordered a contingent of House Durendaire knights to begin searching for the ambushers, but he believes that your presence would do much to bolster their efforts. Travel to Boulder Downs and rendezvous with the House Durendaire knights.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_SEQ_02: You arrive in Boulder Downs to discover the knights of House Durendaire slain after what must have been a desperate battle with Iceheart's followers. Before you can take stock of the situation, you find yourself surrounded by the surviving heretics, who are plainly hungry for retribution... Though they fight with the passion of true believers, they are no match for you, and soon they too lie motionless in the snow. What now? For want of a better idea, search the heretics' bodies for anything which might offer some insight into their plans.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_SEQ_03: You rifle through a heretic's knapsack and find a curious parchment with dates and times writ upon it. Could it be of significance? Lord Drillemont will know.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_SEQ_04: Lord Drillemont recognizes the parchment as a timetable of guardsmen's shift changes from the outpost in Snowcloak. With it, the heretics could pass into and out of their tunnels without fear of discovery, and thereby prepare an ambush for the allied forces searching the area. Despite your best efforts, it would seem the Temple Knights and Crystal Braves are still in danger, and Lord Drillemont has no choice but to send reinforcements.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_TODO_00: Rendezvous with the House Durendaire knights.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_TODO_02: Deliver the heretic's parchment to Drillemont.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_000: We have long suspected that the heretics use a network of secret tunnels to traverse the highlands undetected... Given what you overheard, I fear that Snowcloak may be riddled with such passageways, and that the heretics in Boulder Downs are planning to use them to take our forces unawares. Needless to say, we cannot allow that to happen.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_001: A contingent of House Durendaire knights are on patrol in the area, and I shall order them to begin searching for the heretics at once. But knowing nothing of our enemy's numbers or readiness, I cannot say for sure that they will be sufficient...
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_002: It would put my mind at ease if you would consent to assist my knights with the search. I know they would take courage from the presence of so storied a warrior.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_003: Pray rendezvous with them at Boulder Downs. If Halone is kind, we may catch these heretics before their plans come to fruition.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_004: Show them no mercy, . The lives of our allies are at stake.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_010: I implore you, ─make haste to Boulder Downs. Rendezvous with my knights and lay low every last heretic you find.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_011: Every moment spent dawdling is a gift to our enemies─another chance for them to slink into their accursed tunnels and appear at our allies' backs.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_020: My knights sent no word of your coming, . What has happened? What is that in your hand?
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_030: By the Fury... Those were veterans with years of service!
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_031: And now they lie dead in the snow. <sigh> Their bodies must be recovered, and─
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_032: No. No, we have not the men to spare. Not now. Not while Iceheart prepares to summon an abomination.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_033: The heretics you dispatched were not of sufficient number to contend with the combined strength of the Temple Knights and the Crystal Braves. There must be others. And I'll wager they are on their way to Snowcloak as we speak.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_034: To make matters worse, it seems the traitor you followed managed to pass the heretics something of value after all...
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_035: The parchment you recovered is a timetable of the guardsmen's watches at our outpost in Snowcloak. The traitor was stationed there long before he aroused our suspicions. Would that we had caught him sooner!
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_036: With this information, the heretics would know when the watch was weakest. They could use their tunnels with impunity and prepare their ambush...
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_037: The timetable has not changed, you see. Of course, it will be changed now, but the heretics may already be in position.
TEXT_GAIUSE407_00074_DRILLEMONT_000_038: House Durendaire must send reinforcements─even if it means withdrawing knights from the Stone Vigil. I can see no other way to safeguard the lives of our allies.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_00: Lord Drillemont recognizes that the situation in Snowcloak is coming to a head and that decisive action must be taken.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_01: Lord Drillemont fears that the heretics may fall upon the allied forces at Snowcloak before reinforcements can reach them. Lest they be taken unawares, he bids you make haste to the frozen wall and warn Ser Aymeric of the danger.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_02: Your warning comes as little surprise to Ser Aymeric, who reveals that he had been anticipating an attack. Keen to reassure you, he pledges to place his knights on high alert. Perhaps Alphinaud will wish to do the same.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_03: Even as Alphinaud laments the search operation's lack of progress, two heretics reveal themselves and charge towards the startled young man. Before you can rise to his defense, Yda appears as if from nowhere and subdues the heretics with a flurry of blows. The battle for Snowcloak has begun, and for a moment, Alphinaud is concerned─until the fortuitous discovery of a promising tunnel serves to brighten his spirits. Alas, the tunnel is rather narrow, and will not accommodate more than a handful of troops at a time. Given that additional numbers may prove more a hindrance than a help, it is decided that the task of charting the tunnel should be entrusted to a small and highly mobile party of seasoned adventurers. Speak with the stalwart Temple Knight to learn the location of the tunnel's entrance.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_04:
Were it not for the knight's directions, you would never have found the tunnel's entrance, which even now appears to be nothing more than a continuous piece of ice. What dangers lie within Iceheart's secret fortress? You know only that the heretics are expecting you─and that it would be a pity to disappoint them.

※Challenge Snowcloak with other players via the Duty Finder, or with a party of NPCs via Duty Support. Both systems are accessible from the main menu as well as the dungeon's entrance point.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_05:
“What we do, we do for the greater good.”
...The words of a true believer, spoken in all solemnity by the woman once known as Ysayle. It is plain that she will not be swayed from her path. Though weary from your previous encounter, you prepare yourself for battle, only to see your foe make instead for the nearby aetheryte and teleport away. Iceheart has eluded you.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_06: Though you failed to apprehend Iceheart, you have driven the heretics from their lair. Hopefully Alphinaud will take comfort in this partial victory.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_SEQ_07: Alphinaud receives your report with surprising optimism, turning his thoughts to how recent events might contribute to the Crystal Braves' good repute. Of course, everything is contingent upon the successful prevention of Shiva's summoning. But with the aid of the Scions─and you in particular─the young commander is confident that all will turn out as it should.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_TODO_02: Speak with the stalwart Temple Knight.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_DRILLEMONT_000_030: Time is of the essence, . While my knights make ready to depart, the heretics may take our allies in Snowcloak unawares.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_DRILLEMONT_000_031: Superior training and equipment will avail them naught if they are cut down ere their swords are drawn. But all is not yet lost. If you leave now, there may still be time to warn them.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_DRILLEMONT_000_032: Make haste, I beseech you! Fly to Snowcloak and tell Ser Aymeric everything we have discovered.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_DRILLEMONT_000_040: Ser Aymeric must know of the heretics' plans. Hurry, , before it is too late!
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_000_050: . This is a welcome surprise─perhaps the only one thus far. As you can see, we have yet to uncover any hidden─
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_000_051: ...You have my gratitude. Truth be told, we suspected the heretics might be plotting such an attack. Now that we have confirmation, I shall place my knights on high alert.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_000_052: Has Commander Leveilleur been informed? The Braves must be made aware.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_000_060: Hmm... If Halone is kind, we may chance to espy our foes in the act of emerging from their tunnels... It would be most useful to know where they lead.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_100_060: Ser Aymeric? He's over there. Have words with the man if you must─we shall speak anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_LUCIA_110_060: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)We are at a disadvantage here... We should linger no longer than necessary.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_YUYUHASE_120_060: Gods bless whoever designed this uniform. I would have frozen to death by now if it weren't for this greatcoat!
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_TEMPLER00075_130_06: How could any man hope to tunnel through ice this thick? It would be the work of years...
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_001: It must be here! I am certain of it! Why else would they go to such lengths to defend Snowcloak?
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_002: 'Tis but a pity this discovery comes when our enemy has us at such a disadvantage. Forewarned though we be─the heretics know the terrain far better than we. I dare not think how many are watching us at this very moment...
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Confound it! This is all wrong. Iceheart has us scrambling to save our own skins when we should rightly be straining every sinew to find her, and stop this damnable summoning!
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_YDA_000_010: That was close! They didn't hurt you, did they?
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_012: There will be others nearby. We must see that they are given a similarly warm welcome.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_CRYSTALBRAVE02400_0: There's been a development, sir! Together with the Temple Knights, we have secured the entrances to some half-dozen tunnels, after spotting the enemy breaking the surface. But that is not all, sir─we think that one of them may be important. Certainly, the heretics near flung themselves upon our swords to defend it.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_015: A-ha! Just as I suspected! Amongst this warren of tunnels lies the entrance to Iceheart's lair! Summon the others─we're going in!
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_PAPALYMO_000_016: A moment, Alphinaud! The tunnel in question is barely wide enough for two men abreast. We cannot say with any certainty where it leads, much less what is waiting for us there.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_PAPALYMO_000_017: Furthermore, we have no way of knowing how many heretics are still lurking here on the surface! What if they were to converge on this point after we entered the tunnel? For all we know, we could be funneling our forces into a trap!
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_018: ...I take your point. If the tunnel is indeed as narrow as you say, greater numbers would be more a hindrance than a help. Should we encounter difficulty, our own allies would become an obstacle to escape.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Ahem! A change of plans. While we rendezvous with Ser Aymeric and keep the heretics at bay here, you will go wherever that tunnel leads.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_020: If you find Iceheart at the end of it─do not let her escape.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_021: You venture into the unknown, so see that you are prepared for anything. I suggest you call upon your allies─though not too many or Papalymo will sulk.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_200_060: We will hold the line, . You may concentrate on the task at hand.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_300_060: I am informed that Commander Leveilleur has asked you to lead a party down one of the tunnels. A characteristically daring proposition... Yet I can think of no one better qualified for the task. I bid you good fortune.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_TEMPLER00075_000_07: The entrance to the tunnel, ? It's just over here.
Had we not seen the heretics breaking the surface, we would never have noticed it...
Per Ser Aymeric's orders, we will stand guard outside. Please be aware that even should you encounter significant resistance, we cannot leave our post.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_000_080: We have established a defensive perimeter. You need not worry about attack from the rear.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_000_081: May the Fury guide and protect you, .
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_TEMPLER00075_000_10: Even knowing what to look for, it's easy to miss. And the covering of ice doesn't take long to reform either.
How many more tunnels like this might there be in Snowcloak? Come to think of it, how many might there be throughout Coerthas?
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_110: That took longer than I expected. What news, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_111: So Iceheart is but a pseudonym─not that it matters.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_113: That she managed to escape is regrettable, but from your description of that beast, you did well to come as close as you did.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_114: In any case, now that you have cleared a path, the Temple Knights can begin to survey the tunnels in earnest.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_115: Mayhap they will even find a route past the ice wall. Wouldn't that do wonders for their fight against the heretics.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_116: The Crystal Braves would certainly share the credit for it too. Twelve be praised, ─we may yet turn this situation to our advantage.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_117: ...Assuming we stop Iceheart before she summons Shiva, of course.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_118: Needless to say, our fellow Scions have not been idle. Minfilia and Urianger have been busy perusing the archives of House Fortemps, gathering what information they can on Shiva.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_ALPHINAUD_000_119: Which reminds me, if you were intending to trudge back to Camp Dragonhead to report on the day's events─don't. The Antecedent should be here any minute. I can only assume some people enjoy subjecting themselves to this cold. <shiver>
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_AYMERIC_000_120: Though I did not doubt that you would return, I am nonetheless relieved to see my judgment validated.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_LUCIA_000_130: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)'Tis a blessing you are still with us. Commander Leveilleur took to pacing in your absence.
TEXT_GAIUSE408_00075_YUYUHASE_000_140: Is it finished? Does that mean we can leave this godsforsaken place? I can't feel my─ Uh, forgive me. I should not keep you from Commander Leveilleur.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_00: Though not given to small talk, Alphinaud can think of no better way to pass the time until Minfilia arrives.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_01: How much knowledge has been lost over the centuries─over the millennia? And how differently would we view the world had we a better understanding of its past? Little is known of Shiva's life and deeds, yet the heretics venerate her as a saint. Ser Aymeric's ancestors are said to have founded Ishgard by the will of Halone, yet he admits that scripture only tells so much. Ultimately, however, the details of his people's war with the dragons are irrelevant. Regardless of how the conflict began, it is destined to continue─unless Iceheart's plan succeeds, which the Scions cannot allow. While Minfilia and the others search for a means to breach Iceheart's sanctuary, you are to assist Yuyuhase and the 3rd Unit Braves in tracking down the heretics who attempted to ambush the allied forces.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_02: The heretics were last seen heading towards Daniffen Pass, and the 3rd Unit Braves are already in pursuit. Yuyuhase leaves to join them and bids you follow. Do as bade and speak with any 3rd Unit Braves you find.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_03: Many of the 3rd Unit Braves are unaccustomed to the frigid conditions in Coerthas, and the young man you find kneeling in the snow is no exception. Having twisted his ankle, he is no longer able to keep up. Press on without him and join the others south of Daniffen Pass.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_04: You come across several sets of tracks which appear to belong to the Braves and their quarry. Follow them southwest and keep your eyes peeled for both friend and foe.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_05: You find a solitary Brave. Though not seriously injured, he is clearly disoriented and in no condition to fight. According to him, the heretics split up, prompting the Braves to do so as well─and Yuyuhase followed one trail alone. Search for the officer in the woods to the east.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_06: You rescue Yuyuhase from certain death, slaying Iceheart's followers before they can deliver the telling blow. Speak with the Crystal Brave and confirm his condition.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_07: Yuyuhase reveals that he was able to slay one heretic, and was in the process of searching his victim's body when the dead man's comrades surprised and overpowered him. With a grin, he then produces a piece of parchment and proceeds to read you the message written thereon. It would seem to be an escape plan devised in the aftermath of the heretics' failed ambush at Snowcloak. The plan mentions a rendezvous point near the Observatorium, as well as a merchant sympathetic to the heretics' cause. Search the outskirts of the Observatorium and seize the fugitives before they escape.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_08: Outside the walls of the Observatorium, you chance upon the merchant and a single heretic, who subsequently attempt to flee. However, they are stopped in their tracks by the unexpected arrival of Captain Ilberd, Alphinaud, and Yugiri. After Ilberd takes them into custody, Alphinaud explains that they had been seeking the merchant in connection with their investigation into the Ivy. Wait with Alphinaud inside the gates while Captain Ilberd interrogates the merchant.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_SEQ_09: The interrogation of the merchant is not expected to take long, but Alphinaud is doubtful that it will yield any useful information. The Ivy would surely not be so careless. Be that as it may, all you can do now is wait and hope that your fellow Scion is wrong.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_TODO_01: Pursue the heretics towards Daniffen Pass.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_TODO_02: Search for the heretics south of Daniffen Pass.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_TODO_06: Search for the heretics outside the Observatorium.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Antecedent. You come to us straight from the archives of House Fortemps. I trust your time there proved fruitful.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_002: Would that it had. Urianger and I scoured countless texts, but what we found was of questionable veracity.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_003: Accounts of Shiva's life and deeds are sparse and contradictory, only agreeing upon one point...
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_004: She lay down with a dragon─the gravest of all sins, according to the Ishgardian faith.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_005: Yet in the eyes of Iceheart's followers, this was a holy act─the blessed union of man and dragon.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_006: How such a thing could even be possible is quite another question. Suffice it to say, I very much doubt that we will find a useful answer in the archives of House Fortemps.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_007: Much knowledge has been lost over the centuries─though in this case, one wonders if it is by circumstance or design.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_008: You said that Iceheart took a moment to plead her case prior to escaping, did you not?
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_009: Hm. Viewed without prejudice, most would agree that bringing an end to an endless war serves the greater good.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_010: I think Ser Aymeric might take issue with her methods.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_AYMERIC_000_011: I do not care if a few stragglers manage to escape. Until the sappers confirm that a tunnel is safe, the men are not to search it.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_013: You pursue your foes with less zeal than I had expected, Ser Aymeric.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Lest you misunderstand, I do not deny that our enemy has given us good reason to be prudent. I merely meant─you being a man of faith─that I had expected a certain...single-mindedness. After all, was it not by the will of Halone that your ancestors came to this land─why they took up arms against the Dravanians? What would they have done in your position, I wonder...
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_AYMERIC_000_015: ...There are those who believe that faith is a renunciation of free will─that unquestioning devotion is required of all who would live a life in service to the Fury.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_AYMERIC_000_016: Such righteous fervor may well serve a knight on the front line─less so a leader of men.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_AYMERIC_000_017: We are all at liberty to interpret the scriptures as we will. I choose to believe that the Fury would value the lives of Her followers over the deaths of Her enemies.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_AYMERIC_000_018: But I would not presume to speak for the knights of eld. 'Twas a different time─nay, a different era─and scripture tells us only so much.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_020: That man is awfully pragmatic for a servant of the Holy See.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_021: A welcome trait at the negotiating table, to be sure─less so when one's enemies are making ready to harness the power of a god.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_022: Mayhap he does not truly believe that Iceheart's plan can succeed...? Truth be told, I too remain somewhat skeptical.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_023: Shiva was real─a living, breathing woman─of that there can be no doubt. In this respect, she differs from every other figure to have been summoned, each of whom was worshipped as a god.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_024: ...The sole exception being Good King Moggle Mog XII─the myth made manifest in response to the fervent supplications of the Mogglesguard.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Saint Shiva may differ, but what of the heretics? They are a tribe of outcasts at war with a mighty nation, who yearn for the resurrection of the one who embodies their beliefs. If that is not placing one's faith in a higher power, then what is?
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Crystals and conviction, Minfilia. They have them both in abundance.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_027: ...Can that truly be all that is required?
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_028: My survey team has concluded a preliminary analysis of the aetheryte Iceheart used to escape. They believe that she teleported to another aetheryte, somewhere not far to the west.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_029: Despite the apparent proximity of this second aetheryte, however, they have been wholly unable to detect its presence directly. Unless Iceheart has some means to mask its signal, I can only presume she had it destroyed to prevent us from following her.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Without the means to teleport as she did, we have no choice but to search for an alternate route─most likely a tunnel─assuming one exists.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_MINFILIA_000_031: Let us not give up on teleportation just yet. One of our colleagues in Sharlayan may be able to assist us.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_032: I pray that you are right. I dare not think how long it will take us to survey the entire tunnel system...
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_040: While Minfilia looks into our aetheryte problem, I would like to request your assistance with another matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_041: The 3rd Unit is currently tracking the remnants of the heretic force which attacked us. However, the search goes poorly, despite our numbers.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Coerthas is vast, and Iceheart's followers know the terrain far better than we. Your knowledge of this region may serve to hasten the process.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_043: The sooner we capture Iceheart's followers, the sooner we can press them for their leader's whereabouts.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Also─though it is admittedly a selfish request─I feel that my Braves would benefit immensely from working alongside you. While we have our share of veterans, we also have more than a few less-experienced recruits─many of whom look up to you, in case you were not aware.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Good, I knew you would understand. Yuyuhase can apprise you of the details.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_046: When the task is complete, come and find me at the Observatorium. Captain Ilberd and I are meeting there to discuss the latest developments in his investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_047: The Temple Knights shall hold Snowcloak in our absence. Let us leave them to their work─ours is more pressing.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_AYMERIC_000_050: The network of tunnels throughout Snowcloak is extensive. A full survey will take time.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_LUCIA_100_050: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)Harry the enemy when he is entrenched. Retreat from his advance, and attack his flanks when he withdraws. Aye, Iceheart is no fool.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_060: There you are, ! Commander Leveilleur instructed me to wait for you.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_061: Your assistance is most welcome, believe me. Most of the 3rd hail from Ul'dah, and for a man accustomed to the feel of sand beneath his boots, the crunch of snow can be rather disconcerting.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_062: But to the matter at hand─nary a moment ago, I received word that the heretics we seek have been spotted making for Daniffen Pass. My Braves are already in pursuit, and I should be grateful if you would join them.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_063: I myself shall be taking part in the hunt. Never let it be said that I do not earn my coin.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_THIRDSQUADRON00077_: Thal's balls, my ankle is on fire! Caught my boot on a rock or something and twisted it as I fell.
The others went on ahead through Daniffen Pass. Hurry and you might catch up.
If you aren't sure where to go, look for tracks. This snow is fresh, so they shouldn't be hard to find.
Go on without me, Scion. I'm in no condition to run. Just follow the fresh tracks.
<gasp> How can anyone run in this blasted snow without knowing what's underneath!?
Scion! What are you doing here!?
The heretics? I-I'm not sure. There was a great scaled beast, and... <cough> <cough> ...Yuyuhase? I think... I think he went east on his own. The heretics split up, so we did too.
I-I just need a moment to catch my breath. Just a moment, . I'll be right behind you.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_100_120: I don't get paid enough for this...
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_120: How embarrassing─I was so intent on following the heretics' tracks that I almost failed to notice they had doubled back. Almost, mind you─one tried to sneak up behind me and got a knife in the gut for his troubles.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_121: I thought myself alone, so I started searching the dead man's knapsack for anything of interest. And lo and behold, before his friends found me, I came upon this.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_123: “Withdraw in groups of three or less to the Observatorium. Give the signal and wait─the merchant will be watching. Be late and be left for dead.”
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_124: Speaks for itself, does it not? They can't possibly mean to rendezvous inside the place, so we should restrict our search to the surrounding areas.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_125: Let me rephrase that: you should restrict your search to the wilderness around the Observatorium. I will need more than a moment's rest to recover from these wounds.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUYUHASE_000_130: Quickly, , quickly! I will inform Captain Ilberd of the heretics' plans, but you must make sure that they do not escape before reinforcements arrive!
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_HERETIC00077_000_14: I am through with listening to your excuses! We leave now!
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_HERETICTRADER00077_: (-Suspicious Merchant-)How? The woods are crawling with those bluecoats, and the knights are searching every wagon that passes through the gates!
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_HERETIC00077_000_14: Well, stay with , then, if you think you'll fare any better.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ILBERD_000_143: Now, now, there's no need for that.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUGIRI_000_145: There are places like this in my homeland─sacred snowcapped peaks where blood must not be shed.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUGIRI_000_146: Yet your lands ever thirst for the blood of the fallen─and by your deeds, it has drunk deep.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_HERETICTRADER00077_: (-Suspicious Merchant-)N-No! I have done no wrong!
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ILBERD_000_148: None but meet in secret with heretics. Deny it all you will. We shall have the truth from you yet. Inquisitors are not the only ones skilled in the art of interrogation.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_150: Fancy meeting you here, . I presume your work with the 3rd brought you hither?
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_151: What a tangled web... Lest you wonder, we came not for the heretics, but for the merchant who has been conspiring with them.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_152: He came to our attention during the course of our investigation into the Ivy. It beggars belief, I know, but it seems our favorite Garlean spy may have been providing assistance to Iceheart.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_153: Were it not for the efforts of Lady Yugiri and her shinobi, we might never have discovered this connection.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUGIRI_000_154: Master Alphinaud is too kind. I fear my people and I have done little to aid your search for this spy.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUGIRI_000_155: We long to strike back against the Empire and weaken their influence in this land─to prevent the tragedy which befell Doma from reoccurring.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUGIRI_000_156: The days ahead and the work they promise will require a very particular set of skills. Skills which I am fortunate enough to possess. If you will allow it, I would accompany you until the investigation is complete.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_157: That is a most generous offer, Lady Yugiri, and one which I gladly accept.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_YUGIRI_100_157: Thank you. Though I may disappear for a time, know that I shall never be far, and shall always be watching.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_158: ...A comforting thought. Come, . Let us wait inside for Captain Ilberd to return and deliver his report.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_160: Captain Ilberd seemed confident that the merchant's resolve would swiftly crumble when pressed. If so, we should have new information ere long.
TEXT_GAIUSE409_00077_ALPHINAUD_000_161: As to whether it will bring us any closer to learning the Ivy's identity, I would rather not say. Given our adversary's cunning, I shall consider us fortunate if we are spared another wild-dodo chase. The gods know we have more than enough to occupy our time as it is.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_SEQ_00: Alphinaud is eager to hear Ilberd's report on the Ivy.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_SEQ_01: At the Observatorium, Ilberd furnishes you and Alphinaud with a progress report on his hunt for the Ivy. It is revealed that one of the imperial spy's confederates, a Flame stationed at Revenant's Toll, had been selling secrets to the merchant you apprehended, who had in turn been passing information to the heretics. Yet even as this revelation explains how the heretics came to possess knowledge of the caravan routes, it raises the question of how they and the imperial agents might be connected. Could it be a purely financial arrangement, or something more worrying? Whatever the answer, Ilberd seems confident that he is drawing closer to discovering the Ivy's identity. After issuing the captain further orders, Alphinaud bids you accompany him to an emergency meeting between Alliance leaders. Speak with him again to be informed of the particulars.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_SEQ_02: The council of Alliance leaders will convene at the Lotus Stand in Old Gridania. Alphinaud bids you join him at Nophica's Altar prior to the meeting.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_SEQ_03: The council of Alliance leaders will be convening shortly. Speak with the silent conjurer to be shown to the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_SEQ_04: At the Alliance council, you learn that the Garlean war of succession has concluded with the crowning of Varis zos Galvus, the late emperor's grandson. Under his leadership, it is feared the Empire will soon resume its march upon Eorzea. If the realm is to stand against the reinvigorated might of Garlemald, it seems clear that the Alliance must not only regain its former unity, but find a way to entice the long-estranged Ishgardians back into the fold. Speak with Alphinaud to hear his thoughts on the matters discussed.
