TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_SEQ_05: Having bent your ear with his philosophical musings, Alphinaud informs you that Ilberd has made further progress in his hunt for the Ivy. Seek the captain in front of the Adders' Nest in New Gridania, and place yourself at his disposal.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_SEQ_06: You have reported to Ilberd. At your word, the final hunt for the Ivy will commence.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_TODO_01: Speak with Alphinaud in Old Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_TODO_04: Speak with Ilberd in New Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Captain Ilberd. Your report, if you will.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_002: Aye, Commander. Firstly, with regard to the heretic we captured, I regret to say that the man could tell us naught that we did not already know of Shiva.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_003: We have since handed him over to the Ishgardian authorities. Henceforth, the Holy See will pursue the matter independently.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_004: Our inquiries concerning the Ivy, however, have proven more fruitful. We have ascertained the channel by which the heretics acquired their information on the shipment routes.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_006: You will recall the Flame we first identified as being in the Ivy's employ. From him we were able to trace a trail of conspirators, each taking us closer to his master.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_007: Alas, the trail came to an abrupt end. Fearing that the investigation had been compromised, we took the necessary step of detaining all suspected of conspiracy.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_008: There were five on our list, including a Flame stationed at Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_009: The man's primary duty was to keep an inventory of donations from abroad, the particulars of which he would share with benefactors, thereby ensuring that needs did not go unfulfilled.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_010: By virtue of his role, he was privy to the details of all shipments bound for the settlement. Needless to say, that included those originating from House Fortemps.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_011: He knew the precise route the caravan would take. And he sold that information to a merchant.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_012: I think I can guess which one...
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_013: None other. With a little encouragement, he soon confessed to knowingly aiding and abetting the heretics.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Well, that is one mystery solved, at least. But what of the Ivy? Are we any closer to prising off his mask?
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_015: I daresay we are, Commander. Our relentless pursuit has forced him to commit a grave error.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_016: In a desperate bid to cover his tracks, the Ivy resorted to exercising certain administrative powers available only to high-ranking members of the Immortal Flames.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_017: If you consider then that our investigation is known to barely a handful of them, the field of suspects is greatly narrowed.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_018: You mean to say that the agent is among Raubahn's innermost circle? Someone who has been with him since the Immortal Flames' establishment?
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_019: 'Tis the most plausible explanation. The infiltration likely occurred during the company's founding, with the groundwork for the act being laid beforehand.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_020: To slip into a position of authority unremarked, and remain above suspicion all these years...
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_021: Aye. I, too, was surprised─though I really should not have been. Of the three Grand Companies, Ul'dah's was ever the more vulnerable to infiltration.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_022: Both Limsa Lominsa and Gridania had long-standing armed forces that lent themselves well to the formation of the Maelstrom and the Order of the Twin Adder. To all intents and purposes, it was the same people─loyal ones, mind─under the same leadership. Only the banner was different.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_023: Not so the Flames. Ul'dah's military was made up of disparate orders, most of which were glorified mercenary companies that answered only to their own paymasters.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_024: ...Hardly an ideal environment in which to establish something as high-minded as a Grand Company.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_025: The difficulties Raubahn faced when founding the Immortal Flames are well known. Even after he had convinced his fellow Syndicate members to share the cost, there remained the small matter of finding enough bodies to fill the ranks.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Indeed. And given the pressing nature of the imperial threat, that meant recruiting every passing sellsword.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_027: Amidst the chaos of its founding, it would have been child's play to infiltrate the company.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_028: A good deal easier then than now, aye.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_029: The Immortal Flames have ever been caught between conflicting interests─the public and the private.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Though the Monetarists ultimately agreed to support the organization's founding, 'twas not out of charity that they did so, but simple self-preservation.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Had Nael van Darnus's ambitions been any less apocalyptic, you may be sure that they would never have risked supplying Raubahn with an army. 'Tis but a wonder they did not attempt to extinguish the Flames the moment the danger had passed...
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_033: Even as we speak, our Doman allies are shadowing several high-ranking Flames, any one of whom could be the Ivy.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_034: Desiring to deal a blow against the Empire, the refugees were eager to lend us their aid. I expect to hear from them ere long.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Very good. Pray continue your investigation with the 1st.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Meanwhile, have the 2nd attend to the unrest. The 3rd can join the 4th in inspecting crystal shipments.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_037: If they notice anything unusual, I want to know about it. If Shiva is summoned in like manner to the other primals, the heretics will be looking for further supplies.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_039: I shall send word to Ser Aymeric informing him of our success in identifying the heretics' abettors. Hopefully, the information will be of some use to the Ishgardians.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_042: An emergency council of the Alliance leadership has been called. There have been developments in Garlemald, it would seem.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_043: As commander of the Crystal Braves, my presence has been requested.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_044: I would have you accompany me, . As the realm's stoutest champion, 'tis only meet that you be present for the discussion. Oh, and the Antecedent has already given her consent, lest you worry.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_100_001: Upon the honor of the Crystal Braves, I swear that I shall not rest until the Ivy is unmasked and in chains.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Like me, you are doubtless eager to conclude our business with Iceheart, but until another path to her sanctum is found, she will remain beyond our reach.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Minfilia and the Archons are sparing no effort to secure an alternate route. Until such time as they succeed, I suggest we give some thought to the realm's other problems...
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_052: I shall go on ahead to Gridania in readiness for the coming council.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Meet me at Nophica's Altar, and we shall make our way to the Lotus Stand together.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_061: When you are ready, speak with the conjurer yonder. She will show us to the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_070: Unlike Raubahn, politics is not my cup of tea. While you and the commander attend the council, I will attend to some business of my own.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_071: When you are ready, speak with the conjurer yonder. She will show us to the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_DOORMANLOTUS_000_08: The Alliance leaders await you at the Lotus Stand. Will you be joining them now?
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_090: It will not have escaped your notice that the nations of Eorzea are no nearer to being of one purpose, despite their protestations to the contrary. Plainly, the threat of a resurgent Garlemald is not enough to stir them.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_091: And the reason for this? Deep-rooted mistrust amongst the citizenry. The nations' leaders can come to all the understandings they like, but their unity means little and less to the commonfolk.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_092: Take the Lominsans, for instance. Though Admiral Merlwyb outlawed piracy over a decade ago, foreigners still picture the nation as a haven for grog-swilling, wooden-legged cutthroats.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_093: In like wise, the Gridanians are mocked as hermits who talk to trees, and the Ul'dahns scorned as swindlers who worship coin.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_094: ...Not that such sentiments are entirely without grounds, of course. Take that pillar of Ul'dahn society Teledji Adeledji, for example. But that is beside the point. The fact is that people are wary of outsiders whether they have cause to be or not.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_095: On that basis, one could argue that the conflict at Carteneau is a necessary evil.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_096: Each nation has its own warmongering faction that advocates the acquisition of Omega. In order to placate them, we present them something resembling warfare, and thereby curb their appetite for full-scale conflict.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_097: ...But enough idle musing. Let us speak of a more pressing matter: the Ivy.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_098: Since we spoke at the Observatorium, Captain Ilberd has further shortened his list of suspects. And by happy coincidence, the one he deems the most likely candidate is lately come to Gridania...
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_099: The hunt nears its end, . All that remains is to corner our quarry. Seek out Ilberd near the Adders' Nest. He will give you the particulars.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Should there be any developments in Coerthas, you may be sure that I will send word without delay. In the meantime, I wish you success in apprehending the Ivy.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_110: My thanks for coming, Scion. Doubtless the commander has informed you, but we have unmasked the Ivy.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ILBERD_000_111: From this point on, we must proceed with extreme caution.
TEXT_GAIUSE410_00078_ROAILLE_000_120: Gridania's lush abundance never ceases to delight me. 'Tis a far cry from the barren deserts of Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_SEQ_00: Minfilia has never been one to hesitate when it comes to asking others for aid.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_SEQ_01: It would seem that Minfilia's claims of progress on the matter of finding a way into Iceheart's sanctuary are somewhat premature. After a lengthy discussion with Urianger, the Antecedent has concluded that the Scions in Revenant's Toll lack the expertise to develop a solution and must therefore turn to another for assistance─a Sharlayan colleague who is currently en route to Mor Dhona. Minfilia invites you to accompany her to the northern gates, where she intends to greet the newcomer's arrival.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_SEQ_02: While you and Minfilia converse upon matters deep and profound, a carriage arrives in Revenant's Toll. A tall Roegadyn woman disembarks from it, whom Minfilia introduces to you as Moenbryda, an accomplished Sharlayan scholar and an authority on aetheryte technologies. Now that your new colleague has arrived, it would seem a good time to trouble Minfilia for a plan of action.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_SEQ_03: Eager to resolve the situation in Snowcloak, Minfilia and Moenbryda return to the Rising Stones. Join them in the solar where you can discuss the matter in private.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_SEQ_04: It turns out that Moenbryda's meeting with the other Scions is less an introduction and more a reunion─a particularly emotional one, in the case of Urianger. Setting her mind to the problem of the missing aetheryte, she quickly devises a solution involving white auracite, a material she has been researching for the purpose of capturing Ascian souls. By using it to channel a burst of concentrated aether into the aetheryte by which Iceheart escaped, she believes she can recreate the beacon at the opposite end. If successful, it should theoretically be possible for you to teleport to it. Should it fail, of course, any such attempt would result in your death─a painless death, to be sure, but a permanent one nonetheless.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_TODO_00: Wait for the carriage outside Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_000: As you may recall, Iceheart used the aetheryte in the depths of Snowcloak to teleport a short distance to the west─most likely to a sanctuary of some description. It is there that we suspect she means to summon Shiva using the crystals she stole from the House Fortemps caravan.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_100_000: The heretics believe that they are bringing about the second coming of their patron saint. But if, as we suspect, they mean to hold a summoning ritual of the kind employed by the beast tribes, it seems likely that the result will be something more akin to a primal.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_001: Suffice it to say, they must be stopped─and stop them we shall. But first, we must surmount the obstacle that Iceheart has placed in our path.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_002: Ordinarily, it would be a simple matter to tap into the established Aethernet and thereby follow our quarry. However, despite our best efforts, we have been unable to ascertain the position of the aetheryte to which she teleported.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_003: Our prevailing theory is that she destroyed the second aetheryte upon arrival─a reckless, desperate measure, but also an effective one.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_004: After discussing the matter at length with Urianger, we have concluded that we lack the expertise to develop a solution.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_005: ...Which is why we have called upon the aid of one who does possess such expertise─a colleague of ours who is currently en route to Revenant's Toll from Sharlayan. She should be arriving within the hour, in fact.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_006: Since you are here, mayhap we could welcome her together. I am certain she would appreciate the gesture. Let us make our way to the northern gates and await her coming.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_050: What manner of woman is she, I wonder...? We have spoken before via linkpearl, of course, but it is not the same.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_YDA_000_070: I can't wait until she gets here! We have so much to talk about!
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_PAPALYMO_000_080: Master Louisoix did think quite highly of her. On the other hand, so does Yda...
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_THANCRED_000_090: The arrival of a newcomer has ever been cause for celebration─doubly so when she's an attractive young lady. A bard could wish for no better audience. Mayhap I shall regale her with the tale of our battle against Leviathan's thralls─how I soared over my opponent's axe and brought him low with my blades...
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_YSHTOLA_000_100: Only those with proven expertise receive the mark─as our newcomer has. Pay no heed to her manner.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MOENBRYDA_000_110: For an outpost in an aether-rich wasteland, this place is a good deal livelier than I expected. Just goes to show that you never know until you know.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MINFILIA_000_060: Let us return to the Rising Stones at once, then. We have much to discuss.
TEXT_GAIUSE414_00082_MOENBRYDA_000_120: Is that Tupsimati on the wall back there? I'm amazed you managed to find all the pieces after...well...you know.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_00: A plan has been devised, and Minfilia would have it carried out without further delay.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_01: According to Minfilia, Alphinaud has asked to speak with you before you join your fellow Scions inside Snowcloak, where preparations for Moenbryda's plan are already underway. Though she believes with all her heart that you will survive, she nevertheless thanks you for all you have done in service to the realm. Bid farewell to the Antecedent and rendezvous with Alphinaud at Snowcloak.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_02: Accompanied by Alphinaud and Moenbryda, you journey to the heart of Snowcloak, where the assembled Scions channel their aether into Moenbryda's white auracite. The scholar then directs the flow into the nearby aetheryte, which begins to glow brightly. At Moenbryda's instruction, you attune to the giant crystal, opening a path to Iceheart's sanctuary...probably. Speak with Alphinaud one last time before teleporting to only the gods know where.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_03: Given the likelihood that Iceheart is now aware of your plans and making haste to complete the summoning ritual, Alphinaud advises you to assemble a party of battle-hardened adventurers capable of felling Shiva if necessary. However, before you do so, he bids you speak with the stalwart Temple Knight, who bears a missive from Ser Aymeric addressed to you.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_04:
The lord commander of the Temple Knights is appreciative of your efforts, and he prays that Halone will see you safely home. Call upon your allies, place your faith in Moenbryda's plan, and put an end to Iceheart's crusade.

※The Akh Afah Amphitheatre (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_05: Those driven to the brink of despair are ever the most dangerous of foes, as you are reminded when Iceheart offers her own body as a vessel for Shiva's soul. The resurrected saint of eld lashes out with a righteous fury, pushing you to your mortal limits...yet the battle ends as it began, with the young maiden kneeling in the snow, cursing your ignorance.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_06: “Hear... Feel... Think...” Of Iceheart's cryptic parting words, her final three leave the deepest impression, for few indeed are the ways in which one could come to know them. Could it be that Hydaelyn speaks to your enemy too? For the time being, put aside such troubling thoughts and inform Moenbryda of your victory.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_SEQ_07: Moenbryda is understandably skeptical about your description of events. However, she is willing to give you the benefit of the doubt for the time being─on the understanding that you did not suffer any form of head trauma. Certain of what you saw, you elect not to inform her that cranial injuries are only to be expected when doing battle with a primal.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_TODO_02: Speak with the stalwart Temple Knight.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_TODO_03: Confront Shiva in the Akh Afah Amphitheatre (Hard).
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_TODO_04: Confront Shiva in the Akh Afah Amphitheatre (Hard).
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MINFILIA_000_010: I have already informed Alphinaud of our plan to recreate the beacon in the manner Moenbryda described. He agreed that despite the inherent danger, it represents our only hope of success.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MINFILIA_000_011: He also said that he wished to meet with you at Snowcloak before proceeding. I expect you will find him waiting for you there when you arrive.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MINFILIA_000_012: I want you to know that I appreciate everything you have done on our behalf, , and that I have faith you will return to us─as you always have.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Good to see you, . I was starting to wonder if you were having second thoughts.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Captain Ilberd sends his regards, by the way. He attends to the interrogation of Eline Roaille in Ul'dah even as we speak.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_032: But I shall not distract you from the matter at hand. We can discuss the Ivy upon your return.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_033: I trust that... By which I mean to say... Ahem. The others are waiting for us at the aetheryte. After you, Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_100_030: Trust in the power of white auracite, ─and in me, of course.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_000_003: Try attuning to the aetheryte now. Feel for the current and try to locate the beacon.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_004: We have done all we can, . For now, let us withdraw.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_005: When your final preparations are complete, you must seek out the beacon we have created. If, by the grace of the Twelve, you arrive safely, you must stop Iceheart before she summons Shiva.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_040: We cannot ignore the possibility that our actions have alerted Iceheart to our plans.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Should that be the case, she may attempt to hasten the completion of the summoning ritual. And if she succeeds, you will have little choice but to face Shiva in battle.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Knowing little of this “saint,” I cannot say if your own strength will suffice, and so I would encourage you to call upon your allies.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Some may have reservations about wagering their lives on the success of Moenbryda's experiment, but others will surely agree that desperate times call for desperate measures.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_044: Ah! Before you assemble your party, pray speak with that knight. I believe he has a message for you from Ser Aymeric.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Of all the myriad challenges you have faced, I should be amazed if it were a failed teleportation attempt that finally killed you. Pray do not surprise me.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_000_060: I've a mind to join you, but Urianger made me promise I wouldn't.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_000_061: Apparently the thought of me becoming Shiva's thrall was too much to bear. Hmph. As if I'd give her the chance.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_TEMPLER00075_000_07: . Ser Aymeric regrets that he could not be here in person, and asks that I read to you this letter. Ahem.

“Ishgard faces an unprecedented threat─yet in our hour of need, it is not her knights who stand poised to defend her. , the Warrior of Light, savior of Eorzea─your deeds this day shall not be forgotten.

“Where others would flee, you choose to remain. Where others would falter, you rise to the challenge. Where others would use their gifts for selfish ends, you wield yours in service to a greater cause.
“May Halone bless you with good fortune and see you safely home.”
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_000_080: By the Twelve, you're alive! I-I mean, of course you're alive! Why wouldn't you be?
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_000_081: Iceheart did what? And...you're certain about that, are you? Dravanians are skilled with glamours, after all...
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_000_082: Look─if you say that's what you saw, I believe you. It's just that I've never heard of a primal being summoned like that before.
TEXT_GAIUSE415_00084_MOENBRYDA_000_083: Are you sure you're not injured? Head trauma has been known to cause hallucinations, you see... No? Fair enough. I was only asking.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_SEQ_00: Moenbryda remains unconvinced that you have not sustained a head injury.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_SEQ_01: Seeing little point in pondering the implications of your tale in Coerthas, Moenbryda declares that she and the others will return to the Rising Stones. Before you join them, journey to Whitebrim Front and inform Alphinaud that you are still alive, among other things.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_SEQ_02: Alphinaud's voice swells with pride as he asks you to recount the events in Snowcloak. Though he is disappointed and concerned by Iceheart's success in summoning Shiva, Ser Aymeric advises him to take solace in your victory. As further comfort, he reveals that some of the supplies stolen from the House Fortemps caravan have been recovered and will be delivered to Revenant's Toll forthwith. The lord commander then requests that you accompany him to Camp Dragonhead, as it seems a certain lord has been praying for your safe return.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_SEQ_03: Lord Haurchefant is more than a little distressed that you did not think to involve him in your daring endeavor. Though plainly overjoyed that you survived, it is clear that the stress has taken its toll on him. Composing himself, he informs you that Ser Aymeric has requested a private audience with you and Alphinaud in the intercessory, though he makes no mention of what the lord commander wishes to discuss.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_SEQ_04: The cordial mood between Alphinaud and Ser Aymeric abruptly turns sour when the Scion accuses his counterpart of manipulating the situation to his advantage. In response, the lord commander all but declares his desire to work with Alphinaud for the betterment of Eorzea, while stressing that a man in his position must act with the utmost discretion. Alphinaud relents, having at last gained an understanding of the pragmatic ambassador, and the rift between the two is quickly mended. Ser Aymeric then formally introduces his second-in-command, Lucia, who will act as his representative when he is otherwise indisposed. As a final gesture of goodwill, the lord commander shares the results of the Ishgardian investigation into the heretics' attacks with Alphinaud, which should help the Crystal Braves to dismantle the remainder of Eline Roaille's network of spies. Whatever else Ishgard may be, it is plain that she is no friend to Garlemald.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_TODO_00: Speak with Alphinaud at Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_TODO_01: Speak with Haurchefant at Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_TODO_02: Speak with the House Fortemps guard.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_MOENBRYDA_000_000: If you ask me, there's naught to be gained from mulling over the implications of your story in the freezing cold. Let's save it for the Rising Stones, eh? I'll get everyone to meet us there.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_MOENBRYDA_000_001: Ah, but before that, you had best pay a visit to Whitebrim Front and speak with Alphinaud. He's probably worried sick about you.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_MOENBRYDA_000_002: That, or he's busy playing at politics with the Ishgardians. Either way, I'm sure he'll be delighted to see you hale and healthy. Speaking of which─you don't have a headache or anything, do you? No? ...Blurred vision? Oh, no reason!
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_DRILLEMONT_000_010: I still remember the first time you entered these chambers. Suffice it to say, I never imagined that I would one day be so glad of your return. Welcome, my friend. Welcome.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_LUCIA_000_020: (-Taciturn Temple Knight-)...'Tis customary to report to one's commanding officer after completing a mission.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_030: That you stand here now is proof of your mission's success. Praise be to Halone.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_ALPHINAUD_000_040: There  is─and none the worse for wear! Was there ever any doubt that the Warrior of Light would succeed?
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_ALPHINAUD_000_041: I think I speak for us all when I say that I should like nothing more than to hear the stirring tale of your victory─if you would be so kind.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Then we were too late to prevent the summoning...
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_043: But not too late to prevent further loss of life. An outcome worthy of celebration...
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_044: And one for which we have  to thank.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Yes... You are right, of course, Ser Aymeric. We should be content with what we have accomplished.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_046: I for one could not have wished for a better outcome. Shiva is no longer a threat, and the heretics have been routed.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_047: Aye, there is the matter of Iceheart's escape, but she cannot run forever. Whether it takes days, weeks, moons, or even years, my knights will find her.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_048: In the meantime─ Lord Drillemont, is the caravan ready?
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_DRILLEMONT_000_049: The supplies that your men recovered have been prepared for transport, in accordance with your wishes.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_DRILLEMONT_000_050: Rest assured that my knights will see them safely to Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_051: Of that I have no doubt.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_ALPHINAUD_000_052: I take it these are the selfsame supplies the heretics stole from the House Fortemps caravan?
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_053: Less the crystals which comprised the bulk of the shipment, yes. Scarcely a fraction of that which was promised, but a meaningful contribution to your cause all the same.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_054: Ah, on an unrelated note... ─might I trouble you to accompany me to Camp Dragonhead at your earliest convenience?
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_055: 'Tis not for my benefit. A certain lord was most distressed when he learned of your intent to risk life and limb to stop Iceheart. It took half a dozen knights to restrain him, I am told.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_AYMERIC_000_056: Men give vent to their anxieties in myriad ways. Pray do not think less of him.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_ALPHINAUD_000_060: If our business here is concluded, we should attend to Ser Aymeric in the intercessory.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_HAURCHEFANT_000_070: What were you thinking, !? Wagering your very being on a dubious theory which might allow you to enter Iceheart's lair─knowing full well that she could have sufficient forewarning to complete her ritual to summon Shiva anyway...?
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_HAURCHEFANT_000_071: And then─and then─engaging the abomination in mortal combat!? By the Fury, ! 'Tis the stuff of ballads! A battle for the ages! Would that I had been there to fight by your side!
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_HAURCHEFANT_000_072: Yet here I was forced to wait─condemned to wonder at the fate of a dear friend for a veritable eternity!
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_HAURCHEFANT_000_073: I would not wish such torture on my most hated enemy...
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_HAURCHEFANT_000_074: <sigh> But you are here now, and that is what truly matters. Let us move on.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_HAURCHEFANT_000_075: Ser Aymeric wished to have words with you and Master Alphinaud in private. He awaits us in the intercessory.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_HAURCHEFANT_100_070: Pray go on ahead without me, . Another matter requires my attention, but I shall join you anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE416_00086_FORTEMPSGUARD00054_: Greetings, . I shall show you in at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_SEQ_00: For one with reason to celebrate, Alphinaud looks rather grim.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_SEQ_01: The implications of Iceheart's actions are not lost on Alphinaud, who is eager to discuss them with your colleagues at the Rising Stones. Return with him to Mor Dhona and report to Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_SEQ_02: Was Shiva a primal, or something heretofore unseen? Did Iceheart truly become her, and if so, did she retain control? Did the Ascians have a hand in her plans? Your tale raises more than a few questions which the Scions are unable to answer. Minfilia is most troubled by Iceheart's final words to you, from which she concludes that the heretics' leader is blessed with the power of the Echo. What drove the young maiden to take such drastic action remains unclear, but if she is to be believed, then the answer may lie with Midgardsormr─the great wyrm that perished at the Battle of Silvertear Skies, and that Ishgardian astrologians fear may soon rise from the dead...
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_TODO_00: Speak with Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It would seem we have much to discuss with our friends at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_001: If what you say is true, Iceheart's method of summoning Shiva defies all precedent. It necessitates a complete reappraisal of the primal threat, and of our approach to combating it.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Moreover, there are grave ramifications if word of this incident reaches imperial ears.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_003: The Garlean Empire believes that primals are an insufferable menace─that their mere existence is a threat to this very star. As such, they deem any action taken against the beast tribes to be justified by default.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_004: Imagine then...if it became known that it was not only the beast tribes of Eorzea that could summon primals, but her civilized peoples as well, any lingering objections to the Eorzean campaign would vanish overnight.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Where before we had to contend with a single imperial legion, we could well find ourselves facing the combined might of all Garlemald...
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_006: But I speak unadvisedly. Come, ─it is better that we continue this conversation in Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_010: If there is one thing that can be said for Ser Aymeric, it is that he understands how dangerous knowledge can be in the wrong hands.
TEXT_GAIUSE417_00087_ALPHINAUD_000_011: We are but fortunate that this incident took place in so remote a location. The truth should not be too difficult to suppress─for now, at least.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_SEQ_00: Minfilia would discuss how best to proceed in light of recent developments.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_SEQ_01: Minfilia has scarcely begun to tell you of her intent to study the great wyrm Midgardsormr when some manner of commotion erupts just outside the solar. Do as the Antecedent bids and see if aught is amiss.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_SEQ_02: A clearly agitated Alphinaud informs you that Eline Roaille has somehow managed to slip her confines and escape. He believes that the disgraced flame marshal means to flee to her imperial masters at Castrum Meridianum. Make haste to Camp Bluefog in northern Thanalan, and join Ilberd and the 1st Unit in their hunt for the fugitive.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_SEQ_03: You arrive at Camp Bluefog to the news that Eline Roaille passed through scarcely a bell before. Follow Captain Ilberd to the nearby Ceruleum Processing Plant, the next notable landmark on the way to Castrum Meridianum.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_SEQ_04: You overtake Eline Roaille at Raubahn's Push, but not before she is joined by her imperial allies. Undeterred, you stand shoulder to shoulder with the Crystal Braves and the shinobi of Doma, and engage the enemy, succeeding at length in overwhelming the Garleans and recapturing the fugitive. Wholly unrepentant, Eline greets the subsequent arrival of Alphinaud with a hail of vitriol, and is lambasted by Ilberd for her shamelessness before being dragged away. Ask Alphinaud for his thoughts on the heated exchange.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_SEQ_05: Alphinaud seems troubled. Though the sordid business of the Ivy is concluded, it has plainly left an unpleasant taste in his mouth.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_TODO_01: Speak with Ilberd at Camp Bluefog, in northern Thanalan.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_TODO_02: Speak with Ilberd at the Ceruleum Processing Plant.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_MINFILIA_000_010: I mean to scour the annals for knowledge of Midgardsormr. Given his great age, I daresay he appears in more than a few─
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_MINFILIA_000_011: Hm? Do you hear that? The commotion outside... Would you see if aught is amiss?
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_MINFILIA_000_020: There seems to be some manner of commotion without. Pray see if aught is amiss.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_030: ! 'Tis well that you are on hand! We have a problem─Roaille has escaped!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_031: It happened shortly after the Immortal Flames took her into custody. She had been placed in a dungeon cell ahead of her coming trial, but apparently the accommodation was not to her liking.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_032: The turnkey was found slain along with two guards. 'Tis plain she received inside help.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Citizens report seeing Roaille quitting the city via the Gate of Nald, with a bloodied spear in her hand.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_034: She makes for Castrum Meridianum, I am certain of it. With her fate in Eorzea as good as sealed, what recourse has she but to flee to her imperial masters?
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Even as we speak, Captain Ilberd and the 1st are hot upon Roaille's heels. Pray make haste to Camp Bluefog and join the hunt.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_040: My thanks for coming, Scion. I have spoken with the soldiers here. They say that Roaille walked through the camp not a bell ago.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_041: Aye, she walked right through─you did not mishear. We have Raubahn's decision to keep the matter secret to thank for that. Bad for morale, he said...
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_042: As a result, not a single Flame in the garrison made any attempt to detain her. And so here we are.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_043: Roaille must not be allowed to reach Castrum Meridianum.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_050: This wretch was with Roaille. He threw himself at us that his mistress might escape.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_051: She didn't blink when we cut him down─not even when he started screaming. No loyalty even to her own, the godsdamned harpy... <spit> With me, Scion─we almost have her.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_YUYUHASE_100_050: <sigh> Was that really necessary? I had better be compensated for the additional exertion you caused me.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_QIB_TODO001: Defeat Eline Roaille and her imperial allies!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_BATTLETALK_0: I want Roaille alive. Kill the rest! FOR EORZEA!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ROAILLE_BATTLETALK_: Hmph! You will not take me so easily this time!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_YUYUHASE_BATTLETALK: More reinforcements? They really aren't paying me enough...
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ROAILLE_BATTLETALK_: Fools! You cannot stand against the Empire!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_BATTLETALK_0: They have healers! Kill them first!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_YUGIRI_BATTLETALK_0: The circle fetters those who wander within! Lure the enemy to it!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_YUYUHASE_BATTLETALK: I've more than earned my coin already...
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_061: Bind her! And do it tight!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_064: She and her imperial cronies pushed us close, but we were better.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Behold...a respected officer of the Immortal Flames. People looked up to you as one of the order's founding members─one of its pillars. It saddens me to see you fallen so low.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ROAILLE_000_066: <snort> What would you know of low? You─a spoiled little lordling who has never known any want!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ROAILLE_000_068: People such as you take wealth and birth for granted! You think it your gods-given right to rule over others!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ROAILLE_000_069: You know naught of our plight─the injustice that we lowborn Ishgardians must endure! To the noble lords and ladies, we are not people, but resources to be consumed!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ROAILLE_000_070: I did what I had to do to survive─stealing, killing, even whoring myself! It is no fault of mine if fools imagined me a paragon when I joined the Flames!
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_071: To hear you tell it, one would think you the only person ever to have suffered.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_072: In case you have forgotten, Raubahn himself was born into poverty─as was I. We lived hand-to-mouth, with little more than the shirts on our backs. Hunger was our constant companion.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_073: Yet never did we bemoan our lot in life, nor did we begrudge others their fortunes. We accepted the hand that we had been dealt─and played it to the best of our ability.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_074: Life was a battle, aye, but no matter what fate threw at us, we took it on the chin and came back for more. Everything we have, we fought for.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ROAILLE_000_075: How are we any different then!?
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_076: 'Tis true that we were both mercenaries of lowly birth.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_077: And 'tis true that we both had our fair share of struggles.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_078: But whereas I sold my sword, you, Marshal─you sold your comrades.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_079: If life has taught me one thing, it is that you never betray your own. I would sooner cut off my own arm than raise a hand against a friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_080: ...But enough talk. You will return to Ul'dah to face justice─and the people whose trust you have dragged through the gutter.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Not so much as a hint of remorse... <sigh> 'Tis well that this sordid business is finally at an end.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ALPHINAUD_000_091: A friend's betrayal cuts deeper than steel. We must hope that we have chosen our own allies more wisely than Raubahn chose his.
TEXT_GAIUSE418_00088_ILBERD_000_100: I joined the Crystal Braves that I might strike a blow against the Empire. Those who cast their lot with Garlemald should expect no better treatment.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_SEQ_00: Alphinaud would ask another favor of you.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_SEQ_01: Alphinaud informs you that he and Ilberd are planning to question Eline Roaille before reporting their findings to Raubahn. While they conduct their interrogation, you are to return to the Rising Stones and inform Minfilia of all that has occurred.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_SEQ_02: With the Ivy unmasked and her network of spies in disarray, the Empire's power to observe and influence Eorzean affairs has been greatly diminished. Meanwhile, your fellow Scions have made further progress in the quest to find a means to destroy the Ascians. If their theories are correct, white auracite may allow you to recreate the blade of Light you once used to vanquish Lahabrea.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_TODO_00: Report to Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Captain Ilberd and I have a few questions for the flame marshal regarding the circumstances of her miraculous escape. When we have completed our interrogation, we shall take our findings directly to General Raubahn, and that shall be the end of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Your work here is done, my friend─my thanks.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_ALPHINAUD_100_001: Ah, but I have one last task for you: return to the Rising Stones and apprise Minfilia of all that has happened.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_ALPHINAUD_101_001: I am aware that the Antecedent held Roaille in high regard... For better or worse, she will want to know how this tale ends.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_ILBERD_000_010: Like Roaille, I once made my way as a mercenary─and like her, I did more than a few things I am not proud of.
TEXT_GAIUSE419_00089_ILBERD_000_011: But never once did I betray my own. There are depths to which a man should not sink.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_SEQ_00: Minfilia is considering which of her many responsibilities demands her utmost attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_SEQ_01: As the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have grown in size and influence, so too have their responsibilities, prompting Minfilia to consider if their expansion was wise. Alphinaud, however, does not harbor such concerns, having embraced his role as commander of the Crystal Braves and guardian of Eorzea. The young Elezen now wishes to aid the Immortal Flames in their ongoing efforts to bring stability to Ul'dah, and he would like your assistance with this mission as well. Join him outside the solar and listen to what Riol, his subordinate, has to say.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_SEQ_02: Riol, who has been attempting to trace the source of some weapons wielded by disgruntled refugees, has learned of a large shipment which may be intended for the same purpose. A black marketeer in eastern Thanalan is planning to resell the weapons and reap a tidy profit─unless you and Ilberd intervene before the exchange takes place. Rendezvous with the captain of the Crystal Braves at Highbridge.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_SEQ_03: Ilberd informs you that the black marketeer's clients have arrived. With luck, you may prevent the sale of illicit goods, seize the men who covet them, and learn their intent.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_RIOL_000_001: Lot o' new faces've come in from all over to join the Crystal Braves. We're glad for the help, o' course, but it's still a right pain in the arse trainin' 'em up.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_010: I am most eager to address the Ascian threat. However, we dare not neglect our other pressing concerns.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_011: We both know full well that Saint Shiva will not be the last primal we face...and our relationship with Ishgard is still tenuous at best.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_012: To think that the resolution of the primal threat was once the sole priority of the Scions of the Seventh Dawn. Some days I wonder if it was wise for us to take on so many other responsibilities.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Lest you forget, Antecedent, the Scions need not shoulder the burden alone. Were not the Crystal Braves established for this very reason?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_015: True, we are presented with a multitude of problems. However, we have all the resources we need to address them in turn.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_016: , in particular, is ever a steadying hand, who I trust will continue to support the Braves.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_017: To what do we owe the pleasure? Have there been further developments regarding the situation in Ul'dah?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_018: As expected, the Immortal Flames have been struggling to cope with the revelation that one of their highest-ranking officers was a Garlean agent.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Suffice it to say, Teledji Adeledji and his Monetarist ilk have wasted no time in attempting to turn the situation to their advantage. Coupled with ongoing unrest, the Flames are finding themselves hard-pressed.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Plainly, General Raubahn needs our help, and I will direct the Crystal Braves to offer what support they can.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_021: If I am to stay abreast of the latest developments and issue effective orders, however, I cannot afford to waste time traveling back and forth.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_022: And so, for the foreseeable future, I think it would be for the best if I were to remain in Ul'dah─unless you have an objection?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_023: None whatsoever. We have matters here well in hand.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Moenbryda's research is proceeding as planned?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_025: So she tells me, though I am not familiar with the details.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_026: Urianger is poring over his tomes at the Waking Sands, and the others are contributing in their own ways.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_027: Alas, the key problem─how to form an aetherial blade at will─remains unsolved. Nevertheless, it is only a matter of time.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_028: , while we focus on that task, mayhap you could assist Alphinaud and his Braves with theirs?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_029: It would do much to restore faith in the Immortal Flames if the Warrior of Light was seen working on their behalf.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_030: Never forget that your esteemed status allows you to act in ways that those more tightly bound to organizations and nations cannot. As ever, I implore you to do so.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_031: Not that your response was ever in doubt, but I humbly thank you once more for aiding our cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Now then, there are preparations I must attend to before my departure, such as receiving Riol's latest report.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_033: He has proven to be quite skilled at gathering information others wish kept secret, hence why I placed him under my direct command and ordered him to investigate the Ul'dahn riots.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_034: When you are finished here, join me outside. Depending on what he has to say, I may soon have a favor to ask.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_035: If there are any developments on our front, I shall inform you at once in the usual fashion.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_MINFILIA_000_040: While we focus on resolving the Ascian threat, pray devote your energies to assisting Alphinaud and the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Is everything in order, ? Are you ready to attend us?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_RIOL_000_050: Pleasure as always, . You'll be escortin' the commander to Ul'dah, I take it?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Actually, I had another task in mind for .
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_052: If you would be so kind as to repeat your report for  benefit?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_RIOL_100_053: Me an' mine've been makin' inquiries into the source o' the weapons what found their ways into refugee hands a ways back.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_RIOL_000_054: So happens we caught wind o' somethin' promisin': a rather large purchase o' sharp an' pointy things by a black marketeer holed up near Highbridge.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_055: I doubt that this man would have secured such a quantity of weapons if he did not already have clients waiting─clients that, for whatever reason, would prefer for this transaction to remain secret.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_RIOL_000_056: Brings to mind that merchant what caught an arrow while talkin' to , don't it? Generous fellow, he was, dolin' out swords an' spears to the downtrodden an' disgruntled.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_RIOL_000_057: Which isn't to say that these clients have the same mischief in mind...but if ye want to be sure, might be prudent to intervene before they collect their goods, savvy?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_058: Seizing the weapons before they fall into the wrong hands would be for the best. However, if we strike at the appointed hour, we might capture the black marketeer as well as his clients. What say you, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_059: Then it is settled. Rendezvous with Captain Ilberd at Highbridge and intervene when the exchange takes place.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Now then, if you would excuse me, I must leave for Ul'dah. I expect good tidings.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_RIOL_000_061: Don't keep Captain Ilberd waitin' for ye too long, . He might have to start without ye!
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ILBERD_000_070: Ah, . My scouts have been keeping a close eye on the black marketeer, and it would seem that his guests have arrived.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ILBERD_000_071: It would also seem that he has hired more than a few men to stand guard─common thugs of no consequence, but they nevertheless pose a threat.
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ILBERD_000_072: Even so, I feel compelled to apologize. This is far beneath a  of your standing, and Commander Leveilleur needn't have dispatched you hither...
TEXT_GAIUSE501_00363_ILBERD_000_073: But powerful men ever have need of loyal, able-bodied friends. Having found one in you, 'tis only natural that he would come to rely upon you without hesitation.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_SEQ_00: Ilberd is eager to bring the black marketeer and his clients to justice.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_SEQ_01: Ilberd states that the 1st Unit will establish a perimeter, preventing the clients' escape, while you and he seize the black marketeer and his weapons. Follow the captain to the Burning Wall and survey the area.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_SEQ_02: Although he spies only a single sentry, Ilberd concludes that there must be others in hiding. He bids you create a distraction while he and his men slip past into the tunnels where the black marketeer and his clients are meeting. Approach the lone sentry and strike up a friendly conversation.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_SEQ_03: The sentry is less than pleased with your presence, and he and his comrades attempt to summarily dispatch you. They do not succeed. Captain Ilberd and his men are nowhere to be seen, and so you have no choice but to wait outside the tunnel as instructed.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_SEQ_04: A sudden scream of agony rings out from within the tunnel. Proceed inside and seek out the source of the disturbance.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_SEQ_05: You find a flustered Ilberd standing over a man who lies motionless in a pool of his own blood. The captain explains that the black marketeer fought back with a hidden blade, and that one of his subordinates, fearing for his safety, slew the man. What is worse, a party of Duskwight sellswords believed to be the clients managed to slip past the 1st Unit, which is currently giving chase. As a final ignominy, it would seem that Riol's information was erroneous, and that the massive shipment of weapons consists of a single wooden crate...
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_TODO_02: Wait for Ilberd outside the tunnel entrance.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_000: Now then, we should make for the Burning Wall without delay and secure those weapons.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_002: The 1st Unit will ensure that the clients do not escape. With me, .
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_010: I spy the one man, but there are sure to be others...
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_012: I've a plan. While you approach the sentry and create a distraction, my men and I will slip past and catch the black marketeer unawares.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_013: Once you've disposed of the thugs, wait for us outside the tunnel entrance. Any questions? Then let us be off. Good luck, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_SENTRY00364_000_020: Who goes there!? An adventurer? Damned fool, you should have never come here!
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_BALLOON_100_021: Kill  and be done with it!
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_BALLOON_100_022: Worthless, all of you! This ends here!
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_BLACKMARKETEER00364: (-???-)I don't understand! Wh-What's this all about!?
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_040: As you can see, this is a fine mess.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_041: When I tried to restrain him, he drew a hidden blade and lashed out. But before I could disarm him, one of my subordinates panicked, and this is the result.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_042: How foolish of me to underestimate the bastard, and to bring an inexperienced recruit. Commander Leveilleur will be most disappointed.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_043: Damn it all! A golden opportunity, wasted!
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_044: As for the clients...though we know not how, they slipped past our perimeter. At present, the 1st is currently tracking a party of Duskwight sellswords we suspect may be them.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_045: Would that we could have enlisted the aid of the Immortal Flames or the Brass Blades. Alas, we're here to aid them─they're in no position to aid us.
TEXT_GAIUSE502_00364_ILBERD_000_046: Well, at the very least, we have secured the weapons. Yet even that accomplishment is lacking, for the information we received indicated a massive shipment, and this is anything but...
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_SEQ_00: Ilberd would like nothing more than to have this incident forgotten.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_SEQ_01: Ilberd wishes to join the 1st Unit in their pursuit of the Duskwight sellswords. However, the crate of weapons you and he have confiscated cannot simply be abandoned. He asks that you collect it and deliver it in his stead to Yuyuhase of the 3rd.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_SEQ_02: With remarkable ease, you secure the wooden crate filled with weapons. All that remains is to leave it in the care of Yuyuhase, who can be found on the Steps of Thal in Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_SEQ_03: You find Yuyuhase conversing with Alianne of the 4th Unit and her subordinate, Wilred, and place the crate of weapons at their feet. Although Alianne struggles to accept that the single crate is the entirety of the shipment, Yuyuhase dismisses the discrepancy as Riol's failure. After you part ways with the three Braves, Riol steps from the shadows and begs a private audience, though he does not explain why. Seek him out at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_SEQ_04: After listening to your account of events at the Burning Wall, Riol shakes his head in disbelief and insists that something is not right. He reiterates his claim that there should have been more weapons, crediting his experience deciphering financial transactions, as he once did for the Crystal Braves to ensure that no funds came from unsanctioned sources─though such precautions are no longer taken, it would seem. Apologizing for his outburst, he takes his leave, moments before Tataru summons you to Revenant's Toll via linkpearl. Return to the Rising Stones and speak with the receptionist.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_SEQ_05: Tataru thanks you for returning so quickly and states that a guest from Ishgard has requested your presence. Given the urgency of the receptionist's summons, it seems likely that the envoy has a dangerous task in mind.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_TODO_01: Deliver the confiscated crate to Yuyuhase in Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_TODO_03: Speak with Tataru in the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ILBERD_000_000: I will join the 1st in their hunt for the Duskwight sellswords. If the gods are good, we will catch them before they escape into the Black Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ILBERD_000_001: In the meantime, I ask that you deliver these weapons to Ul'dah in my stead.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ILBERD_000_002: Entrust them to the 3rd's Yuyuhase. He will take care of the rest.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ILBERD_000_004: Pray take the black marketeer's weapons in that crate and deliver them to Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ILBERD_000_005: Seek out Yuyuhase of the 3rd unit on the Steps of Thal and deliver the crate into his care.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ALIANNE_000_011: Rhesh wished for me to thank you for helping us to rescue her from Castrum Centri. How fortunate that we could meet again so soon!
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_WILRED_000_012: Did you hear, my friend? I've received my first official assignment as a full-fledged member of the Crystal Braves!
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_YUYUHASE_000_020: Ah, the Warrior of Light, ever-reliable friend to the Crystal Braves. You have my deepest thanks for your assistance in Coerthas. Now, what brings you to us this day?
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_YUYUHASE_000_021: A gift of weapons from a certain black marketeer, courtesy of Captain Ilberd, you say?
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_YUYUHASE_000_022: Understood. Once we've cataloged the contents, I'll have them delivered to the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ALIANNE_000_023: This cannot be everything, can it?
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ALIANNE_000_024: Riol stated with confidence that there would be a far greater quantity of weapons.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_YUYUHASE_000_025: A blatant falsehood. Clearly, Riol is unfamiliar with the ways of Ul'dahn merchants, who ever strive to present themselves as greater than they are.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_YUYUHASE_000_026: We should be thankful that his information was not completely erroneous, and that we managed to achieve anything of worth at all.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_WILRED_000_027: It's still something worth celebrating, isn't it, Lieutenant?
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_WILRED_000_028: Besides, we've got more important things to worry about─like fighting those Garleans up north!
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ALIANNE_000_029: There'll be no fighting if I have anything to say about it. Our orders are to stand watch, not to seek glory in battle.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_ALIANNE_100_030: If you have no further need of us, then I shall take my unit to the Ceruleum Processing Plant.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_YUYUHASE_000_031: Time for the 4th to earn their keep, eh? Fight well, Alianne─for the freedom of all!
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_YUYUHASE_000_032: Excellent work as always, my friend. Rest assured that the Immortal Flames will hear of your contribution. Until we meet again.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_033: . A word, if it please ye.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_034: Not here─look for me at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. No need for whistlin' this time, don't ye worry.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_051: Few places better than a market for privacy, I find. All the hustle an' the bustle o' commerce means most conversations go unnoticed.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_052: I'll get to the point: at the Burnin' Wall, when you an' the captain interrupted the exchange, what happened? Tell me everythin'─leave no detail out.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_053: Hmmm...that's not quite how the 1st told it.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_054: These Duskwights they were chasin'─latest word is that we lost the trail.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_055: But ye never saw 'em yerself? Not before the fightin' started, an' not after?
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_056: Somethin' ain't right. I don't know what it is, but I can feel it in me bones.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_057: I'm not daft enough to be misled by some merchant's drunken boasts. Our information was reliable, godsdammit! I know he purchased those weapons!
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_058: Hmph. As if I've never deciphered a moneylender's books, or had to follow a transaction back to its source...
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_059: Did plenty o' that back when the Braves were gettin' started, believe me. The commander wanted assurances that we weren't takin' gil from the wrong sort o' benefactors.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_060: 'Course these days the money flows like water, an' the 1st an' 3rd get the shiniest new toys...
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_RIOL_000_061: ...Forgive me, friend. I've a lot on me mind these days, an' I appreciate ye lendin' an ear. Right, then─best get back to it.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_TATARU_000_062: , can you hear me!? This is Tataru!
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_TATARU_000_063: Your presence is urgently requested at the Rising Stones! Please come and see me as soon as you are able!
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_TATARU_000_080: Thank you for coming so quickly, !
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_TATARU_000_081: We've a guest from Ishgard who wishes to speak with you─a most, um...determined lady, by all indications...
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_MINFILIA_000_090: Oh, ─we will be with you in a moment. Would you please wait outside with Tataru?
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_LUCIA_000_091: You look well, . We will have words when the Antecedent and I are finished.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_URIANGER_000_092: 'Tis poor form to assault a guest in one's home. Alas, Moenbryda hath ever struggled to observe proper decorum.
TEXT_GAIUSE503_00365_MOENBRYDA_000_093: So this is an Ishgardian knight, eh? She looks the part, I'll give her that─but I reckon I could hold my own.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_00: Tataru seems eager to escort you to the solar.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_01: Brooking no delay, Tataru bids you follow her to the solar to meet with the Antecedent, who is waiting for you with the Ishgardian envoy. Proceed within and speak with Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_02: Waiting for you in the solar is Lucia, Ser Aymeric's second-in-command, who has come on his behalf to request your assistance with a matter of grave import. The astrologians of the Observatorium have interpreted recent signs as an indication of Midgardsormr's imminent resurrection. Alas, the knights of Ishgard are in no position to dispatch forces to the Keeper of the Lake at present, and so Ser Aymeric would have you investigate the wreckage on their behalf and ascertain the veracity of the astrologians' claims. Before proceeding to the Keeper of the Lake, however, Minfilia advises you to speak with a Doman watch who has been stationed on the northern shore.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_03:
The Doman watch reports that forces from Castrum Centri have been scavenging materials from the wreckage, but that otherwise the distant monument has shown no signs of activity. Given the imperial presence, a stealthy approach will be necessary. Gather your allies and take the watch's boat to the base of the Agrius and survey the fallen airship from bottom to top.

※Challenge the Keeper of the Lake with other players via the Duty Finder, or with a party of NPCs via Duty Support. Both systems are accessible from the main menu as well as the dungeon's entrance point.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_04: The Ishgardian's worst fears have seemingly come to pass, as atop the wreckage of the Agrius you confront the fallen guardian of Silvertear Falls. With no choice but to fight, you engage the wyrm lord in battle, at last laying him to rest forever.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_05: As you turn to leave, the voice of Midgardsormr rings out once more, and you are invited to plead your case. Yet your words fall on deaf ears, and the wyrm lord flatly states that his children now sing of Ishgard's imminent destruction. Your fate sealed, he prepares to end your life─only to hesitate when Hydaelyn intervenes and marks you as one of Her chosen. Midgardsormr then relents─but not before somehow stripping you of the Mothercrystal's blessing. Revealing that a covenant binds him to you, the essence of the wyrm lord coalesces into a tiny vessel, and though it subsequently vanishes, you can yet feel his eyes upon your back...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_06: Before you can even begin to speak of your experiences, the Doman watch informs you that Alphinaud has summoned you to the Rising Stones. Return and seek out the young commander.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_07:
In private, you share your experiences with Minfilia, Alphinaud, and Urianger. Together, you conclude that it would be best to keep the majority of your conversation with Midgardsormr a secret, given Ishgardian attitudes towards consorting with Dravanians. Alphinaud leaves to speak with Lucia, and for a moment you are left alone with Minfilia, who observes that you are somehow changed. Having no choice, you reveal what you kept concealed from the others─that Midgardsormr took from you the blessing of Light. The Antecedent accepts your reassurances that everything is well...yet Midgardsormr's constant presence is a reminder of the opposite.

Unaware of your new burden, Lucia thanks you for besting Midgardsormr, and for bringing confirmation of the impending Dravanian attack. Though she has complete faith in her nation's capacity to defend itself, Alphinaud remains doubtful, and as the knight takes her leave he mutters quietly to himself, head bowed in thought.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SEQ_08: Despite his reservations, Alphinaud acknowledges that the Scions of the Seventh Dawn are in no position to intervene. Until such time as they choose to request aid, you and the others have no choice but to watch and wait.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TODO_01: Speak with the Doman watch in Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TODO_02: Enter the Keeper of the Lake.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TODO_03: Enter the Keeper of the Lake.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TODO_05: Speak with Alphinaud at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TATARU_000_000: Our guest is with the Antecedent in the solar at present.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TATARU_000_001: Let's not keep them waiting any longer. Shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_LUCIA_000_004: You look well, . We will have words when the Antecedent and I are finished.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_URIANGER_000_005: 'Tis poor form to assault a guest in one's home. Alas, Moenbryda hath ever struggled to observe proper decorum.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MOENBRYDA_000_006: So this is an Ishgardian knight, eh? She looks the part, I'll give her that─but I reckon I could hold my own.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TATARU_000_007: This is no time for idle chatter!
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_LUCIA_000_008: Good of you to join us. We have much to discuss.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_URIANGER_000_009: Unexpected tidings from the north, borne by the lord commander's second. What manner of wind bloweth this day...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MOENBRYDA_000_024: At this point, it would be more unnerving if he spoke plainly.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_010: Forgive me if I state aught which you already know, but I would ensure that you understand the nature of your destination.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_011: As Urianger stated, what we now call the Keeper of the Lake is the wreckage of the Agrius, former flagship of the imperial fleet, and the corpse of the wyrm responsible for its destruction.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_012: Fifteen years ago, as the next step in his campaign to subjugate Eorzea, Gaius van Baelsar attempted to seize control of Mor Dhona. So massive was his force that all thought his victory a foregone conclusion...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_013: But an unlikely ally came to Eorzea's aid that day─Midgardsormr, legendary guardian of Silvertear Falls, burst forth from beneath the waters of the lake and led a host of dragons against the Garlean airships overhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_014: In what would later become known as the Battle of Silvertear Skies, the great wyrm felled countless airships before engaging the Agrius.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_015: In the ensuing struggle, the flagship's ceruleum engines failed, and it tumbled into the lake below. Yet this victory came at a great cost, for the explosion which followed claimed the life of the great wyrm as well.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_016: That same explosion transformed Silvertear Falls into the desolate wasteland it is today, draining the lake of its waters and crystallizing aether for malms around.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_017: Yet a remnant of the lake remains, and at its center a constant reminder of that fateful day long ago...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_018: In accordance with Ser Aymeric's wishes, our Doman allies have been standing watch over the Keeper of the Lake. It would be wise to speak with them before investigating the wreckage yourself.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_019: Be careful, my friend. We know not what dangers await you within.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_100_019: Now then, let us not neglect our own tasks! There is much to be done, and precious little time to do it.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_020: Midgardsormr was once worshipped as the guardian deity of Silvertear Falls, yet there he has lain for fifteen years...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TATARU_000_021: Oh gods, if that charred monstrosity actually returned to life, I...I don't know what I would do.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_LUCIA_000_022: Before I depart, I must needs speak with the Antecedent in private. If you would be so kind.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_DOMANPEOPLE00366_00: You're in luck, . I was about to send word to Revenant's Toll about the Garleans.

Of late, I've seen small airships─likely from Castrum Centri─come and go from the Keeper of the Lake. Though I cannot say for certain at this distance, I believe they may be salvaging something from within the wreckage.
The castrum's supply lines have been cut for some time, and I'd wager they're desperately in need of spare parts and other equipment.
So it's true, then? The Ishgardians honestly fear that the wyrm might rise again?
Well, from here that seems rather unlikely...but if it's assurances they want, you've no choice but to inspect the corpse in its entirety.
Easier said than done, given the creatures which inhabit the wreckage─and the aforementioned Garleans who won't take kindly to your presence.

They're sure to fire upon an airship, so I'd advise a more stealthy approach. Take this boat and a few of your comrades to the base of the Agrius, then climb to the top. That's the only viable approach, I'd say.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_047: Garleans have taken an interest in the Keeper of the Lake? Then that is all the more reason we must investigate the wreckage.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TATARU_000_048: Do you think he would attack Revenant's Toll? Gah, just the thought of it is enough to give me nightmares!
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_LUCIA_000_049: Hm? Ser Aymeric bade me remain until your investigation is complete. Though, if Garleans are salvaging the Agrius, that may present a problem...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_DOMANPEOPLE00366_10: The boat is yours for the taking─though I wouldn't make the journey without a few friends at my side, as those Garleans won't hesitate to attack you.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_SYSTEM_100_050: You may summon Midgardsormr by selecting the corresponding entry within your Minion Guide under Character in the main menu.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_DOMANPEOPLE00366_00: I was beginning to fear the worst! Were those explosions I saw?
Ah, but you shouldn't waste time talking with me. Alphinaud left a message stating that you were to return to the Rising Stones at once.
He sounded awfully worried about you. Mayhap you should hurry back to Revenant's Toll?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_053: Welcome home, . Alphinaud was worried sick about you─why don't you go and set his mind at ease?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TATARU_000_054:
Twelve save me, is it coming!? What should we do!?
Oh...he's not?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_LUCIA_000_055: Have you spoken with Commander Leveilleur yet? He has been pacing again.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_URIANGER_000_056: Truth interpreted is truth transformed. Today's heroes may yet become tomorrow's gods...or something else.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Praise the Twelve that you are hale and whole!
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_061: I came as soon as Minfilia informed me of Ser Aymeric's request.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_062: You have completed your investigation of the Keeper of the Lake, I take it? Then I would hear your report.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_070: You...conversed with Midgardsormr? I swear, were anyone else to make such a claim, I would regard it with considerable skepticism.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_071: Are we to understand that the wyrm lord did not perish, and has in sooth lain dormant these past fifteen years?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_URIANGER_000_072: Less a resurrection and more a rejuvenation for he who dwelleth in eternity, years passing as moments...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Though his words were ambiguous at times, one statement left little room for interpretation:
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_074: “My people have heard the song. Ishgard shall burn.”
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Clearly, an attack is imminent. We must share this information with Ser Aymeric immediately.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_076: However, we dare not divulge your conversation with Midgardsormr in its entirety.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_077: To even acknowledge that you heard the voice of a Dravanian is a grave but necessary risk. Lest we forget, men have been executed as heretics for declaring as much.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_078: For your own protection, and for the sake of our tenuous relations with Ishgard, the truth cannot leave this room.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_079: As for how we shall present our revelation to Ser Aymeric's emissary, you may leave that to me. Pray remain here for now.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_080: Is there something you are not telling us, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_081: You seem...different, somehow. 'Tis almost as if you are missing something...something important.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_082: Twelve forfend! Midgardsormr stripped you of the blessing of Light!? Are you all right? How do you feel!?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_083: I see... It is a relief to hear that you are otherwise unharmed.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_084: It beggars belief that any being could possess the power to deprive you of Her blessing.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_085: Hmmm... Midgardsormr made mention of a covenant, did he not?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_086: One of the ancient myths regarding Silvertear Falls states that when the waters came into existence, so too did the great wyrm.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_087: Althyk and Nymeia, Brother Time and Sister Fate, decreed that Midgardsormr ever watch over the source, from which all water─and magic─was said to flow.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_088: I wonder... What if this was the covenant of which he spoke, and 'twas not the gods with whom he treated, but Hydaelyn Herself?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_089: Well, if he is watching over you as he claimed, mayhap you will have an opportunity to ask.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_090: Let us keep this matter to ourselves. I do not wish to burden our friends needlessly.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MIDGARDSORMR_000_09: Art thou a pawn, or master of thy fate?
What hast thou wrought by thine own hands, mortal?
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_120: Oh? I was not expecting you to return so soon. Surely you are not completely finished with your investigation, are you? Of course not. We shall speak again anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_LUCIA_000_121: Once you have set your affairs in order, I would be glad to hear your report.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_MINFILIA_000_100: Would that we could discern the nature of the covenant between Hydaelyn and Midgardsormr...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_TATARU_000_101: Thank you, , thank you! I shall sleep soundly knowing that that wyrm will trouble us no longer!
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_110: The Ishgardians have warred with the Dravanians for centuries─nay, nearly one thousand years.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_111: In all that time, not once have their enemies breached their defenses and entered the city proper.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_112: Yet regardless of how strong these magical wards may be, I nevertheless fear that the Ishgardians are underestimating the gravity of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_113: Though it was not Midgardsormr who roared, a call to arms by one of the first brood cannot be ignored...
TEXT_GAIUSE504_00366_ALPHINAUD_000_114: Until such time as they choose to request our aid, however, we can do naught but observe the situation at a distance, and pray that our fears are unfounded.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Edelstein wishes to share a report with you concerning the Garleans' movements.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_01: Lieutenant Edelstein informs you that imperial soldiers have been seen marching from Castrum Meridianum. The garrison leader would have you join the Crystal Braves in their efforts to repel the advancing Garleans. Speak with Lieutenant Alianne of the 4th Unit Braves, and lend your strength to her planned counteroffensive.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_02: Upon speaking with Alianne, you learn that another force of imperial soldiers has been spotted attempting to conceal themselves along the west approach to the processing plant. Before the lieutenant can outline her strategy, however, Captain Ilberd arrives, and drafts you into assisting the 3rd Unit Braves as they set out to engage this second threat. Speak with Yuyuhase at Raubahn's Push for further instructions.
