TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_03: Yuyuhase welcomes your arrival, and explains his plan to uproot the Garlean raiders from their places of concealment. Search your assigned areas, and eliminate any imperial soldiers you encounter.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_04: You have discovered and defeated an imperial squad. Move on to the next location, and engage any remaining Garlean soldiers.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_05: You have defeated the remaining imperial troops. Return to Yuyuhase at Raubahn's Push and report your success.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_06: You rejoin Yuyuhase, and he speaks of similar victories in the field. The Lalafellin Brave offers to share news of the Garleans' demise with Alianne, and asks that you do the same for Lieutenant Edelstein. Return to the Ceruleum Processing Plant and make your report to the garrison leader.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_SEQ_07: You make your report to a relieved Lieutenant Edelstein, who once more thanks you for your deeds. With the Garlean threat neutralized, it would appear the processing plant has been delivered from potential disaster.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_000: We've been keeping a close eye on that Garlean garrison, and 'twould seem the imperials have finally begun to mobilize.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_001: According to the reconnaissance report that just came in, the squads seen leaving the castrum are too few in number to effectively take and hold our position. They will likely mount a swift assault, and focus on the acquisition of resources.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_002: I have, of course, also shared this report with the Crystal Braves─they've decided to take to the field to meet this assault head-on. I have apprised your fellow Scions of the situation, and am heartened to know that they will be joining the effort.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_003: Pray report to Lieutenant Alianne, and lend your much-welcome strength to the counteroffensive.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_004: The Crystal Braves are preparing to meet the Garleans in the field. Speak with Lieutenant Alianne, and she will apprise you of your role in the coming battle.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_WILRED_000_005: R-Right, then. Time to see if all this training has paid off! Rhalgr, guide my blade...
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_PAPALYMO_000_006: Considering the weapon she wields, I don't believe the lady is in need of additional protection...
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_THANCRED_000_007: Be it a squad of soldiers or some magitek monstrosity, I shall allow no foe to harm the lovely Moenbryda.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YDA_000_008: Have you ever seen Moen swing her axe? Swipe! Slice! Cleave! There's really no stopping her!
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YSHTOLA_000_009: Now that is an impressive piece of steel.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_MOENBRYDA_000_010: Isn't it a beauty? A lady merchant in Revenant's Toll simply gave it to me! Said she was “investing in the future,” or some such.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ALIANNE_000_011: I've been waiting for the chance to even the score with these imperial invaders...
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ALIANNE_000_020: Glad to have you with us, . As I'm sure Lieutenant Edelstein has explained, the Garleans have deployed a small force from Castrum Meridianum.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_WILRED_000_021: Their main column assembles to the north near Dalamud's Talons, but we've also spied several squads attempting to conceal themselves on the approach to the west.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ILBERD_000_023: They wish you to rush forth and commit to battle with the main column, leaving the detached force free to raid the plant and pillage supplies. Not much of a strategy, but these are desperate men.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ILBERD_000_025: Greetings, Scion. I understand the commander bid you and your fellows come lend a hand to the Braves. With such mighty heroes at its disposal, the 4th should have little trouble contending with aught the Garleans might throw at them.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ILBERD_000_026: But even you cannot be everywhere at once. The 3rd was getting restless holed up in Ul'dah, so I marched them out here to fill any holes in the plant's defenses and add their numbers to your counterattack.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ALIANNE_000_027: The reinforcements are welcome. We've enough soldiers now to divide our own forces and safely engage the enemy far beyond the walls.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ILBERD_000_028: Aye, 'twould be best to avoid staging a battle anywhere near this much ceruleum. Let's take this fight to the Garleans.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_PAPALYMO_000_029: A wise course, indeed. I shudder to think of the consequences should any of these storage tanks be exposed to fire...
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_PAPALYMO_100_029: If there are no objections, the Scions shall join the 4th and give battle to this main column.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ILBERD_000_030: You're with the 3rd, then, Warrior of Light. Your job will be to intercept these squads hiding out in the west and prevent them from reaching the processing plant.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_ILBERD_000_031: When you're ready to proceed, report to Lieutenant Yuyuhase─his scouts should have a rough idea of where the imperials have concealed themselves by now.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_032: The 3rd have been given the task of hunting down the enemy squads lurking to the west. Pray hurry to their staging point if you mean to join them.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_050: A pleasure to be fighting at your side once more, Scion. Our operations invariably succeed when you're around, and victories are wont to pave the road to greater coin.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_051: Now, this detached force we've been sent to eliminate has split into smaller squads─the better to conceal themselves within the terrain hereabouts, I imagine. We'll need to split ourselves up as well to cover more ground, and make sure we root out all these would-be raiders.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_052: And seeing as you're an army unto yourself, I've assigned you your own areas to scour clean of enemy soldiers. Aye, this will be a simple search and destroy.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_053: We'll rendezvous back here when the task is done. Happy hunting, Scion.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_060: You seem grim, Scion. I'll take that to mean that, between us, more than a few Garleans won't be making it back to the castrum.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_061: These imperials, though, they certainly made us earn our pay. I would be a happy man if I never had to tussle with another of those magitek horrors...
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_062: It is time we bid this war-torn land farewell. I will contact the 4th, and let Lieutenant Alianne know the west is now clear.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_YUYUHASE_000_063: I would appreciate it if you would do the same when you report to Lieutenant Edelstein.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_071: Their raiding parties are no more, then? Excellent.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_EDELSTEIN_000_072: The Amajina engineers will be most relieved to hear that the plant is no longer in any immediate danger. Thank you again for your assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE506_00368_BALLOON_000_081:
Our position is compromised!
To arms!
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_SEQ_00: Lieutenant Edelstein appears concerned for Moenbryda's well-being.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_SEQ_01: With the battle against Castrum Meridianum's soldiers concluded, Moenbryda is now free to conduct her experiments in the field. Find the scholar at Dalamud's Talons, and see how her research progresses.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_SEQ_02: After witnessing Moenbryda perform a successful trial upon a corrupted crystal formation, you are visited by an Ascian who introduces himself as Nabriales. The Paragon soon senses that you have lost Hydaelyn's blessing and teleports away, seemingly intent on taking advantage of the Scions' vulnerability. Moenbryda realizes that the staff Nabriales spoke of is likely Tupsimati, the relic once wielded by Louisoix himself. Hurry back to the Rising Stones and protect Minfilia from the Ascian's intrusion.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_SEQ_03:
You return to the Rising Stones to find Nabriales already in the solar with Minfilia, the Antecedent clutching the shards of the broken Tupsimati. With dismissive contempt, the Ascian reveals his plans to use the power yet hidden within the staff to bring about a new Rejoining. He then tears open a dimensional rift, through which he escapes with both Minfilia and the relic she holds. Follow Nabriales into the rift, and put a stop to his nefarious plans.

※The Chrysalis can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_SEQ_04: You have defeated Nabriales and rescued Minfilia. Return to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_SEQ_05:
Upon your return to the Rising Stones, you are once more visited by Nabriales, who taunts you with his immortality. Before he can flee into the void, however, Minfilia succeeds in trapping the soul of the weakened Ascian within the chunk of white auracite. But try though you might, without Hydaelyn's blessing, you are unable to summon enough aether to truly destroy him. As she witnesses Light struggle to triumph over Dark, Moenbryda finally comes to understand her mentor Louisoix's dedication to his duty. The wounded scholar then expends her own life energy in a brilliant burst of aether, allowing your glowing blade to at last pierce Nabriales's essence.

A step too late, the rest of the Scions enter the solar to be greeted by the tragic news of Moenbryda's sacrifice. Somewhat comforted by the knowledge that his dear friend was, at the last, liberated from doubt and confusion, Urianger departs to grieve at the Waking Sands. Speak with the Antecedent to discuss the aftermath of the battle.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_SEQ_06: Though assailed by her own grief, Minfilia yet worries more for Urianger and the loss he must be feeling. The Antecedent then voices her intention to hold a memorial service for the Scions' fallen friend, and honor all that Moenbryda has accomplished.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_EDELSTEIN_000_000: You must be anxious for word of your fellows. Lieutenant Alianne has reported a sound victory over the main column, and informs me that the Scions have already turned their attention to other duties.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_EDELSTEIN_000_001: All but one, that is. The Roegadyn lady with the large axe? 'Twould appear she has chosen to remain at the site of the battle.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_EDELSTEIN_000_002: I know not what task keeps her from returning to civilization, but northern Thanalan is no place to wander alone─even for a capable sort such as her. I would certainly feel better about things if you could check in on her before you continue on your way.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_EDELSTEIN_000_003: I believe the lady's name was “Moenbryda,” yes? She was last seen inspecting an outcrop of corrupted crystals at Dalamud's Talons to the east.
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_MOENBRYDA_000_010: If I'm right, and the Ascian is after Tupsimati, then we'd best make all haste back to the Rising Stones! Minfilia must be warned!
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_WANDERINGMINSTREL_0: What evil is afoot that my breast should flutter so with unnamed dread?
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_ALYS_000_012: Oh, ! I heard quite a loud bang from inside the Stones not moments ago. Is everything all right?
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_MOENBRYDA_000_021: Master Louisoix's staff is kept in the solar, isn't it? Quickly, now!
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_YDA_000_040: Oh, Moen... I miss you so much already...
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_PAPALYMO_000_041: She was counting on the theory that a soul's aether burns brightest at the moment of its passing. A scholar until the very end...
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_THANCRED_000_042:
Would we had arrived a few moments sooner...
Just a few moments...
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_YSHTOLA_000_043: Our list of grievances against the Ascians was already overlong. Must they continue to add to it?
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_MINFILIA_000_050: Never have I seen Urianger so utterly defeated. No one should be made to suffer such grief...
TEXT_GAIUSE507_00369_MINFILIA_000_051: We shall gather in the Sharlayan manner to celebrate Moenbryda's life...and mourn her passing.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_SEQ_00: Minfilia has a request to make of you.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_SEQ_01: Minfilia expresses concern over Yda's emotional state following the loss of Moenbryda. Seek out the melancholy pugilist at the Rising Stones, and see if there is anything you can do to lighten her burden.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_SEQ_02: Yda explains how Moenbryda would disapprove of her gloominess, and outlines a plan to cheer herself up. You learn that she has ordered a rare flower in memory of her friend, which is currently awaiting collection at Rowena's store. Unfortunately, it would seem Yda finds the merchant rather trying, and is therefore reluctant to pay for the goods in person. Head to the store in your fellow Scion's stead, and use the purse provided to purchase the moon daisy.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_SEQ_03: You have collected the moon daisy─as well as a flurry of unsolicited advice─from Rowena. Take the flower to the mark of the Scholar at Rathefrost, and hand it to the waiting Yda.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_SEQ_04: As Yda places the moon daisy before the mark of the Scholar, the skies over Rathefrost are suddenly darkened by the passing of Dravanian wings. Moments later, you are contacted by an audibly anxious Alphinaud, who bids you return to Revenant's Toll at once. Hasten back to the Rising Stones and speak further with the young commander.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_SEQ_05: Upon returning to the Rising Stones, you are informed that events are coming to a head in Ishgard, and that an envoy from the Holy See is already en route to the Scions' headquarters, bearing an urgent report...
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_TODO_01: Hand over the flower payment to Rowena.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_TODO_02: Deliver the moon daisy to Yda at Rathefrost.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_TODO_03: Speak with Alphinaud at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_MINFILIA_000_000: Have you a moment, ? I believe Yda wished a word with you.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_MINFILIA_000_001: I should consider it a personal favor if you would lend a sympathetic ear to her troubles.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_MINFILIA_000_002: She has not been herself since Moenbryda's passing, and my heart aches to see her so downcast...
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_MINFILIA_000_003: Yda should be somewhere within the Rising Stones. Pray lend her a sympathetic ear, my friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_011: ...Oh, it's no use. I'm trying to stay positive, but... <sigh> It's just hard, you know...?
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_012: The thing is, I know Moen would tell me off if she saw me moping around like this...
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_013: ...Which is why I decided to cheer myself up by getting her a special flower.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_014: I placed an order for a moon daisy with Rowena a little while ago, and it's ready to be picked up.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_015: The trouble is...I find Rowena a bit difficult at the best of times, and...well, this isn't one of them. I know it's silly, but I just can't face it at the moment. So, I was wondering...do you think you could maybe collect it for me? I have the coin to pay for the flower right here.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_016: Thank you so much! I'll be waiting for you─and the daisy─at Rathefrost!
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_ROWENA_000_030: What can I do for you today, adventurer? Eldritch trinket to trade?
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_ROWENA_000_031: ...Eh? They've got you runnin' errands now? <snort> Them Scions really know how to make the most o' your talents, don't they? Sendin' the savior of Eorzea to the bleedin' market... Fine use o' your time, that is!
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_ROWENA_000_032: Seriously, though─you'd best learn how to say no, or they'll have you muckin' out the chocobo stables next.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_ROWENA_000_033: Anyway, what was it you were here to pick up? The moon daisy, was it? Here, then─take it. And tell that Yda lass I've got a wide selection o' headwear in stock if she ever decides to replace that dowdy ol' mask o' hers. Gods know, she needs to...
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_040: Ugh, Rowena can be so annoying! She just will not take no for an answer. Every time I visit her, she insists I replace my visor with something more “fashionable.” And when I tell her I like it just fine the way it is, she says it again. And then again. And then AGAIN! It drives me crazy!
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_041: Uh, what I mean to say is, I really appreciate you doing this for me. So anyway...let's see it!
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_042: <sigh> Moenbryda loved these things, you know... I hope that somewhere, somehow, she knows I'm still thinking of her...
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_YDA_000_043: Thanks again, . I think... I think I'm going to be all right.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_PAPALYMO_000_044:
Yda seems to have regained a little of her spark.
...And I believe we have you to thank for that. I am most grateful, . Truly.
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_ALPHINAUD_000_050: My apologies for the interruption... I was deeply saddened to learn of Moenbryda's passing. Her loss will be sorely felt...
TEXT_GAIUSE601_00370_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Alas, recent developments in Ishgard leave us little time to mourn. The envoy from Coerthas will soon arrive, and we must hasten to hear her report.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_SEQ_00: Alphinaud awaits the arrival of the Ishgardian envoy.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_SEQ_01: The envoy from Ishgard turns out to be Lucia, Ser Aymeric's second-in-command. The knight brings grim tidings, and has come to seek the aid of the Crystal Braves and the Grand Companies in bolstering her city's defenses. She also bears a personal request from the lord commander, who wishes to speak with you. Travel to Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands, and rendezvous with Alphinaud prior to meeting with Ser Aymeric.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_SEQ_02: You join Alphinaud in Camp Dragonhead, but it appears that Ser Aymeric has yet to arrive. As you wait together, the Crystal Braves' commander notes the unusually agitated mood in the camp─Dravanian invasion or no─and suggests that further investigation might be in order. Make your way to the Gates of Judgement, and question the unsettled knights.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_SEQ_03: You learn from the knights stationed at the Gates of Judgement that they were attacked by Lady Iceheart and her followers. Inform Alphinaud of this development.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_SEQ_04: Shortly after apprising Alphinaud of your discovery, you are accosted by Lucia, who confirms that which you have already learned: a heretic force has broken through the outer defenses and dispelled the first layer of arcane wards protecting the city of Ishgard. Now is not the time to debate the ramifications of this event, however, as Ser Aymeric is waiting for you back in Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_TODO_00: Speak with Alphinaud in Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_TODO_01: Question the knights at the Gates of Judgement.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_TODO_02: Speak with Alphinaud at the Gates of Judgement.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_001: I thank you for receiving me at such short notice. Time is of the essence, so I would forgo the usual pleasantries, if I may.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_MINFILIA_000_002: Certainly. You come with news of the Dravanians?
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_003: Aye, the dragons have begun their attack in earnest. The first wave reached the central highlands a short while ago, and battle was joined soon thereafter.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_004: Ser Aymeric himself sallied forth with a contingent of Temple Knights and several companies of the noble houses' finest. Though the beasts were ultimately forced into retreat, our victory─if such it may be called─came at the cost of many of our own. Too many.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_005: We will not withstand a second wave should the Dravanians renew their assault.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_006: You paint a grim picture, my lady. It is reinforcements you seek, then?
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_007: We do. Though it pricks our pride, it is plain we cannot protect Ishgard with our ranks thus thinned by the Horde. Ser Aymeric would meet with you to discuss the possibility of enlisting your aid.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Very well. I shall depart for Coerthas at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_009: I must warn you, however, that the involvement of the Crystal Braves is by no means assured─our commitment to quelling the unrest in Ul'dah must take precedence.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_010: It is with such contingencies in mind that I must make another request. The Scions of the Seventh Dawn are known for sharing close ties with all three of the Grand Companies of Eorzea. Would you consent to plead our case to their leaders?
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_MINFILIA_000_011: Hm. Though I will gladly appeal to the Grand Companies on your behalf, I dare not promise a favorable reply...
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_012: You need say no more. Considering our past dealings with the Eorzean Alliance, I can well imagine how our plea will be received.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_013: But the fate of Ishgard hangs in the balance. We must explore every avenue still open to us─no matter how unpromising.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_MINFILIA_000_014: I see. Very well. I shall send envoys to each of the allied nations, and have them present your request directly to the heads of the Grand Companies.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_MINFILIA_000_015: In the event that your plea does receive a favorable answer, know that any support is certain to be conditional. Demands will be made of Ishgard...
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_016: That is only to be expected. Rest assured that I speak with Ser Aymeric's authority in this matter, and that our actions are fully sanctioned by the Holy See.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_017: ...Which brings me to my final request: a personal appeal to you, Warrior of Light. The lord commander much desires to speak with you, regardless of your fellows' involvement.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_018: You faced Midgardsormr and survived. Anything you can share of your experience may yield us an advantage over our foe.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_019: Thank you. You wear the mantle of hero well.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_020: 'Twould seem the road leads us both to Camp Dragonhead. Seek me out when you arrive, .
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_040: It seems I was the swifter, . You too, however, have arrived with time to spare, for our host has yet to make an appearance.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_041:
The murmurings about camp tell of some manner of trouble at the Gates of Judgement...
In the lord commander's absence, I suggest we visit the place, and find out what is afoot.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_HAURCHEFANT_000_042: My dear friend, ! Once more you arrive in our hour of need! Would that we could speak longer, but I'm afraid my duties demand my full attention...
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_YAELLE_100_042: We knights of House Fortemps train nigh without cease for moments such as this. Yet now that one is here, my knees threaten to buckle beneath me...
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_TEMPLERA00371_000_0: W-We need not fret overmuch─there are yet several layers of arcane protection that shield the city from invasion. Mother will be fine...
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_TEMPLERB00371_000_0: When I laid eyes upon Lady Iceheart...I felt the marrow freeze within my bones.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_CAVALRYMANA00371_00: The Gates of Judgement are much more than mere doors─they are the outermost layer of Ishgard's magical wards. If our first line of defense can be so easily shattered...
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_CAVALRYMANB00371_00: Heretic scum! How dare they meddle with our divine protections! I shall rid our nation of their blasphemy even if it means cutting them down one by one!
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_050:
Mark the nervous glances our friends share...
The dragons have attacked, yes, but something else has occurred...something unexpected. Let us question the knights here ere we proceed.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_060: 'Twould seem the heretics struck the first─and most telling─blow against Ishgard...
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_061: Scions! We expected you at Camp Dragonhead!
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_ALPHINAUD_000_062: My apologies. We chanced to hear that there had been trouble at the gates, and thought it prudent to investigate the cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_063: Then you have learned of the heretics' treachery. Lady Iceheart led a force of her followers against our defenders, and came close enough to dispel the first of our wards.
TEXT_GAIUSE602_00371_LUCIA_000_064: But let us speak more of this back at the camp. Ser Aymeric awaits you...
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_SEQ_00: Alphinaud seems eager to return to Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_SEQ_01: Eager to begin his meeting with Ser Aymeric, Alphinaud puts the Gates of Judgement behind him. Return to Camp Dragonhead and ask Lord Haurchefant where the audience is to be held.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_SEQ_02: After welcoming you with his customary warmth, Lord Haurchefant informs you that Ser Aymeric awaits within the nearby intercessory. Speak with the House Fortemps guard to gain entry to the audience chamber, and announce your arrival to the lord commander.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_SEQ_03:
Shortly after greeting Ser Aymeric in the intercessory, you are joined by Estinien, the Azure Dragoon. Owing to his prolonged contact with the Eye, Estinien is able to hear Nidhogg's “voice,” and confirms that the roar that recently shook the heavens was the vengeful wyrm's call to battle. It would appear that Iceheart, if not directly in league with the creature, at least shares Nidhogg's desire to invade the city and lay claim to the Eye.

Swayed by Ser Aymeric's grim prediction of a desolate Coerthas providing a new staging point for the Empire, Alphinaud agrees to aid the beleaguered lord commander. Speak with the young Scion and hear his thoughts concerning the Ishgardians' request.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_SEQ_04: The Dravanians converge upon the city of Ishgard in their thousands, and there is no guarantee that her defenders will be able to repel them─even with outside assistance. Nevertheless, Alphinaud seems grateful for this opportunity to bring the nations of Eorzea together as allies once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_TODO_01: Speak with Aymeric in the intercessory.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_000: ...Lady Iceheart has grown bold indeed if she would risk direct action against the city. Come, let us do as we were bid, and return to Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Lord Haurchefant will know where Ser Aymeric means to receive us.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Pray ask Lord Haurchefant to direct us to the meeting place when you are ready.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_HAURCHEFANT_000_010: 'Tis reassuring indeed to behold the countenance of a friend when one's homeland teeters upon the very brink of disaster!
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_HAURCHEFANT_000_011: Though a single misstep could send us plunging into the abyss, your heroic presence stokes the flames of courage within my heart!
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_HAURCHEFANT_000_012: Ah, but you did not come to Dragonhead to listen to my prattling! The lord commander has arrived, and would treat with you in the intercessory.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_HAURCHEFANT_000_013: Ser Aymeric is now arrived in Camp Dragonhead. Pray make your way to the intercessory!
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_014:
Ishgard's future hangs in the balance. If the city's salvation rests on our assistance, I cannot well withhold it. Even so, I mean to make Ser Aymeric sweat for his reinforcements. On this occasion, feigned disinterest may serve the cause of Eorzean unity better than naked philanthropy.
Come! Let us find out what concessions the Holy See is willing to make...
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_FORTEMPSGUARD00054_: Greetings, . Shall I show you inside?
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_050: I thank you for coming with such haste...and apologize for my absence. Suffice it to say, Lady Iceheart and her heretics have much to answer for...
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Yes...we are but recently returned from the Gates of Judgement ourselves. Given the circumstances, we quite understand if you would prefer to postpone our appointed audience.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_052: On the contrary, Master Alphinaud─I think it more important than ever that this meeting take place. Rest assured, I shall return to my post on Ishgard's walls the moment our business is concluded.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_053: Before we move on to the subject of reinforcements, however, I would introduce you to a close friend and stalwart ally. Estinien!
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_054: May I present to you Ishgard's Azure Dragoon.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_055: An impressive title...though I confess, I know precious little of the order of dragoons.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_056: They are formidable warriors all. Yet even among such masters of the lance, Estinien is without equal.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_057: He, out of all the warriors of Ishgard, was chosen to wield the power of dragons, and may thus contend with any Dravanian.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_059: If ever I was without equal, I am no longer─as my fellow Azure Dragoon here will attest. Be at ease, ─I did not come to challenge you this day.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_060:
Ah, it is you...
But of course...it is only fitting that fate should draw the two of us together.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_061:
So, you are the adventurer of whom they spoke...
I see now why my blood fair sang in anticipation of our meeting.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_062: ...Well, now that we have all been introduced, let us proceed to the matter at hand. I would share with you what we have learned of Iceheart's design, as confessed by the heretics taken captive after the assault on the gates.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_063: 'Twould seem that Lady Iceheart and the Dravanians share a common goal─the reclamation of Nidhogg's stolen eye.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_064:
Nidhogg...
One of the seven great wyrms.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_065: His name features prominently in your nation's history. Though once defeated by the hero Haldrath, the beast is said to have terrorized Coerthas since Ishgard's founding.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_066: Aye, many are the scars our walls bear from Nidhogg's relentless efforts to raze the city.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_067: The trophy Haldrath plucked from the bested wyrm's skull─known simply as “the Eye”─is a treasured relic of Ishgard, and one possessed of untold power.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_068: Should it ever be returned to Nidhogg, the dread creature would be restored to the height of his strength. ...And then no wall or ward we could erect would be stout enough to deny him.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_MIDGARDSORMR_000_06: (-Voice of Midgardsormr-)My vengeful son hath waged war against Ishgard for a thousand years. No mortal mind could comprehend the depths of his rancor.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_070: The Eye itself is secreted deep within the Vault. It is kept under heavy guard─surrounded at all times by men and women who have proven their loyalty to the Holy See.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_071: But though stout walls and sharp blades may suffice to discourage the heretics, the dragons are another matter. There are individuals within the Dravanian Horde whom an entire company of knights would labor to repel─to say nothing of Nidhogg himself.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_072: Nor does age rob them of their strength. Through the endless march of years, the dragons endure. Patient. Calculating. Inexorable. You must understand: these creatures do not share our perception of time.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_073: And that is especially true of the great wyrms─they who spend centuries in slumber only to wake and resume their campaign as if mere hours had passed.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_074: It has been twenty years since Nidhogg last darkened our skies. Twenty years for him to gather his strength, and for us to bolster our defenses... And now, just as he seems primed to return, the heretics strike at the gates...
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_075: ...You believe that Lady Iceheart is in league with the creature, then?
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_076: Of that, we cannot be certain. Though we know the heretics covet the Eye, we have been unable to determine their plans for it.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_078: Such questions aside, we must needs address the ragged hole their mistress has seen fit to rend in Ishgard's protections. 'Tis a weakness the Dravanians are not like to leave untested.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_079: So it would seem... You have described your plight in admirable detail, Lord Commander. Yet I cannot help but wonder at your candor. Why share such sensitive information with us?
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_080: I shall speak plain. Ishgard has need of allies, and I would have you bolster our front lines in readiness for the coming battle against the dragons.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_081: This much I expected. Unlike our arrangement concerning the Keeper of the Lake, however, only you stand to benefit from our assistance in this matter. I fail to see why we should intervene in a conflict which concerns only Ishgard and Dravania.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_082: When the Eorzean Alliance requested Ishgard's assistance during Operation Archon, you refused us.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_083: Does it not seem grossly unjust to demand that we now risk our lives in your private war?
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_084: I make no attempt to defend my country's conduct. I only ask that you consider what would follow were Ishgard to fall.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_085: Having razed our city to the ground, the Horde would have little cause to linger, and most would return to their lairs in Dravania. Soon thereafter, the ruins of Coerthas would be buried in snow, and the land would become the sole province of beasts and beastmen.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_086: ...Until the Garleans' arrival, that is─for you may be certain that the Empire would not hesitate to claim Coerthas. They would not even have to draw steel.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_087: An imperial province sharing a border with Mor Dhona...? Seven hells...
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_088: ...Ahem. Very well─we will assist you in repelling the dragons. The roar of a great wyrm may have shaken the firmament, but we of Eorzea will not abandon our Ishgardian brothers to face the coming Horde alone.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_AYMERIC_000_089: Nor did I ever think you would. Now, upon the matter of the roar─
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_090: Through the power of the Eye, I have become the vessel of Nidhogg's strength. His essence has stolen into my very blood.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_091: Fear not─I am in full control of my faculties, I assure you. And the Eye itself is of no relevance to this tale─it is not essential that I bear it with me wheresoever I go.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_092: Its lingering influence does, however, allow me to hear Nidhogg's voice...
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_094: ...Was Nidhogg, aye. He means to hurl his Horde against Daniffen's Collar, and shatter the remaining wards that protect the city.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ESTINIEN_000_095: There can be no doubt─the wyrm has summoned his minions to war.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Though the circumstances are far from ideal, this desperate endeavor will at least provide us an opportunity to bring the sister states of Eorzea together in common cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_111: ...Ser Aymeric was more ruthless in his negotiations than I had anticipated. I suppose one must give no quarter when one's home is at stake.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_112: But did you see the look on his face when he formally requested our assistance? Though the lord commander has long campaigned for Ishgard to open its gates to outsiders, I suspect this softening of the Holy See's attitude towards foreign cooperation comes as something of a bittersweet victory.
TEXT_GAIUSE603_00372_ALPHINAUD_000_113: The days ahead promise to be interesting indeed...
TEXT_GAIUSE604_00373_SEQ_00: Alphinaud is ready to begin making preparations for war.
TEXT_GAIUSE604_00373_SEQ_01: Though resolved to aid Ishgard in her hour of need, Alphinaud thinks it wise to report back to the Antecedent before preparing for war. Return to the Rising Stones and speak with Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE604_00373_SEQ_02: Along with the Crystal Braves, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have committed themselves to the defense of Ishgard. As your companions depart the chamber with singular purpose, however, it appears that Riol is more concerned by the private words passing between Ilberd and Yuyuhase...
TEXT_GAIUSE604_00373_TODO_00: Speak with Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE604_00373_ALPHINAUD_000_000: If we are to aid the Ishgardians in this war of theirs, preparations will have to be made, and soon.
TEXT_GAIUSE604_00373_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Before proceeding, however, we must needs return to the Rising Stones and make our report to the Antecedent.
TEXT_GAIUSE604_00373_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Ere we sally forth in the defense of Ishgard, we must needs consult with the Antecedent. Come, let us return to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SEQ_00: Minfilia would have you assist with the preparations being made for the defense of Ishgard.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SEQ_01: Hoping to rally support for Ishgard, Minfilia has once more dispatched your comrades to every corner of the realm. The tasks she has in mind for you, however, will keep you close to Revenant's Toll. In addition to recruiting volunteers from among the adventuring population, the Antecedent wishes you to consult with Slafborn regarding the town's state of readiness. Speak first with Tataru, and invite the receptionist to join you and the Adventurers' Guild representative in discussing the troubles that might spill over the border from the conflict in Coerthas.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SEQ_02: You explain Minfilia's request to Tataru, who immediately begins to plan for every possible eventuality. Follow in the enterprising young receptionist's wake, and join her in consulting with Slafborn.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SEQ_03: Though Slafborn readily acknowledges the importance of elevating the Toll's state of readiness, he is unwilling to make any formal commitment to assist in the coming conflict. Consult with Tataru regarding the possibility of approaching adventurers directly.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SEQ_04: Tataru seems more than happy to recruit volunteers face-to-face. Speak with the adventurers in Revenant's Toll and attempt to rally them to Ishgard's cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SEQ_05: You have approached a number of adventurers, and been greeted with responses ranging from cautious interest to barely concealed hostility. After being rebuffed by a particularly reluctant Roegadyn, you are suddenly pulled aside by Riol, who proceeds to explain the suspicious circumstances surrounding the disappearance of Wilred, the youth from Little Ala Mhigo. With battle looming on the horizon, however, there is little time for you to delve into this latest mystery. Return to Tataru and inform her of the results of your recruiting efforts.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SEQ_06: You compare notes with Tataru, and are pleased to find that her recruitment efforts have met with similar results. Should those who expressed an interest be true to their word, the forces of Ishgard will soon be bolstered by a small-but-experienced contingent of adventurers...
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TODO_01: Speak with Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_MINFILIA_000_000: I have bid the Archons travel to their assigned nations.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_MINFILIA_000_001: Should the members of the Alliance agree to pledge Grand Company soldiers to Ishgard's cause, our comrades will be on hand to act as intermediaries for the duration of the conflict.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_MINFILIA_000_002: ...The small matter of persuading the Alliance leaders to grant such support I leave to Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_MINFILIA_000_003: For you, my friend, a different task awaits: I would have you reach out to your fellow adventurers, and gather what allies you may for the coming siege.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_MINFILIA_000_004: I would also have you consider the matter of our own security. Revenant's Toll is but a short flight from the snowfields of Coerthas─it is not unimaginable that the fighting may spill across the border.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_MINFILIA_000_005: Pray brief Slafborn on the brewing conflict, and discuss potential contingencies. The frontier settlers must be prepared for aught that might wing its way over our walls.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_MINFILIA_000_006:
I only hope that such precautions prove unnecessary...
Ah, before you leave─might I suggest that you have Tataru accompany you? She has a talent for administration, and a firm grasp of the practical challenges we may encounter.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_020: Hmm... We are rather close to Coerthas, aren't we? We'd best see to our own defenses and take stock of our supplies.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_021: Oh, and we'll also need to have beds and bandages laid out just in case.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_022: A good receptionist is ready for any eventuality! Let's go, ─I've a hundred and one things to discuss with Slafborn!
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_023: ...And so I'd like you to spread the word to the settlers and adventurers in town.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SLAFBORN_000_030: I appreciate the warning. If war is coming to Coerthas, then the Toll must be made ready.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SLAFBORN_000_031: I'll increase the number of patrols and lookouts immediately. I'll also see about finding room for an infirmary, as well as temporary housing for victims of the conflict. Ishgard has done well by us in the past and I would return the favor.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SLAFBORN_000_032: But as for rounding up volunteers for the fighting itself, I'm afraid I must disappoint you. I will not send my fellow guild members to die on Ishgardian soil, and I am certain headquarters will say the same.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SLAFBORN_000_033: There will be no official Adventurers' Guild presence at this siege. That said...each adventurer is of course free to do as he or she will.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SLAFBORN_000_034: ...I shall have a word with some of my more capable colleagues on your behalf, and you might try your luck here in Revenant's Toll. I daresay there are a few stout souls about town who will answer your call to arms.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_SLAFBORN_000_035: I'll see if I can't persuade a few friends to join the cause. While I do that, why not try asking around for volunteers here in the Toll? I daresay you'll find a few who are willing to help. But do make sure they're up to the task, will you? You want to fight the dragons, not feed them.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_040: Let's get started, shall we? We have a town to rouse!
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_041: Attention, adventurers! Ishgard is in peril and has need of heroes! If you've ever dreamed of battling a Dravanian, then now is your chance!
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERA00391_00: If ye know of any payin' work, , I'm all ears. Us adventurers should look out for each other, eh?
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERB00391_00: Ah, the freedom to roam where I will... Would that I had quit the stifling confines of my homeland sooner...
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERC00391_00: Revenant's Toll continues to grow, as does the number of travelers who pass through its gates. Between you and me, I'm having a hard time keeping an eye on them all.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERD00391_00: Adventuring is, by its nature, an unpredictable business. With planning and preparation, you can mitigate some of the risks...but if you don't trust your instincts, you won't last long.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERA00391_00: Sell me blade to the Ishgardians? Well...them dragons are a fearsome lot, but I'd slay me fair share if the coin was good.
I've worked for one o' them knights before, ye know. Watched me like a bloody hawk, he did. Still, I'd put up with worse than that for a heavy purse.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERB00391_00: Volunteer my services in the defense of Ishgard? I think not.

Dragons claimed the lives of every one of my brothers─I do not mean to offer them mine. 'Twas to escape such a fate that I took up the mantle of adventurer in the first place. I would sooner die in the pursuit of fortune than huddled behind an icy wall.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERC00391_00: So Ishgard seeks sellswords to bolster its ranks, eh? Though I'm not sure I like the sound of this siege, those nobles will surely be generous with their rewards...
Ah, but I have pledged myself to guard Revenant's Toll. Modest work though it is, I am loath to break the terms of my contract. What to do, what to do...
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_ADVENTURERD00391_00: Spare me your talk of glory and fame─I'm not in the habit of volunteering for lost causes.
I've survived this long by trusting my instincts, and my instincts tell me to stay well away from Ishgard.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_062: Ishgard sounds like she's in a right mess...but that ain't what I wanted to talk to ye about.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_063: I need ye to cast yer mind back to that scuffle with the Empire out by the processin' plant. A lad from Little Ala Mhigo by the name o' Wilred was there with the 4th that day, an' I want to know if ye've seen him since. Have ye?
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_064: Godsdammit, I feared as much... No one's bloody seen him. It's like the ground opened up an' swallowed him whole.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_065: But that ain't all. Around the time Wilred stopped turnin' up for duty, them black market weapons went missin' from our vault in Ul'dah...
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_066: So now, o' course, half the Braves suspect the lad o' makin' off with the goods.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_067: Folk like to believe our company's a disciplined fightin' force, but as you an' me both know, it's no more'n a motley collection o' mercenaries, adventurers, an' Grand Company veterans.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_068: The only thing as binds us together is some vague oath about fightin' for the freedom of all. That an' the steady pay.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_069: Now, compared to most others in this crew, Wilred's a fresh-faced novice─a bleedin' whelp amongst wolves.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_070: But the boy's got passion. When he talked about bein' a guardian of Eorzea, he bloody well meant it. A lad like him wouldn't rob us blind an' bugger off like that. He ain't the type.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_071: An' then─an' this is just between you an' me, mind─there's the fact that the lad wanted to tell me about somethin' queer he'd noticed in the ledgers. Somethin' about the Braves' numbers not addin' up...
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_072: Aye, there's a villain at the end o' this trail I've stumbled on, an' I'll bet me good eye it ain't young Wilred.
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_RIOL_000_073: Anyroad, ye've got a war to wage, so I'll let ye get on. I just thought someone should know... I'll be seein' ye, .
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_080: There you are, ! So? Did you sway any hearts?
TEXT_GAIUSE605_00391_TATARU_000_081: One or two, eh? Well, added to mine, that makes three or four, not including Slafborn's friends! We won't have the largest company in the army, but I'd say one Revenant's Toll veteran is worth a dozen clanking knights at least!
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_00: Tataru has a message for you from Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_01: Tataru has received word from Alphinaud that the Alliance council has convened to discuss Ishgard's plight, and that your presence has been requested at the meeting. Travel to Ul'dah, and rendezvous with Alphinaud on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_02: You look on in silence as Alphinaud delivers an impassioned plea for assistance to the Alliance leaders. But despite his best efforts, he is unable to persuade them to pledge more than a token force to aid in Ishgard's defense. Citing local concerns more deserving of their resources, the leaders refuse to provide meaningful assistance, and suggest instead that you assemble a contingent of elite adventurers, similar to the company that proved so effective during Operation Archon. With that, the council is dissolved, and you are ushered out onto the Royal Promenade. Trouble Alphinaud for his thoughts on the day's proceedings.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_03: Alphinaud's lamentations are interrupted by a linkpearl call from Captain Ilberd. It would seem the Dravanians have begun their assault on Coerthas. Wasting no time, the Crystal Brave commander dispatches his forces, and requests that you and your fellow adventurers assemble on the Steps of Faith, ready to repel the Horde. Make your way to the Gates of Judgement in the Coerthas central highlands, and report to Ser Marcelain.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_04: Upon arriving at the Gates of Judgement, Ser Marcelain hurriedly briefs you on the skirmishes that have broken out around the central highlands. Before digging in for the main siege, you are to aid the Crystal Braves and your fellow adventurers in repelling the Dravanians' advance forces. Head first to Whitebrim, and slay the dragons that threaten the area.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_05: You have defeated the Dravanian forces harrying Whitebrim. Travel next to Providence Point, and slay what dragons remain.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_06: You have eliminated the Dravanian presence at Providence Point. Return to the Gates of Judgement and report to Ser Marcelain.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_SEQ_07: Ser Marcelain is dismayed to learn of the fate of the recently arrived reinforcements, and calls upon you to avenge your fellows in the battle to come.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TODO_00: Speak with Alphinaud on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TODO_02: Speak with Marcelain at the Gates of Judgement.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TODO_03: Defeat the Dravanian forces at Whitebrim.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TODO_04: Defeat the Dravanian forces at Providence Point.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TATARU_000_000: Oh, I've been so caught up with recruiting that I almost forgot! There's been word from Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TATARU_000_001: Apparently, the Alliance leaders are convening in Ul'dah to discuss Ishgard's plight.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TATARU_000_002: And they've requested your presence! As usual.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TATARU_000_003: Anyway, you'd best make your way to Ul'dah, or you'll be late! Alphinaud said that he would meet you on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_TATARU_000_004: Alphinaud asked that you join him on the Royal Promenade. Don't worry─Slafborn and I can handle the preparations here. Now, get going! It wouldn't do to keep the Alliance leaders waiting!
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_BARTHOLOMEW_000_005: The Alliance leaders are already in attendance, . I do not think the grim mood within will be lightened by further delays...
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_010: My apologies for calling you away from your tasks. I had hoped to proceed with these negotiations one leader at a time, but it seems my urgent requests for an audience have prompted a gathering of the council.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Needless to say, I felt obliged to attend.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_012: The Alliance leaders are already seated within. Let us join them, shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_BARTHOLOMEW_000_013: It is not my place to comment on the decisions of the council... Suffice it to say that I shall pray for your victory.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Once again, I owe you an apology. It seems you have been conscripted into leading a contingent of adventurers on yet another mission of inestimable danger.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_031: ...But I fear we have been left with little alternative. We cannot well abandon Lord Haurchefant and Ser Aymeric to their fate.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_032: We must abide by the council's decision─as shortsighted as it is─and strive to fulfill our roles as Eorzea's guardians.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_034: ...Then the assault is begun? We have but this moment concluded our audience with the Alliance leaders.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_035: Move our forces into position. Your unit will join House Durendaire at the Steel Vigil.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_036: Man the cannons alongside the knights, and thin the Dravanian Horde ere they descend upon Ishgard. I will join you as soon as I am able.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_037: ─I would have you and your adventurer allies bolster the defenses at the Steps of Faith.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_038: Report first to Ser Marcelain at the Gates of Judgement, and he will direct you to where you are needed most. May the gods grant us victory!
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_ALPHINAUD_000_039: Seek out Ser Marcelain, the keeper of the Gates of Judgement. The Steps of Faith lie just beyond his position, and he will know where the fighting is worst.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_050: You are the appointed captain of the sellsword contingent? Then, welcome! There is no shortage of bladework to be done!
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_051: As we speak, Dravanian skirmishing parties are harrying positions across the central highlands.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_052: I've assigned the Crystal Braves and your fellow adventurers to contain these scattered attacks─and for the present, I would have you join them.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_053: This is, of course, merely a precursor to the assault on Ishgard proper. The wily serpents seek to divide and confuse our forces, but we will not be so easily drawn out of position.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_054: The Temple Knights will remain on the Steps of Faith and continue our preparations. When the Horde arrives in force, they shall face a wall of Ishgardian steel. Report back to me once their advance skirmishers are slain!
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_055: I would have you assist the Crystal Braves and your fellow adventurers in slaying the Dravanians' advance skirmishers. Report back to me as soon as the threat has been eliminated.
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_070: What news, adventurer? ...The reinforcements? ...Decimated, you say? Dravanian devils! Damn their scaly hides!
TEXT_GAIUSE606_00418_MARCELAIN_000_071: Hold fast to your grief and fury, . We will avenge the deaths of your fellows in the battle to come!
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_SEQ_00: Minfilia seems loath to put you to further trouble so soon after your last great exertion.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_SEQ_01: Though she had hoped to grant you some respite after your exertions in Ishgard, an unexpected invitation from Ul'dah compels Minfilia to beg your assistance once more. A feast is being held to celebrate Ishgard's victory, and it would seem the Scions are expected to attend. Though Tataru wastes no time making the necessary arrangements, her uncharacteristic sighs tell Minfilia that something is amiss. Look for the troubled receptionist at her desk outside the solar.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_SEQ_02: You search for Tataru, but find her desk unattended. Mayhap F'lhaminn knows of her whereabouts.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_SEQ_03: F'lhaminn informs you that Tataru recently left through the front door of the Rising Stones, sighing as she went. Head out into Revenant's Toll and search for the receptionist.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_SEQ_04: You find Tataru alone, grappling with a problem she feels unable to share. After drawing encouragement from your stoic presence, however, she decides to bring the issue to the Antecedent. Return to the Rising Stones and speak with Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_SEQ_05: Citing a need for some measure of martial prowess, Tataru requests a leave of absence to study her chosen discipline. Just as the determined Lalafell is departing, Hoary Boulder arrives to petition the Antecedent with a request of his own. It would seem that the adventurer assigned to his escort party has been seriously injured, leaving them in need of a replacement guard...
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TODO_00: Look for Tataru at her desk.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TODO_02: Search for Tataru in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TODO_03: Speak with Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_000: You must be weary, . And now may very well be your only chance to─
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_002: A messenger from Ul'dah arrived with a missive for you.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_005: “On behalf of the Council of the Eorzean Alliance, Her Royal Majesty Nanamo Ul Namo invites the Scions of the Seventh Dawn to attend a feast at the Royal Palace of Ul'dah...in honor of Ishgard's recent victory.”
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_006: It would seem we are to be recognized for our part in lifting the siege─you, for your valiant efforts as commander of the adventurers' contingent, and the Archons for their earnest attempts to rouse the city-states.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_007: Truly, I find it strange that the Alliance leaders should think themselves deserving of a place at such a celebration.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_008: All three refused to deploy their standing armies, preferring to send hastily assembled companies of sellswords, many of whom perished ere the siege began. Are they truly so brazen as to seek to share in the glory of your triumph?
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_009: Ah, but mayhap they simply seek a pretext to meet with the Ishgardians while the mood is yet jubilant... Such an occasion would present a fine opportunity to press for Ishgard's return to the Eorzean Alliance.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_010: <sigh> We have scarce had time to mourn Moenbryda, and I, for one, am in no mood to carouse. But I suppose we must put away our grief for the good of the realm.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_011: Though you were promised rest, I fear I must insist that you also attend. It would be a strange celebration indeed if the victorious hero were not present. Pray content yourself with the thought that such occasions may bring about momentous change─and this without recourse to bloodshed.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_012: Tataru, if you would do me the favor of contacting the rest of the Scions?
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_014:
And please let me know if there's anything else I can do.

<sigh>
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_015: Curious... I have never known Tataru to sigh at such requests. Could aught be amiss?
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_016: Tataru is troubled, I am certain of it. Would you mind speaking with her? I fear any concern I show will be met with stoic denials.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_SYSTEM_000_030: Tataru is conspicuous by her absence...
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_FLHAMINN_000_040: Tataru? I believe she just stepped outside.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_FLHAMINN_000_041: Now that I think on it, she did seem rather preoccupied...
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_050: Oh, ─it's you. I didn't mean to worry anyone. It's nothing, really...
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_051: Well, it's not nothing exactly... But it feels like nothing compared to the towering trials you and the others face every day.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_052: ...And that's why I should probably talk to Minfilia before things get any worse! Ah, you always know what to say, ! I'm glad we had this little chat!
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_060: Yes, Tataru? You have my undivided attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_061: I've been hesitant to broach the subject, what with all the recent excitement, but  made me realize that there's no time like the present. ...And time is what I'm here to ask you for!
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_062: I am not sure I understand. If you wish to be excused from your duties for a time, then you have certainly earned the rest.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_063: ...But I suspect that lying abed is far from your intent.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_064: You know me too well, Antecedent. There is, in fact, something I've been wanting to try my hand at.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_065: Along with the adventurers and the Crystal Braves, the Scions are constantly being thrown into dangerous battles and deadly predicaments.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_066: Even Hoary Boulder and Coultenet have been promoted from guard duty to fill our need for competent warriors...
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_TATARU_000_067: And so it seems only right that I, too, should acquire the power to defend myself! And others, more importantly! When I return, I shall be both your receptionist and your bodyguard!
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_HOARYBOULDER_000_06: That's the first time I've almost been knocked to the ground by a Lalafell! I've never seen Miss Tataru so determined. Has aught befell with which I might help, Antecedent?
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_070: Ah, not at present, thank you. ...Was there something you would ask of me?
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: Oh, yes! Pray excuse my distraction. An adventurer who was to join us for escort duty was injured while out on patrol.
And I fear we cannot properly defend the scholars entrusted to our protection without the aid of at least one more guard...
Therefore, I humbly request that another adventurer─of the capable kind, of course─be assigned to our party.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_MINFILIA_000_074: Very well. I shall consider the potential candidates and provide you with a replacement as soon as I am able.
TEXT_GAIUSE608_00420_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: My thanks, Antecedent. I take my leave of you.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_SEQ_00: Minfilia is at a loss for words.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_SEQ_01: Recalling a conversation with Urianger, Minfilia surmises that Tataru may have taken up the study of arcanima. Despite the young woman's declaration that she will return as receptionist and bodyguard both, the Antecedent cannot help but worry. To put Minfilia's mind at ease, journey to the Arcanists' Guild in Limsa Lominsa and search for Tataru.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_SEQ_02: You find Tataru on the practice floor of the Arcanists' Guild, sporting a brand-new ensemble and the same old enthusiastic expression. With obvious pride, she declares that she must undertake a special training exercise at Mistress Thubyrgeim's behest, and hurries off before you can respond. Given the circumstances, it may be prudent to ask the acting guildmaster what manner of training she has asked Tataru to complete.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_SEQ_03: Upon learning that you are a friend of Tataru's, Mistress Thubyrgeim shares her concerns regarding the young receptionist's potential as an arcanist─or lack thereof. She then implores you to oversee Tataru's training outside the city, south of the Zephyr Gate, in case something goes awry.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_SEQ_04: As you watch from a distance, Tataru approaches several crates in order to conduct a mock inspection. Wild beasts soon approach, and she steels herself for battle─only to be abandoned by her Carbuncle. Tataru has no choice but to flee, just as you have no choice but to follow.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_SEQ_05: Despite your carefully impassive expression, Tataru soon realizes that you bore witness to her shame. Crestfallen, she renounces arcanima and returns to the city. Though the trial ended in failure, Mistress Thubyrgeim should be glad to learn that her student did not come to harm.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_SEQ_06: Tataru returns to the guild shortly after you arrive and proceeds to deliver a scathing appraisal of her performance and general aptitude to a bemused Mistress Thubyrgeim. Before your young friend can heap further scorn upon herself, however, the acting guildmaster tells her not to lose sight of her strengths─to remember that, while there are studies at which she may not excel, there are others to which she is well suited. Though Tataru claims that she will take these words to heart, it is plain that her confidence has been dealt a crushing blow...
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TODO_00: Search for Tataru at the Arcanists' Guild.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TODO_02: Observe Tataru's training south of the Zephyr Gate.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_000: The power to defend oneself...? Hmm. Tataru has ever been full of surprises.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_001: Now that I think on it, I do recall Urianger mentioning that she had developed an interest in arcanima...
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_002: Mayhap she hopes to gain admittance to the Arcanists' Guild in Limsa Lominsa? ...Yes, that will be the way of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_MINFILIA_000_003: Would you be so kind as to journey to the guild and see that all is well? It is doubtless unwarranted─but surely I am not alone in my concern for her safety?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_004: Has she already gone downstairs? Enthusiasm is well and good, but in excess... <sigh> I pray I was not wrong.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_011: I didn't mean for her to worry... That's the last thing I wanted.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_012: Putting an end to such worries is precisely the reason I'm here, don't you see?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_013: I, Tataru Taru, shall become a great and powerful arcanist!
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_014: And now, at Mistress Thubyrgeim's behest, I must go and complete a special training exercise! Until we meet again!
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_030: Ah, if it isn't . What brings you to the guild?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_031: ...So you are acquainted with our newest member. <sigh> An arcanist of your experience must see that her potential is somewhat lacking.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_032: Nevertheless, she would not be denied, and goes now to undertake her first trial: a simulated inspection of three crates. Doubtless you recall receiving similar training under K'lyhia's supervision?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_033: A thought occurs to me─why not oversee Tataru's training yourself? Given your relationship with the girl and your familiarity with the task, I think you the ideal choice. You need only head to the cliffs south of the Zephyr Gate, as before, and observe at a distance.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_040: Yes? How may I assist you, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_041: ...So you are acquainted with our newest member. <sigh> Mayhap you have already noticed, but I fear young Tataru's potential is somewhat lacking.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_042: Nevertheless, she would not be denied, and goes now to undertake her first trial: a simulated inspection of three crates. A simple task, some might say, but one all arcanists are expected to complete.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_043: A thought occurs to me─why not assist Tataru with her training? Given your relationship with the girl and your growing understanding of arcanima, you may prove a great help to her. Her trial will be conducted at the cliffs south of the Zephyr Gate. You need only observe at a distance.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_050: Greetings, and welcome to the Arcanists' Guild. Do you require assistance?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_051: ...So you are acquainted with our newest member. Hmm... I am sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but...I fear young Tataru may not be ideally suited to the study of arcanima.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_052: Nevertheless, she would not be denied, and goes now to undertake her first trial: a simulated inspection of three crates. A simple task, some might say, but one all arcanists are expected to complete.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_053: A thought occurs to me─why not supervise Tataru's training? You are clearly an accomplished adventurer, and given your relationship with the girl, you seem an ideal person to have on hand. Her trial will be conducted at the cliffs south of the Zephyr Gate. You need only observe at a distance.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_070:
O'er azure seas to pirates' port,♪
Where she met her shining jewel...♪
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_071:
For to bring the smugglers' plans to naught,♪
Came the lass whom none could fool!♪
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_072:
Beat 'em with a Backdraft!♪
Gut 'em with a Gust!♪
Deck 'em with a Downburst!♪
Go, Carbuncle, go!♪
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_073: O～hohoho! Are those crates I spy?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_074: Ah, and this must be the true test! But we're ready for them, aren't we, Carbuncle!?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_076: Uwaaah! Come back, Carbuncle! Come baaack!
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_091: You needn't say a word─your face says it all. I know you bore witness to my shame.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_092: <sniffle> Betrayed by my own Carbuncle and left at the mercy of wild beasts...
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_093: I...I must accept the truth. I'll never be a warrior like you or the others.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_094: I will inform Mistress Thubyrgeim of my intention to withdraw from the guild. Arcanima...like so much else...is beyond me.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_100: Ah, back so soon? How fared our fledgling arcanist?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_101: Abysmally, Mistress Thubyrgeim, abysmally─as  will testify.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_102: I was wrong to become an arcanist. Wrong as usual. I am completely and utterly unqualified, and I sincerely apologize for wasting your time.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_103: ...Tataru. If that were true, I would not have permitted you to join in the first place.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_104: We must all come to accept our limitations, lest our ambitions lead us astray. However, we must not lose sight of our strengths in the process.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_105: For example, your exceptional skill with numbers helped you to gain a solid grasp of the fundamentals of arcanima. Were it not so, you would have struggled even to summon Carbuncle to your side.
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_THUBYRGEIM_000_106: In my opinion, the Scions are truly fortunate to have such a capable and good-natured receptionist in their service. Would you not agree?
TEXT_GAIUSE609_00421_TATARU_000_107: You are too kind, Mistress Thubyrgeim. Though I could not overcome this challenge, I shall take your words to heart and try not to be discouraged.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SEQ_00: Tataru is considering her next course of action, and how you might aid her in it.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SEQ_01: Though Tataru has been forced to abandon her pursuit of a new profession, she would not see her brief sabbatical end without accomplishing something of note. Accordingly, she asks that you accompany her to Costa del Sol─though for what purpose she does not say.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SEQ_02: Once more, you find Tataru dressed appropriately for the occasion─her goal this time being the procurement of pearls from clams native to Bloodshore. The endeavor is not without risk, however, as the clams are a favorite food of certain dangerous creatures. Follow Tataru to the sands below and see if she requires any assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SEQ_03: Fortune smiles on the young woman, as she soon uncovers a clam. While she works to remove the pearl within, stand watch for any creatures that might do her harm.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SEQ_04: A ravenous serpent sets its sights on your friend and her prize, but you promptly slay it. Happily, Tataru appears to have completed her task─let her know that you have too.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SEQ_05: Tataru reveals her intent to use the blood pearls she has harvested to fashion charms for her fellow Scions. In this way, she hopes to ensure that they will always come home. Having accomplished her task, she makes for Limsa Lominsa, where F'lhaminn awaits, and bids you return to Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SEQ_06: After listening to your account, Minfilia concludes that despite Tataru's failure to become an arcanist, she nevertheless benefited from the experience. With the benefit of hindsight, she suspects that the receptionist would have managed on her own...but is grateful that you indulged her request even so.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TODO_00: Speak with Tataru in Costa del Sol.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TODO_02: Stand guard as Tataru harvests pearls.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TODO_04: Speak with Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_000: <sigh> As fetching as these garments are, I fear I shall never don them again...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_001: But I can't go back to the Rising Stones without something to show for my time away.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_002: Wait─I know what I can do! That is, if you don't mind accompanying me for a little longer?
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_003: Wonderful! Then to Costa del Sol we will go! It's a bit of a gamble, but I'm confident it will pay off!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_THUBYRGEIM_000_004: Tataru is a bright, spirited girl. If she could but focus her nervous energy...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_010: Yes, this is it! This is where the man at the Drowning Wench told me to look!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_011: There is a certain variety of clam which can be harvested this time of year in Bloodshore─one which produces the most marvelous pearls!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_012: However, these clams are also coveted by certain wild creatures─and since I fared rather poorly in battle last time... Ahem. Let us be off!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_020: What fortune, I've already found one! Would you be so kind as to keep watch while I work? This should only take a moment...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_021: Open...up...you little... Gah! This is proving more difficult than I thought...
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_030: Well fought, , well fought! I knew I was right to ask you to come.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_031: As for me, I have my prize: a bounty of blood pearls!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_032: So named for their reddish hue, they were treasured as wards against dark magicks in ancient times.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_033: I thought I might make charms for everyone...so that no matter where they go, they will always come home.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_034: It's sort of the power to defend myself and other people...in a way. Right, well, I mustn't keep F'lhaminn waiting! There's work to be done─and lots of it!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_035: We're to secure provisions for the Scions in the Lominsan markets. She may have an eye for quality, but I have a nose for bargains!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_036: Will you be heading back to the Rising Stones? If so, pray convey my apologies to the Antecedent, and tell her that she needn't worry about me.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_TATARU_000_037:
Farewell, , and thank you for everything!
Hmmm, that sounded rather final, didn't it? How about...until we meet again!
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_050: Welcome home, . I gather you found Tataru in Limsa Lominsa?
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_051: My, it sounds as though she had quite an adventure. And while it did not end as she had hoped, I suspect that it will prove to be a valuable experience.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_052: I daresay she could have managed without our intervention. Even so, I appreciate you indulging my request.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_060: My, it sounds as though she had quite an adventure. And while it did not end as she had hoped, I suspect that it will prove to be a valuable experience. I daresay she could have managed without our intervention. Even so, I appreciate you indulging my request.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_061: I am sorry, . No doubt you have other matters to attend to, and we have already imposed upon you so much. Pray take some time for yourself─I daresay you have more than earned a respite.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_MINFILIA_000_062: After all, we will be most busy with preparations as the banquet draws near. Should other adventures summon you elsewhere, perhaps now is the time to heed their call?
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SYSTEM_000_063: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_GAIUSE610_00422_SYSTEM_000_070: The Crystal Tower quest series may be undertaken by speaking with the outlandish man in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_00: Minfilia is eyeing you with a mixture of regret and desperation.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_01: That they might better understand the impact of primal summonings, the Scions of the Seventh Dawn employ scholars to travel across Eorzea taking aetheric readings. These expeditions often entail visiting dangerous areas, and so each scholar is assigned an escort. Unfortunately, an adventurer charged with accompanying one such scholar was recently injured, leaving Minfilia with no other option but to ask that you serve in his stead. Hoary Boulder, who awaits you outside the solar, will brief you on the details.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_02: Hoary Boulder welcomes the opportunity to work with you personally─though Coultenet observes that your duties will take you in different directions. Your charge awaits you at Camp Tranquil in the South Shroud. Make your way into the forest and see your mission done.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_03: Your late arrival does little to endear you to the scholar, who curtly instructs you to follow him to Issom-Har without further delay.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_04: Having found a suitable location, the scholar begins to calibrate his instruments. Leave him to his work and keep watch for wild beasts.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_05: A brief moment of action provides a welcome distraction from an otherwise uneventful duty. Speak with the scholar to see if he has finished taking measurements.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_06: Rather than express gratitude for your protection, the scholar requests that you make a more concerted effort to slay your assailants quietly. Resist the urge to remind him who he is talking to, and accompany the vile ingrate to Snakemolt so that he might continue his mission.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_07: The scholar wastes no time preparing to take measurements, and orders you to stand watch as before.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_08: You dispatch your assailants with practiced efficiency. With luck, the scholar will have no complaints this time.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_09: Suddenly disconcerted by the atmosphere in Snakemolt, the scholar hurriedly departs for Rootslake, where the final survey site awaits. Follow him and complete your mission.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_10: His words terse and his mood tense, the scholar motions for you to stand guard once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE611_00423_SEQ_11: The attack comes as little surprise, as does your victory. Inform the scholar that all is well.
