TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_02: While discussing the future of the Waking Sands with Urianger, you hear a cry from the solar which could only be Minfilia's. After bursting through the doors, you find the Antecedent collapsed upon the floor, alive─thank the gods─but unmoving. Wielding the power of the Echo, you learn that an Ascian robed in white was present mere moments before, having infiltrated the Scions' inner sanctum unnoticed. As the vision unfolds, the trespasser proclaims himself an emissary, and speaks cryptically of the Echo and its power, asserting that mastery of this gift could end hostilities between the Ascians and the children of Hydaelyn forever. Back in the present, Minfilia rises to her feet, disoriented but unharmed, and commands you to search Vesper Bay for the Ascian, who she suspects may still be lurking nearby.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_03: You are shocked to find the Ascian standing in the center of Vesper Bay, making no attempt to conceal his presence. Although he recognizes you as the one who bested Lahabrea in the Praetorium, he expresses some doubt as to your true capabilities. After declaring that he will walk north, he adds that you may follow, but warns that you will be waylaid should you choose to do so.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_04: A trio of imps ambush you outside the gates of Vesper Bay, precisely as the Ascian predicted. Though he does not appear to be present, you cannot shake the sensation that you are being watched...
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_05: You are soon waylaid by another voidsent─a gargoyle, this time─which you duly slay. As before, you feel certain that the battle was observed...
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_06: Upon entering Parata's Peace, you are assailed by a pair of gnarled gargoyles, but they are unable to stop you from pressing forward. To the north, you spy the white-robed Ascian standing motionless, as if daring you to approach. Oblige him.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_07: As the white-robed figure watches in silence, four black-clad Ascians appear and engage you in combat. Wielding dire magicks, they push you to your mortal limits, but in the end you claim victory. As the last one falls, you see what looks like a grin flash across the face of your observer. Accost him and find out what he has to say.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_08: "As it was, so shall it be again.“ The words of Elidibus linger in your memory, simultaneously inviting and eluding interpretation. Intriguingly, the Ascian emissary claims to serve the same god as Lahabrea, yet he appears to bear no ill will towards you and your fellow Scions. Quite why this should be is unclear─if, indeed, it is even true... Return to the Waking Sands and report all that has transpired to Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_SEQ_09: Your tale serves only to confound an already troubled Minfilia, who is at a loss to explain Elidibus's actions. Though it would seem that the white-robed Ascian is no friend to Lahabrea, everything else about him remains a mystery.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TODO_07: Report to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_000: Owing to the tireless efforts of all concerned, we are, at long last, ready to bid farewell to Vesper Bay.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_001: So as to avoid drawing undue attention, we shall make the journey to Revenant's Toll in small groups, departing at irregular intervals.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_002: Lest you doubt, it is still my intention to conduct future operations openly, but on this particular occasion, the need for caution overrides all other concerns. To move north as one ponderous caravan would only serve to invite attack.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_003: It seemed only right that I should be the last to leave, and I would have you remain with me until the end, .
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_004: Upon my departure, the Waking Sands will formally cease to be our headquarters, and the premises will be given into the care of Urianger.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_005: I had thought to relinquish the property, but he was quite adamant, and I had not the heart to disagree. These walls have borne witness to some of the brightest...and darkest moments in our order's history. Mayhap it is best that we do not forsake them entirely.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_006: Urianger shall remain here and devote his energies to studying the nature of primals. By the grace of the Twelve, he will one day discover the permanent solution that we have sought for so long.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_007: Of course, he will not be alone─Alisaie shall continue to work closely with him as well.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_008: Should they require our assistance, I have their assurances that they will not hesitate to contact us.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_009: Speaking of Urianger─would you inquire of him if any tasks remain undone? I cannot escape the feeling that I have forgotten something. Something important.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_010: Thou art ever welcome, , but I require no assistance. Pray take thy leave unburdened by concern for my well-being.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_011: Verily, thy countenance bespeaks a desire to quit this place without further delay. Hm. Mayhap thou thinkest this chapter of our tale concluded─that these halls should rightly be consigned to the annals of history...?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_012: In man's eagerness to seize the future, how readily he doth set down the past.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_013: Full many a proud pioneer hath bravely stridden into the great unknown, only to find there the banner of his ancestor, faded by the eons. And still man glorieth in his discoveries. 'Tis through his pride that wisdom doth ever give way to ignorance, while they who lurk in shadow remain hidden, lost no sooner than they are found.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_014: <sigh> Be not offended, . Thy conduct hath ever been beyond reproach. Despite thy surpassing strength, and all thy many victories, thou hast never been so convinced of thine own greatness as to imagine thyself above the failings of thy forebears. Mayhap it is the Echo which hath opened thine eyes to the lessons of history. Would that the same could be said of─
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_021: Whence came that cry!? The solar! Twelve forfend─the Antecedent!
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_030: Tell me, Louisoix... Would you have done the same?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSANCIENT_000: (-???-)...Louisoix Leveilleur was a remarkable man. Wise beyond mortal measure. Would that I had met him prior to his passing.
(-???-)How readily you see. You are indeed gifted, Antecedent.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_034: But you... You are not like the others. Your robes...
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSANCIENT_000: (-???-)Gifted─but ignorant. Yet I shall not judge you harshly. The fault lies with your forebears. It has been...millennia.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Mine are the robes of an emissary. Unlike he who came before, I have no quarrel with you.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_037: He who─ You speak of Lahabrea?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Lahabrea is a warrior. He fought. He fell.
(-???-)He may yet learn from his mistakes.
(-???-)Come. I only confirm that which you already knew.
(-???-)There is no cessation, no oblivion. Only expulsion.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_044: We're ready when you are, my lady! If there's nothing else...
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_046: Ah...I feel the same way. After everything that's happened here, it feels strange to leave. But I'm sure we'll soon get used to Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_047: Well...I'll let you say your good-byes. Take as long as you like, my lady. We shall depart whenever you're ready.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)It is only to be expected. She lacks the gift and the knowledge both. To her, we are indistinct.
(-???-)Shadowless, fleshless, formless... What truth there is in each tale is diluted by time and telling.
(-???-)Knowledge dictates expectation, and expectation colors perception. Thus did she perceive naught.
(-???-)So it is with all but a chosen few. Even you, when young, could not yet see with eyes unclouded.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_053: You know nothing about me. Nothing.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)The gift grants you clarity; it grants you focus. With it, you may in time come to see us as we are, rather than this crude approximation.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_055: Lahabrea did not think so highly of the Echo.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Lahabrea is wrong about a great many things. The Echo is indeed a gift─albeit one you have yet to master.
(-???-)There would be no strife between our peoples─for we would be of one mind.
(-???-)I leave, as I came, in peace, Antecedent. May we meet again as friends.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSANCIENT_000: (-???-)Mayhap I was indelicate... 'Tis a mercy She shields Her children from His grace with such resolve.
(-???-)Was it also by Her hand that you survived the Ardor, I wonder?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_070: <groan> I...I take it there is no need to explain.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_071: Save your concern. He did me no lasting harm. Whatever his intention was, it was not to kill.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_072: I heard a cry! What happened!? Are you all right?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_073: You look faint─do you need to lie down? I could fetch you a flask of my special tonic─
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_074: Urianger, send word to the Students of Baldesion. Tell them to scour the archives─the forbidden tomes in particular.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_075: If there is any reference to an Ascian robed in white, however oblique, I would know of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_076: ...An Ascian, my lady? Was that what gave you cause to cry out?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_077: I did but moments ago glimpse a figure clad in white set forth from the Waking Sands. Yet Ascians are wont to employ teleportation magicks─why would one be so brazen?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_078: I know not and care not. Find him, ! Turn every stone in Vesper Bay if you have to!
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_090: He speaks of peace, but I know his words belie his true intent.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_095: Tell me he's gone, . Tell me we're safe. We are safe, aren't we...?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_100: What this visitation doth portend, I cannot say. But that thou must pursue the Ascian is clear. Scour thee Vesper Bay for signs of his passing. And fear not for the Antecedent's well-being─should the fiend be so imprudent as to return to the Waking Sands, he shall not find us unprepared a second time.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-???-)Approach when you will. I shall wait.
(-???-)I am told that you are the Warrior of Light. But I would know for myself.
(-???-)I shall walk north, and you may choose to follow.
(-???-)Know, however, that you will be waylaid if you do─you may even perish. Should you survive, we shall speak anon.
(-???-)I see you live. Good. But your trial is not yet at an end.
(-???-)Remarkable. Truly remarkable. I thank you for granting me this indulgence.
(-???-)None save  who bested Lahabrea could endure such an examination.
(-???-)Have the laws of man grown so twisted in my absence that it is now permitted to lay hands upon an emissary?
(-???-)You bore witness to my audience with the Antecedent, did you not? Then you know I acted only in self-defense.

(-???-)I realize the same cannot be said of Lahabrea. Even amongst his brethren, he is considered...unique. Nevertheless, I cannot wholly condemn his misdeeds, for through them we discovered you─one so strong in the gift that  could cast us out.
(-???-)Your Mother favors you still, that much is plain. But surely you must feel it? Her influence wanes, and Her strength shall soon be spent.
(-???-)These lands, these people, this world─all shall soon change.
(-???-)As it was, so shall it be again. As it should always have been.
(-???-)Doubt my claims and question my motives if you will.
(-???-)Only believe me when I say this...
(-Elidibus-)I am Elidibus, emissary─bearer of the word of the one true god. And we shall meet again.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_140: Thank the gods you've returned, ! After you left, I began to worry that I might have sent you to your doom. I take it our visitor proved elusive?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_141: Beg pardon? He was waiting for you!? What did you do? What did he say?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_142: "As it was, so shall it be again“? ...Of when does he speak? And of what, exactly?
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_143: The words of this Elidibus portend much but reveal nothing─save perhaps a measure of disdain for Lahabrea.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_MINFILIA_000_144: <sigh> I had hoped for answers, but it seems I shall have to be content with a wealth of additional questions.
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_TATARU_000_150: Where were you, !? Did you find the man in white? Oh, what am I doing─the Antecedent is waiting for you!
TEXT_GAIUSE118_01192_URIANGER_000_155: By the Twelve's good grace, thou hast returned. The Antecedent waiteth for thee. Hie thee to her side without further delay.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_SEQ_00: Thancred wishes to discuss how to proceed with the investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_SEQ_01: For want of a better idea, Thancred suggests consulting Fufulupa once more. Speak with the Brass Blade and find out if he has aught to offer.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_SEQ_02: Upon learning that someone within the Brass Blades' ranks may be involved in the crystal thefts, Thancred and Y'shtola devise a plan to lure the thieves into the open. Posing as a courier in possession of crystals, Y'shtola will act as bait, while you and Thancred observe from a distance. Should the thieves appear, you are to subdue them by any means necessary.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_SEQ_03: Y'shtola's ruse succeeds in drawing the thieves out into the open, but when the trap is sprung, it quickly becomes clear that they will not be taken alive. Left with no other choice, you fight till each lies dead. Report all that has occurred to Y'shtola.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_SEQ_04: Although the thieves had naught in their possession to indicate their allegiance, Thancred notes that all were Sea Wolves, and that each of them sported distinctive blue facial tattoos. This observation appears to prompt a revelation in Y'shtola, who immediately takes her leave to make inquiries. Having been placed in charge of matters in Thanalan, Thancred invites you to return with him to Horizon and report to Fufulupa.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_SEQ_05: Fufulupa informs you that the traitorous Brass Blade was identified while you were away, but that the Lominsan-born Sea Wolf subdued the unit sent to detain him and took flight. Though he assures you that his comrades will soon hunt down the fugitive, you wonder if the task might better be entrusted to one more capable. Before you can volunteer, however, Thancred is informed via linkpearl that your services are needed elsewhere.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_TODO_01: Lie in wait for the thieves.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_000: Any bright ideas? A solitary flash of insight?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_001: ...No? Well then, for want of a better suggestion, I say we try picking Fufulupa's brain again.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_100_001: Who knows, if we work together, we may yet find something of use nestled away within it.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_005: Mayhap a more subtle approach is in order...
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_006: I'm flattered that you enjoy my company so much, , but talking to me isn't going to get us anywhere. Come, let's have a word with Fufulupa.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_100_010: Oh, but it is good to see you return! I have given some thought to the matter, and I have just hit upon a most disturbing possibility! How could I have been so blind...!?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_010: Calm yourself, Fufulupa. What is this disturbing possibility of which you speak?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_000_012: I was contemplating as to how the thieves' activities escaped our notice for so long, and then it came to me! What if there is someone among our own ranks conspiring with them─a traitor in our own midst!?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_013: ...It would be most unfortunate if your fears proved well founded, Fufulupa.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_014: Indeed. If, for reasons of security, the Concern decided to transfer the remaining crystals stored in Horizon to another location, their plans would be discovered the moment the Brass Blades were informed.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_015: Ah, but such a shipment would surely be well guarded. Would thieves as wily as ours risk open confrontation?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_016: Mayhap not. But neither would the Concern be eager to present them with such an obvious target. Nay, they might instead elect to carry out the transfer in secret─to entrust the goods to, let us say, a lone Miqo'te miner, traveling without escort so as not to attract undue attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_000_017: But who─ Ahhh, I see! Yes, the Concern may well elect to do that. But to travel with so much cargo would be a strenuous task indeed, and this miner would certainly need to rest upon the way. Mayhap...north of the bridge to Hammerlea?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_018: A fine spot for a rest─would you not agree, ? .
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_000_019: Ahem! Forgive me, my friends, but I have received new orders! I must inform my men at once!
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_020: Call me a cynic, but I would be surprised if these thieves lay down their arms and surrender. See that you come prepared to offer them some encouragement.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_025: What are you doing, !? If the thieves approach from the north, there will be no one there to stop them!
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_026: Meanin' no offense, ─I'd sooner be left in peace.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_POP_MESSAGE: Movement in the distance catches your eye...
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_BALLOON_110_026: I ain't dyin' in this godsforsaken 'ell'ole!
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_027: Bumped into the thieves, did you? I don't suppose any of them are still breathing, are they? Hm. I thought not. Well, no sense keeping our miner friend waiting, then.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_030: Stubborn to the last, as expected. You are unharmed?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_031: A gang of Sea Wolf thieves, and in Thanalan, no less. I suppose there's a first time for everything...
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_033: Aye, and all with the same taste in facial tattoos. Blue, in case you were wondering.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_034: ...Our thieves are a long way from home.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_YSHTOLA_000_035: Thancred─if you would be so good as to attend to the outstanding matters in Horizon... I have inquiries to make.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_036: To Horizon, then. Fufulupa will want to hear about your meeting with the thieves.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_038: This tale does not require a bard's embellishment. Simply tell Fufulupa what transpired.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_000_040: On behalf of the Brass Blades of the Rose, I thank you for your service to Horizon!
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_000_041: Ah, but we have not been idle! While you were afield, we succeeded in identifying the traitor within our ranks!
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_042: Is that so? Then, by your leave, I should very much like to have a word with the fellow in private.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_000_043: Ah...no. I am afraid that will not be possible. Regrettably, he, um...managed to subdue the unit of Blades dispatched to detain him, and made good his escape.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_044: Oh, for the love of─ And how did he manage that, exactly? Your men haven't been sampling that somnus we confiscated, have they? Or was he a giant in disguise?
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_FUFULUPA_000_045: N-No...but he was quite strong! A Sea Wolf─Lominsan born and raised, I believe. But do not worry─we will find him, you have my word on that!
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_046: I see... Pray keep me apprised of any developments.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_048: I fear our time together is at an end, my friend. Your services are required elsewhere. Awfully disappointing, I know, but one must follow where duty leads.
TEXT_GAIUSE202_01346_THANCRED_000_049: ...You might try to look a little disappointed! Or do you mean to give me another one of your stoic nods? You do, don't you? <sigh>
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_00: Thancred has information on your next assignment.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_01: By way of Minfilia and, in turn, Thancred, Alphinaud has requested your presence in Vesper Bay. Report to young Master Leveilleur at the docks outside the Waking Sands.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_02: Alphinaud informs you that travelers from the eastern nation of Doma arrived in Vesper Bay not long ago, apparently seeking an audience with the rulers of Ul'dah. Believing that they may have valuable information on the current state of affairs within the Empire, he is resolved to seek them out, and wants you on hand to ensure that all proceeds smoothly. Knowing how unaccommodating the Sultansworn can be, he suggests beginning the search on the Royal Promenade in Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_03: As predicted, you find the Doman leader and her assistants fruitlessly petitioning the Sultansworn posted outside the Fragrant Chamber. Sensing an opportunity, Alphinaud approaches the travelers and offers his assistance─on the condition that they first accompany him to the Quicksand and explain their situation. Follow the party to the Quicksand and let Alphinaud know when you are ready to listen to the Domans' tale.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_04: Lady Yugiri, the leader of the refugees, explains that her people have come to Eorzea in search of asylum. After their rebellion against the Empire failed, imperial forces set about razing their homeland of Doma, leaving them no choice but to flee. Moved by her tale, Alphinaud offers to speak to General Raubahn on Yugiri's behalf, and departs for the Hall of Flames, leaving the refugees in your care. Inquire of Yugiri if there is anything she needs.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_05: Supplies on the Doman galleon have run low, and Yugiri asks that you help her secure provisions. As proprietress of the Quicksand and a proven friend to the Scions, Momodi may be the best person to speak with regarding this matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_06: It so happens that a wealthy merchant recently canceled his reservation at the Quicksand, leaving Momodi with an excess of foodstuffs. She offers to send them to the Waking Sands for redistribution, and furnishes you with two letters containing instructions for her suppliers, Fridurih and Katherine, who can be found at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_07: You deliver the instructions to the merchants, who make no effort to hide their disapproval of Momodi's actions. Return to the Quicksand and inform Momodi that the shipments are on their way.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_08: Momodi is pleased to hear that the foodstuffs will be put to good use. Share the good tidings with Yugiri.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_09: Not long after you explain Momodi's arrangement to Yugiri, Alphinaud returns to the Quicksand with more good news: the Domans have been granted an audience with the sultana and the Syndicate. What will come of the meeting is anyone's guess, but at least Yugiri will have an opportunity to plead her people's case. Return to the Royal Promenade and speak with Raubahn to proceed into the Fragrant Chamber.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_SEQ_10: Before the assembled leaders of Ul'dah, Yugiri details the circumstances which compelled her people to seek refuge in Ul'dah. Although the sultana, Raubahn, and Teledji Adeledji are sympathetic to her cause, the most influential member of the Syndicate, Lolorito, persuades the others to refuse the Domans asylum. Thus barred from Ul'dah, Yugiri and her people must look elsewhere for a new home.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_TODO_01: Search for the Domans on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_TODO_02: Speak with Alphinaud at the Quicksand.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_TODO_05: Deliver Momodi's letter to Fridurih at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_TODO_06: Deliver Momodi's letter to Katherine at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_TODO_09: Speak with Raubahn on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_THANCRED_000_000: The Antecedent bid me tell you to make for Vesper Bay, where young Alphinaud awaits your coming most eagerly. It was he who requested your assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_THANCRED_000_001: Some commotion or incident─I am not privy to the details.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_THANCRED_000_002: While you do whatever it is that Alphinaud has planned for you, I shall endeavor to track down our traitorous Brass Blade. And when I do, you may rest assured that we will have our answers.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_THANCRED_000_005: You do know Alphinaud hates to be kept waiting, don't you? Ah, but of course you do. Carry on, then.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_010: You are late. No matter─I know where our visitors are headed. From what I have been able to gather, this vessel belongs to a band of Domans who seek an audience with the sultana. You are familiar with Doma, yes? In Othard?
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Well, like the rest of the nations of the eastern continent, it is ruled by the Garlean Empire. Given our visitors' unannounced arrival, as well as the state of their ship, I suspect they did not leave their homeland under the best circumstances. Needless to say, I should be very interested to hear their tale and, more importantly, what they know of the current state of affairs in the Empire. Such information could prove most useful.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_012: We would be fools not to pursue this opportunity, do you not think? Come with me to Ul'dah, . Unless I am mistaken─and I am rarely mistaken─we will find the Domans bickering with a Sultansworn on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_013:
...You are uncertain of your role in the proceedings? Insurance. If our guests are not themselves imperial agents, it seems fair to assume that they may be being pursued by some. And if not, who better than you to have on hand in the event of an unforeseen diplomatic incident?
Besides, I do so enjoy your sparkling repartee. Satisfied? Good. I shall see you in Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KASASAGI_000_014: Who are you to address us with such disrespect!?
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KIKYOU_000_015: It is imperative that you allow us to enter!
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_BARTHOLOMEW_000_016: It is as I told you, madam! None shall be granted an audience without the necessary permissions!
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_017: You comprehend not the pressing nature of our suit, sir. If you would but summon your superior, I could explain...
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_BARTHOLOMEW_000_020: It matters not how many times you ask! Without the necessary permissions, none shall pass!
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_021: (-Refugee Leader-)Pray understand, good sir! We have not the leisure to lodge a formal petition. Time is of the essence.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_022: (-Refugee Leader-)All I ask is that you summon your superior. Allow me to plead my case. Surely you can grant us that small kindness?
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_BARTHOLOMEW_000_023: Away with you, and darken these doors no longer. I will not ask again!
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_024: (-Refugee Leader-)You know not what you do...
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_025: I gather your pleas fell upon deaf ears.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_026: (-Refugee Leader-)A loyal man with a cold heart. I know his kind well.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_027: I hope that you will find me more to your liking. Alphinaud Leveilleur, at your service. A friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_028: Which, I believe, makes me very nearly unique─in this part of the world, at least. Few indeed are your allies in Ul'dah. Yet you will need some if you wish to endear yourselves to the wealthy and powerful.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_029: Pray join me and my associate at the Quicksand. There you may explain your situation to us, and we shall see if there is aught we can do to help.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_029: Master Alphinaud's associate, yes? We have been waiting for you. I trust you are ready to begin?
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KASASAGI_000_029: We would be most grateful for any assistance you and Master Alphinaud can offer.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KIKYOU_000_029: It has been ever so long since we last set foot on dry land. I truly hope this marks the end of our journey.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KASASAGI_000_030: We are grateful beyond measure for this kindness.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KIKYOU_000_030: Lady Yugiri labors day and night for the good of our people. She is an inspiration to us all...yet I worry for her health.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_030: If I may, ─as I said earlier, we have been at sea for some several moons, and our supplies are all but spent.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_031: I have not the heart to repeat the tales of our tribulations, nor would it please you to listen to them, I think. Suffice it to say, however...sacrifices have been made.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_032: Though it shames me to beg for more when you have already offered so much, desperation compels me... , if you or your associates could spare any provisions─anything at all─it would go a long way to lessen the suffering of my people.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_035: Anything you can provide would be welcome. The adults can go without, but the children...
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_MOMODI_000_040: ...Hells, why didn't you say so sooner, ? 'Course I'll help! You couldn't have picked a better day, to tell the truth! A wealthy merchant an' his entourage were due to have a banquet here on the morrow, see, but just sent word they can't come, meanin' I've got a boatload of foodstuffs an' no one to feed. Best of all, they paid for the lot in advance! Hah hah!
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_MOMODI_000_041: Go an' call on Fridurih an' Katherine at the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. Tell 'em I said to ship the little prince's order to the Wakin' Sands. Oh, an' if they argue, just show 'em those letters. That should set 'em straight.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_060: I would not ask if the circumstances were not dire. Please─any provisions you can spare would be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_FRIDURIH_000_050: She's in the business of feedin' refugees now? I ain't normally one to question Mistress Momodi's judgment, but that doesn't seem wise to me.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_FRIDURIH_000_051: I'll not speak for the children, but if you ask me, any man what can't earn a crust deserves to go hungry.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KATHERINE_000_055: My, that's a rather odd request. Mayhap you misheard her instructions?
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KATHERINE_000_056: You know, you shouldn't encourage them like this. They'll start to expect it, you mark my words!
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_MOMODI_000_059: They didn't give you any trouble, did they? Good. Now go an' tell Lady Yugiri it's all in hand.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_061: I...I dared not hope for such magnanimity, much less expect it! Mistress Momodi is generous indeed... I shall be sure to thank her most humbly.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Lady Yugiri, I briefed the Flame General on your situation. I think you will be pleased with his reply.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_071: We have been granted an audience?
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_072: Before the sultana and the Syndicate both. We should return to the Royal Promenade at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_073: You have done much for us, Master Alphinaud. I swear we shall return the favor.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_074: Naught is owed, Lady Yugiri, for naught has been given. This small favor, you fairly won with your words. And it is with words that you must win the favor of the Syndicate.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_075: Then I shall choose them with care.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_076: You will be accompanying us, yes? Good. Your presence may serve to remind the Syndicate of the true meaning of philanthropy─and that nothing so unpalatable will be required of them, assuming the Domans are willing to earn their keep. Come, the Flame General awaits us on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_ALPHINAUD_000_080: We must take pains to illustrate how accepting the Domans would benefit Ul'dah. Only then might the Syndicate be swayed.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_YUGIRI_000_080: Bards sing of wars which decided the fates of nations, but a single word spoken within a council chamber is more like to decide that of mine own...
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KASASAGI_000_080: If we are all enemies of Garlemald, is it not fitting that we should join forces?
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_KIKYOU_000_080: I have heard that the sultana is a kind and generous ruler. Of the Syndicate, I have heard less flattering things.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: I wished to greet our guests beforehand and offer my support for their cause. Doman, Ul'dahn, it matters not to me; birthplace does not equate to birthright in mine eyes.
I take great pride in my establishments for this very reason. The Platinum Mirage, in particular, serves as a showcase for the talents of countless men and women born beyond our borders.
TEXT_GAIUSE203_01347_RAUBAHN_000_100: A pleasure, . The others are already inside. Let's not keep them waiting.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_SEQ_00: At long last, Hozan and his group are ready to leave Vesper Bay.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_SEQ_01: The road to Ul'dah may be regularly patrolled by the Brass Blades, but Hozan craves the peace of mind your presence would bring, and has thus requested that you accompany his party to Ul'dah. Speak with the coachman when you are ready to leave.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_SEQ_02: The coachman is concerned about recent sightings of a fearsome beast near the bridge to Hammerlea, and asks that you travel ahead of the carriage to survey the area. Should you encounter the creature in question, you are to assess the threat it poses, and take appropriate action.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_SEQ_03: Thanks to you, the road is now safe for travel once more. Retrace your steps and look for the carriage and its coachman outside Horizon.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_SEQ_04: As Hozan and Homei wax poetical about the debt they owe Yugiri, Yozan and Koharu push the two adults aside and begin peppering you with questions. Your motivations, your experiences, your secrets─they would know them all and more. Fortunately, Hozan intervenes before they have a chance to ask you anything too embarrassing. Plainly fascinated by your chosen way of life, the two children resolve there and then to form a Doman Adventurers' Guild once they reach Revenant's Toll. First, however, they must rest awhile in Ul'dah. Report the group's safe arrival to Alphinaud in the Quicksand.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_SEQ_05: In a manner you have long since grown accustomed to, Alphinaud begins to speak of your next assignment having scarcely acknowledged the completion of the last. Stifle the sigh that longs to be set free and ask your fellow Scion for further details.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_TODO_01: Survey the road to Ul'dah for any dangerous beasts.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_TODO_02: Speak with the Hyuran coachman outside Horizon.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_TODO_03: Speak with Alphinaud at the Quicksand.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_000: The first caravan is due to depart shortly, followed by the rest at regular intervals. My family and I─including my stubborn old father Homei─will be traveling in the lead carriage together with young Koharu, whom I believe you've already met.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_001: Though I understand the road to Ul'dah is regularly patrolled by your Brass Blades, it would give us great comfort if you would agree to accompany us on our journey...
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_002: Once again, I thank you for your kindness. When you are ready to leave, please inform our coachman.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUMEI_000_005: A giant bird that one rides as if it were a horse? What a curious creature...
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_GYOSHA01348_000_010: Eager to be off, are ye? Aye, well, I was meanin' to have a word with ye about that. Runner from the Blades says we might have a problem.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_GYOSHA01348_000_011: A fierce-lookin' beastie's been sighted south of the bridge to Hammerlea. Might be as someone's eyes are playin' tricks on 'em, o' course, but it don't pay to gamble in this business.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_GYOSHA01348_000_012: Now I know ye can handle yerself in a fight, but this lot here's another story. So I was thinkin' ye might go on ahead an' have a quick look around─make sure the area's safe, like. An' if ye come across anythin' dangerous, ye know what to do.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_GYOSHA01348_000_013: When yer satisfied the way's clear, meet us outside Horizon. The Blades tell me the road there's safe, so I reckon we can make it that far on our own─assumin' the selfsame bastards don't try to rob us, that is.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_GYOSHA01348_000_015: You go on ahead, , an' meet us in Horizon when yer satisfied our beastie problem's solved. We'll be on our way soon enough.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_015: These reports of a great beast on the road to Ul'dah are most troubling...
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUMEI_000_015: Fascinating creatures... Whence did they come?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_015: Ugh, Grandfather is so lucky. These─hurk!─horsebirds smell terrible!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUMEI_000_020: I must say, that was a surprisingly pleasant ride! Mayhap the journey to Revenant's Toll will not be so bad after all.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_020: It pleases me to see you well. Come, let the coachman know we can continue onward to Ul'dah.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_020: Which do you think would win in a race? A horse or a horsebird?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_020: They have wings, so does that mean they can fly? And does that mean we can fly if we ride one!?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_GYOSHA01348_100_020: So there was a beastie! “Was” bein' the operative word, eh!? Hah hah!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_021: Well fought, , well fought! Ah, if only I were in better health, I should have been proud to stand at your side!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUMEI_000_022: Pay my son no mind. He forgets that his responsibilities preclude acts of derring-do.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_023: Hmph. Be that as it may, I cannot help but envy you. Had we been able to call upon heroes of your strength and skill in Doma, things would have been very different.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_024: <sigh> But we cannot change the past. Those who fought─and fell─are forever lost to us.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUMEI_000_025: Lost but not forgotten─Lady Yugiri's kinsmen least of all. They fought fiercest, though they knew full well it was in vain.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUMEI_000_026: She had every right to walk away, yet she chose to stay. Food, shelter, the promise of a better life─all this and more we owe to her. How does one even begin to repay such a debt?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_027: In kind, Father. To she who has given everything, we shall give our all.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_028: Whatever work there is to be done we shall do without question. Ditch digging, bricklaying, it matters not─Revenant's Toll will grow and prosper by our hands.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_029: Hey,  ! Koharu and I want to know why you became an adventurer!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_Q1_000_000: Why did you become an adventurer?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_A1_000_004: To go whither the wild rose blooms.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_030: I knew it! That's what I told Koharu, but she didn't believe me.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_031: Glory? Ah, like bringing honor to your family, you mean!? Yes, Father always goes on about that.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_032: Money, eh? Yes, I want money, too. I could do a lot of things if I had some─well, any...
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_033: So...you like roses? I think I understand... I mean, they're nice and everything... But don't they grow in lots of places?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_034: It's my turn now! Excuse me,  ! I've got a question! What's Revenant's Toll like? Is it pretty?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_Q2_000_000: How would you describe Revenant's Toll?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_A2_000_000: It is a bustling outpost frequented by countless adventurers.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_A2_000_001: It is a bastion of civilization in a harsh and unforgiving wilderness.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_A2_000_002: It is home to the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_A2_000_003: It is...a stone's throw from an imperial castrum?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_035: You mean...there are lots of people there who are just as strong as you!? Oh, I can't wait!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_036: So...there are lots of rocks and things? It sounds a bit scary...but you'll be there too, won't you?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_037: Oh, so you live there with your friends! That means you'll always be there to protect us!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_038: Ha! You can't fool me! No one would ever live that close to a castrum. Liar, liar, breeches on fire!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_039: Enough, Koharu! It's my turn again!  ─when I'm older, I want to be strong like you. What do I have to do?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_Q3_000_000: What is the best way to become more powerful?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_A3_000_001: Seek out new experiences and adventures.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_A3_000_004: Buy weapons and armor from Rowena.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_040: Of course! To be a better adventurer, you need to go adventuring!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_041: Like that thing you fought earlier, you mean? Right, right!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_042: Aha! So my father was right! How do you do it, then? Come on, tell me! And don't leave anything out!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_043: Rowena? Is she nice? Are her weapons cheap? I don't have any money at the moment, but my father might. I'll have to ask him.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_044: All right, all right─ That's enough questions for  .
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_045: That's not fair! Why does Yozan get to ask two questions? I want to know about adventuring just as much as he does...
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_046: Just one more─please! Do you think I could be an adventurer like you one day?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_047: Really!? Then I will! Thanks for the advice,  . I won't forget it!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_048: I'm going to be an adventurer too!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_049: When we get to Revenant's Toll, let's make an Adventurers' Guild for Domans!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_050: We'll protect our friends and punish the wicked─just like   and Lady Yugiri!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_051: Yeah! Just like   and Lady Yugiri!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_052: We can talk more about it in the carriage on the way. Will you be joining us?
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_HOUZAN_000_060: It will be good to sleep in a proper bed for a change, even if it's only for a night.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YOUZAN_000_060: I bet they could keep out an entire legion with those walls!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KOHARU_000_060: How many steps are there? A hundred? I'm going to count!
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_GYOSHA01348_000_060: Mind lettin' Master Alphinaud know we're here? I need to stay with the birds.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_YUGIRI_000_060: I pray they do not grow too accustomed to this treatment. It is a welcome respite, to be sure, but a far cry from what we can expect in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_KIKYOU_000_060: Has the first group arrived already? Wonderful! Pray inform Master Alphinaud at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Ah, . I take it the first group has arrived? Excellent.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Hm? Is there aught else? No, no. I have matters well in hand here. You and Lady Yugiri should travel to Revenant's Toll forthwith.
TEXT_GAIUSE208_01352_POP_MESSAGE: You feel an eye upon you...
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_SEQ_00: Minfilia wishes to share some final words on the coming mission prior to departing for Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_SEQ_01: Minfilia impresses upon you the urgency of your mission to prevent Leviathan's return. Make for Limsa Lominsa without delay, and report to Admiral Merlwyb in her command room. Speak with Zanthael at Bulwark Hall to be granted admittance.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_SEQ_02: In the command room, the Admiral informs you that Maelstrom scouts have been dispatched to reconnoiter Sahagin movement within the Sapsa Spawning Grounds. Make your way to Camp Skull Valley in western La Noscea, and request the latest intelligence from Commander Falkbryda.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_SEQ_03: You have arrived at Camp Skull Valley, the operation's staging point. Be at ease for now and await further instructions.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_TODO_00: Speak with Merlwyb at the command room in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_TODO_01: Speak with Falkbryda at Camp Skull Valley.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_000: Plainly, should the worst come to pass, and Leviathan is summoned, our only recourse will be to face him in battle. Given past experience, you may very well think that eventuality inevitable...
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_001: Yet so long as there is even a chance that the primal's return might be prevented, we must needs bend all our efforts toward achieving that goal.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_002: Before we do aught else, let us hasten to Limsa Lominsa and meet with the Admiral.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_003: She will not have been idle in the intervening time, and will doubtless have valuable information to share.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_005: So long as there is even a chance that the primal's return might be prevented, we must needs bend all our efforts toward achieving that goal.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_006: Before we do aught else, let us hasten to Limsa Lominsa and meet with the Admiral. As I am sure you recall, her command room is accessible via the Admiral's Lift at Bulwark Hall.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_ZANTHAEL_000_010: You are expected. Pray take this lift to the command room.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_011: Welcome, friends. I take it Y'shtola has apprised you of the situation?
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_012: Let us waste no time, then. According to our best intelligence, the Sahagin had not crystals enough to summon their god.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_013: Alas, we did not count on the Serpent Reavers venturing as far as Thanalan to supplement their cache. For our shortsightedness, we are faced with the grim prospect of Leviathan's imminent return.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_0143: Needless to say, I am not inclined to let the fishbacks have their way. Even as we speak, the Maelstrom makes ready to launch a large-scale operation to thwart the summoning, and we would welcome the Scions' support in this endeavor.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_015: ...But if, gods forbid, our efforts should come to naught, I will need to trouble you for more than mere support─much as I did when Titan last walked these lands.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_016: Lady Minfilia, I am given to understand that you mean to accompany our soldiers to the front lines. I can only assume that you have sound reasons for doing so?
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_017: I do, Admiral. But I would rather not be drawn on their nature. I will say only that there is something I would see with mine own eyes.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_018: Is that so? ...Well, I am not so stubborn as to deny the wish of one whose aid I require─but precautions must be taken. I shall require that you remain by my side at all times. With that settled, let us speak of the operation.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_019: ─ scouts are currently reconnoitering Sahagin movements within the Sapsa Spawning Grounds.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_020: Upon completing their mission, they will return to the operation's staging point at Camp Skull Valley. I want you to make your way there forthwith, that you might be apprised of the latest intelligence. Commander Falkbryda has charge of the garrison.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MERLWYB_000_021: In case I wasn't clear: time is short, . Make haste to Camp Skull Valley and request the latest intelligence from Commander Falkbryda.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_MINFILIA_000_022: There may not be a better chance to learn the true nature of the Echo. I cannot well allow the opportunity to pass me by.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_FALKBRYDA_000_030: I've been expecting you, Scion of the Seventh Dawn. On behalf of the men and women here, I thank you for your cooperation.
TEXT_GAIUSE212_01356_FALKBRYDA_000_031: The safety of our citizens is paramount. With your aid, we will prevent Leviathan's return.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_SEQ_00: Falkbryda is growing ever more agitated by the minute.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_SEQ_01: Falkbryda's scouts are late to return, and she is beginning to fear for them. She bids you ascertain their fate, and furnishes you with a flask of restorative on the chance that her men are injured. Start your search by focusing on the entrance to the Sapsa Spawning Grounds, and treat any wounded you find.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_SEQ_02: You have located one of the scouts and given him the restorative. According to the soldier, he alone managed to flee from an ambush, while his comrades were captured and taken to the Serpent's Tongue. Though Falkbryda expressly forbade venturing too deep into enemy territory, in the name of camaraderie, you resolve to find and rescue the remaining scouts.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_SEQ_03: You are assailed by a trio of Serpent Reavers, but succeed in vanquishing them. Alas, you have arrived too late to save two of the scouts, who were slain in captivity. The coast being clear, you are free to pick up the corpses of the hapless soldiers, unpleasant though the task may be.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_SEQ_04: You have collected the soldiers' corpses. See them returned to Falkbryda at Camp Skull Valley, that they might receive a proper burial.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_SEQ_05: Falkbryda cannot hide her anguish at the brutal end her soldiers met, and hopes that the men still missing did not suffer the same fate. Though the price was dear, the Maelstrom now has the intelligence it sought, and the operation may commence. See to your preparations, and be ready to move out at a moment's notice.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_TODO_00: Use the Maelstrom restorative on the wounded storm private.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_TODO_01: Find the missing scouts within the Serpent's Tongue.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_TODO_03: Deliver the soldiers' corpses to Falkbryda.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_100_001: As you may already know, Maelstrom scouts have been dispatched to reconnoiter the Sapsa Spawning Grounds.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_100_002: Though it pains me to admit it, the Maelstrom has never faced a foe the likes of this before. We must proceed with all due caution.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_100_003: Among other things, they have orders to determine where Leviathan might emerge...assuming it comes to that.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_000: And yet...their return is long overdue. I fear that ill may have befallen them.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_001: For better or worse, we must ascertain their fate. If it is not too much to ask, I would have you aid us in the search.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_002: Five scouts ventured into Sapsa all told. Here, take this flask of restorative to tend those who may have been wounded.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_003: Though it pains me to even consider the notion, if they have perished, circumstances permitting, I ask that you recover their bodies. By no means venture too deep into enemy territory, however─we can ill afford to lose you at this juncture.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_005: Five scouts ventured into Sapsa all told. Use the restorative to tend to those who may have been wounded.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_006: Should it come to light that they have perished, circumstances permitting, I ask that you recover their bodies. By no means venture too deep into enemy territory, however─we can ill afford to lose you at this juncture.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_010: Help... Somebody... Of all the times...to forget the restorative... Urgh...
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_011: Thank you... I owe you my life...
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_012: We were ambushed by the Serpent Reavers. Lightly armed as we are, we didn't stand a chance.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_013: I was able to flee this far, but the others were captured. They were taken to the Serpent's Tongue, I'm certain of it.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_014: I can make my own way back to camp, but I fear the worst for my comrades... Save them, I beg you!
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_BALLOON_000_015:
Looky 'ere, lads! Fresh
meat fer the larder!
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_020: You're returned, thank the Navigator! When I learned that you went to the Serpent's Tongue by yourself, I feared you would meet an untimely demise! But tell me, what became of the others?
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_021: Dear gods... <sob> These wounds were not intended to kill, but to torture and maim... Does their savagery know no bounds!? Enemies or no, they go too far!
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_022: I dread to think what may have become of the two who remain unaccounted for... I pray that they haven't suffered the same evil fate.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_023: At the very least, one of my men came back alive, and for that I owe you my thanks. The price we paid was dear, but we have the intelligence we need.
TEXT_GAIUSE214_01358_FALKBRYDA_000_024: Even as we speak, the Admiral finalizes the details of the operation. The warhorns will sound any moment now. Be ready to sally forth when they do.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_SEQ_00: Falkbryda awaits the commencement of the operation with barely concealed rage.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_SEQ_01: Having made her final assessment of the situation, Merlwyb gives the order for the operation to commence. According to the scout you rescued, the summoning ritual is being held at the beastman aetheryte situated deep within the Sapsa Spawning Grounds. Accompany Y'shtola into the Sahagin lair, and fight your way to the aetheryte.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_SEQ_02: Upon passing the first checkpoint, you are assailed by Sahagin guards, whom you swiftly vanquish. Make haste now for the next checkpoint.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_SEQ_03: You have made your way through the next checkpoint, dispatching the Sahagin that barred your way. Make haste now for the final checkpoint.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_SEQ_04: Leaving a river of Sahagin blood in your wake, you have made it through the final checkpoint. Continue on and rejoin Y'shtola.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_SEQ_05: Despite your best efforts, the summoning ritual is completed and Leviathan is come once more. But no sooner did the primal manifest than he bent his course for the open sea. Her voice laden with dread, Merlwyb expresses her fear that Leviathan means to unleash a tidal wave. Speak with her again, that you might better understand the impending danger.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_SEQ_06: According to Merlwyb, the destructive potential of Leviathan's tidal wave far surpasses anything that occurs in nature. If the primal is not stopped, whole settlements will be laid waste. But with the Lord of the Whorl already far out to sea, how can such a disaster be prevented?
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_TODO_00: Go through the first checkpoint and defeat any Sahagin that appear.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_TODO_01: Go through the second checkpoint and defeat any Sahagin that appear.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_TODO_02: Go through the final checkpoint and defeat any Sahagin that appear.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_TODO_04: Speak with Merlwyb at the Sapsa Spawning Grounds.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_FALKBRYDA_000_000: Thrice-damned fishback bastards... I'll kill them slowly and then chase their rotten souls through all seven hells!
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_001: Peace, Commander. We are here for a purpose─and vengeance is not it. I want your mind on the task at hand, savvy?
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_FALKBRYDA_000_002: M-My apologies, Admiral. You may count on me to keep a clear head.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_003: Good. According to our sole surviving scout, the Sahagin and their thralls have already begun to amass at the aetheryte in the depths of Sapsa. If we are to act, it must be now.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_FALKBRYDA_000_004: The men are ready. We but await your orders, Admiral. As predicted, the Sahagin have tightened security in and around the spawning grounds. A frontal assault is like to be met with fierce resistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_005: Ah, but we are not so artless as that, Commander. We shall divide our forces and strike them hard and fast at key locations. Remember: our ultimate objective is to take the Sapsa aetheryte and eliminate the Sahagin priest presiding over the summoning─we are not here to kill them all.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_006: The Maelstrom shall engage and distract the Sahagin's legion of drowned pirates at the Serpent's Tongue. Commander, you have charge over this effort.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_007: Be mindful that the lay of the land there is devilish for attacking forces. Let the Foreign Levy spearhead the assault, and have subsequent units fan out to cover their flanks.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_008: At the selfsame moment, a diversionary squadron formed of galleons from the Crimson Fleet shall harry the enemy from offshore.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MINFILIA_000_009: In like wise, we Scions shall form smaller units in hopes of confusing the Sahagin defensive effort.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MINFILIA_000_010: and Y'shtola, the two of you are to make your way to the site of the summoning ritual.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MINFILIA_000_011: The Admiral's diversions should serve to thin the enemy's defenses, rendering your path less perilous.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MINFILIA_000_012: A small party, I believe, should be able to win through without drawing unwarranted attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MINFILIA_000_013: Thancred and Yugiri, your mission is to lure as many Sahagin as possible out of the spawning grounds.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MINFILIA_000_014: Having done so, take to your heels and circle 'round to join the infiltration unit of Y'shtola and .
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_015: When all has been set in motion, I myself shall cut a path to the aetheryte, accompanied by Lady Minfilia, as was agreed.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_016: Well, don't let me keep you, friends! ...TO BATTLE!
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_YSHTOLA_000_017: ...When last did we fight side by side, ? Too long ago, I warrant. But come, let us away!
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_KOKKAGUNNSOU01359_0: To get to the fishbacks' aetheryte, ye'll need to fight yer way through three checkpoints in all. No small task, that...but at least ye won't have so many drowned pirate curs to worry about. Me an' the lads'll be keepin' 'em niiice an' busy for ye!
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_POP_MESSAGE: The Sahagin have been alerted to your presence!
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_BALLOON_000_023: You will pay with your livesss!
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_YSHTOLA_000_020: Pray do not concern yourself─'twas but a glancing blow. Come, the aetheryte is close at hand─let us press on!
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_020: Understand─I speak of no normal wall of water. That which Leviathan makes ready to conjure carries more destructive power than aught seen in nature.
TEXT_GAIUSE215_01359_MERLWYB_000_021: ...Enough to raze entire coastal settlements, if his last attempt is any guide. We cannot suffer history to be repeated...yet how in the seven hells are we to prevent it?
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_SEQ_00: Merlwyb is brooding over Leviathan's return.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_SEQ_01: Conceding that little can be done to thwart Leviathan's plans so long as he remains in the open sea, Merlwyb bids you join her in Limsa Lominsa to assess the available options. As always, speak with the guardsman Zanthael in Bulwark Hall to be admitted to the command room.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_SEQ_02: Before a hushed audience, Merlwyb recounts the tale of Halfstone, a hamlet obliterated by a tidal wave of Leviathan's making. The need for action is plain, but it soon becomes clear that neither the Admiral nor your fellow Scions know of any means to vie with the Lord of the Whorl upon the open sea. It is then that Storm Marshal Eynzahr steps forward with a most unorthodox proposal: to use the power of corrupted crystals, borne upon an improvised twin vessel, to rob Leviathan of his command over the element of water. Being the best─and only─plan available, all involved swiftly agree to support the endeavor, yet you cannot help but wonder at its ambition. Perhaps it would be useful to ask Yugiri for her opinion on the matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_SEQ_03: The Maelstrom has caught wind of a man who claims to have felled the mighty Leviathan. Though it seems unlikely that there is any truth to this rumor, thoroughness demands that you determine its authenticity. Make your way to the Grey Fleet in lower La Noscea, and seek out the fellow in question.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_SEQ_04: You arrive at the Grey Fleet to find your old friend Trachtoum being his usual blustering self. Though it is immediately clear that your time has indeed been wasted, you cannot help but feel a sense of relief. After all, had the fanciful claims come from a more artful liar's lips, it might have taken you days to disprove them. No sooner have you had this thought than Minfilia contacts you via linkpearl with news that the twin vessel is ready. Proceed to the Moraby Drydocks and report to Eynzahr.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_SEQ_05: Eynzahr confirms that the moment of truth is at hand. You need but signal your readiness and the Whorleater will bear you forth to your meeting with Leviathan. Brace yourself, for this voyage shall take you through the heart of the maelstrom.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TODO_00: Speak with Merlwyb in the command room in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TODO_01: Speak with Yugiri in the command room.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TODO_02: Speak with the storm private at the Grey Fleet.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TODO_03: Report to Eynzahr at the Moraby Drydocks.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_000: Though our plight cries out for action, we must take thought.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_001: So long as Leviathan remains in the open sea, he is effectively beyond our reach. Our fleet is second to none, of that you may be sure─but Llymlaen Herself would struggle to best the Lord of the Whorl in his element. In a straight fight, he would make meat and matchwood of us.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_002: We need another plan, that much is plain. Let us return to Limsa and see if we cannot think of one. I shall await you in the command room.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_ZANTHAEL_000_010: You are expected in the command room. Pray do not keep the Admiral waiting.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_020: I have my people working triple shifts on the twin vessel, but it will take some time yet. Time we may not have. Seven hells...this waiting is liable to drive the lot of us mad.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MINFILIA_000_020: The Sahagin elder claimed to have become “eternal,” yet he was summarily consumed by Leviathan. What might this imply...?
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_THANCRED_000_030: Being the observant adventurer that you are, you will doubtless have noticed my dagger work back at Sapsa. You know me, ─I like to dabble in a bit of this and a bit of that.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_YSHTOLA_000_040: To confront the Lord of the Whorl in his watery domain is far from ideal, yet he is not like to come to us. <sigh> Would that he lacked the means to strike us from afar...
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_YUGIRI_000_050: When I saw Leviathan rise from the depths, I cannot well describe what I felt. No words could prepare one for such a sight.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: If Leviathan is allowed to unleash a tidal wave, nothing within ten malms of the coast will be safe, let alone Limsa. I trust you see what's at stake here.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_YUGIRI_000_070: Beings held as gods also exist in what you call the Far East.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_YUGIRI_000_071: Legends tell us that they walked among us in days of yore, but I confess that I never truly believed them. That I should live to behold one is...humbling and horrifying in equal measure.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_YUGIRI_000_072: Now that I have come face-to-face with a primal, I do begin to understand why the Garleans fear them so.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MAELSTROM01360_000_: A message, Admiral! I judged it best that it be delivered at once!
According to the Yellowjackets, a man has appeared who claims to have defeated Leviathan.
The details are yet hazy, Admiral. We have dispatched one of our own to question the individual.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_100_079: Hm. I am disinclined to put any store by this claim. And even should it be true, it is as Y'shtola said: none save the Company of Heroes have bested Leviathan, and we know how they went about it. If this man is of their number, what could he tell us that we do not know already?
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_080: ...And yet, having wagered Limsa's survival on two ships, some rope, and a pile of crystals, can we afford to ignore this man? If his testimony could yield us any manner of advantage, should we not hear it? Damn it all...
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_081: The twin vessel will soon be ready. We have no time to wait for the Maelstrom's report on this supposed primal-slayer's claims. ─seek him out and learn what he knows. At the very least, it will spare you the torment of waiting for the reckoning in idleness.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MAELSTROM01360_000_: The man you are looking for is believed to be a resident of the Grey Fleet, in lower La Noscea. The storm private sent to question him should already be in the vicinity. May your journey prove fruitful!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_090: Were our plight any less grim, I should not ask this of you, ─but grim it is, and here we are. Go to the Grey Fleet, and find out what your fellow primal-slayer knows─if primal-slayer he be. Oh, and you have my permission to break his bloody legs if he's lying.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_100: Now look here, you! Ye'll have yer bloody story...right after ye carry those sacks of grain over to the mill!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_STORMPRIVATE01360_0: B-But, sir...that's what you said before you had me pick those oranges for you. And before I mucked out the chocobo stables. And before I rolled that millstone over to the mill. And also before─
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_102: Gods, man! I've worked three days straight without a wink of sleep! Three days! An' do ye hear me complainin'!?
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_103: Bah... I s'pose some of us just ain't made for the rougher stuff. All right, all right...I'll give ye what ye want. Never let it be said that ol' Trachtoum ain't a generous soul.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_104: Now prick up yer ears, 'cause I won't be repeatin' meself. Too modest, see? Besides, there's only so much epicness a man can take in one sittin', ye ken?
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_105: Ahem! The tale of Trachtoum's epic victory over the dread primal Leviabeetus!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_106: Now, Leviabeetus's huge, make no mistake. To give ye an idea how big, each of his scales is about as wide across as me member's long─an' that's no mean feat, let me tell ye!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_107: When I fought him, I could barely see fer all the brine he was peltin' me with. Must've been a lagoon's worth at least. He even knocked me trusty axe out of me hands at one stage... 'Course, that proved to be a grave mistake... Heh heh heh...
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_109: Why, I grabbed him by the tail an' tied him up in knots! But not wantin' to take all the glory fer meself, I let me mates in the Company of Heroes handle the rest. Like I said, I'm modest as well as heroic! Mayhap too modest... Now, there's some as say ye can never truly beat Leviabeetus─that ye've got to learn to live with him an' make the best of a bad situation. Not the Company, though!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_111: I'm sorry! I didn't mean it! I was just enjoyin' the attention, is all! I take back everythin' I said!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_112: I was never part of the Company of Heroes! I'm no marauder! I'm actually a complete coward! I'm nothin'! I'm chocobo dung! No, I'm the maggots ye find wrigglin' in chocobo dung! I have to lie to women to tumble 'em, an' that don't happen much! Me member's tiny, it's pathetic!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_113: I sure as hells didn't fight Leviabeetus...but...but I have seen him with me own eyes!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_114: 'Twas a fair few years back, when I was workin' as a baker's hand. I was shirkin' me duties one day, loiterin' about the harbor, when I saw it...
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_115: ...A great big massive sea serpent some malms off the coast, with a fleet of galleons makin' straight for it, cannons firin'... I was so bloody scared, I soiled meself right there an' then!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_116: Wha─? Oh, gods... Jus' rememberin' that day made me soil meself all over again!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_117: H-Hey, wait... If yer here askin' after Leviabeetus...it means yer plannin' to fight him, ain't ye?
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_TRACHTOUM_000_118: Well...take care! He really is terrible! Dreadful, I tell ye! If yer not careful, ye'll end up in his gullet or at the bottom of the sea!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_STORMPRIVATE01360_0: Why, you worthless, lying whoreson! I can't believe you made me handle chocobo dung!
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MINFILIA_000_120: , this is Minfilia. Were you able to learn aught of use against Leviathan?
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MINFILIA_000_121: ...I beg your pardon? “Leviabeetus”? I see. That is unfortunate.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MINFILIA_000_122: At any rate, I have tidings for you: the twin vessel is now complete.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MINFILIA_000_123: We await you at the Moraby Drydocks. Pray make your way here as soon as you are able.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: I'm told your jaunt to the Grey Fleet proved fruitless. My sympathies, . I'll wager it served to take your mind off the events of recent days, though... But enough of that nonsense. The moment of truth is upon us.

The twin vessel─the Whorleater, I call her─is complete, and she surpasses all my expectations. In addition to her prodigious tonzage, she has been fitted with a platform, that you and yours might maneuver freely in battle. I would mention also that she is nigh unsinkable, but I'm not one to tempt fate.
The Whorleater and her crew stand ready, my friend. Just give the word, and we shall bear you to Leviathan.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MERLWYB_000_140:
In order to build the Whorleater, we had to decommission two perfectly serviceable galleons. Suffice it to say, their captains weren't best pleased with the notion. But when I offered them the chance to keep their ships and face Leviathan in our stead, they magnanimously withdrew their complaints.
“We must all make sacrifices for the greater good,” they said.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_MINFILIA_000_140: <sigh> Would that we had armed ourselves with more knowledge beforehand... Well, it cannot now be helped. I take comfort in the fact that you have faced worse odds in the past, and have ever prevailed. You will do so again, of that I have no doubt.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_THANCRED_000_140: To complete the twin vessel in so short a time, and with limited materials... The people of Naldiq & Vymelli's have won an admirer in me.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_YSHTOLA_000_140: It will require no small amount of helmsmanship to tow the Whorleater. I daresay delivering you safely to Leviathan will be a battle in itself.
TEXT_GAIUSE216_01360_YUGIRI_000_140: When first Master Eynzahr proposed the twin vessel, I must confess that I had my doubts. Only now that the Whorleater is complete do I see the elegance of this solution.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_SEQ_00: Eynzahr stands ready to send you off to your encounter with the Lord of the Whorl.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_SEQ_01:
With little more than a look, you signal your readiness to do battle with Leviathan. At your command, the twin vessel Whorleater will be towed out onto the open sea, where the Lord of the Whorl awaits you. The fate of Limsa Lominsa rests upon your shoulders. Do not falter.

※The Whorleater (Hard) can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_SEQ_02: Following a titanic struggle on the high seas, you succeed in vanquishing Leviathan. Make your way to Limsa Lominsa, that you might bask in the Admiral's gratitude. As always, speak with Zanthael in Bulwark Hall to be admitted to the command room.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_SEQ_03: You report your victory over Leviathan to a grateful Merlwyb, who pronounces you her nation's greatest ally. Apparently inspired by your philanthropic endeavors, she subsequently pledges to send provisions to the Doman refugees at Revenant's Toll. Keen to repay this act of kindness, Yugiri, in turn, offers to share knowledge of her Far Eastern martial art with any who would learn. In response to her concern that the style may seem outlandish to Eorzeans, Thancred reveals that there are individuals in Limsa Lominsa who are more than capable of adapting to the techniques. Though the details yet remain hazy, you sense that interesting times lie ahead for you and your fellow adventurers.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_TODO_01: Report to Merlwyb in the command room in Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_MERLWYB_000_000:
In order to build the Whorleater, we had to decommission two perfectly serviceable galleons. Suffice it to say, their captains weren't best pleased with the notion. But when I offered them the chance to keep their ships and face Leviathan in our stead, they magnanimously withdrew their complaints.
“We must all make sacrifices for the greater good,” they said.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_MINFILIA_000_000: <sigh> Would that we had armed ourselves with more knowledge beforehand... Well, it cannot now be helped. I take comfort in the fact that you have faced worse odds in the past, and have ever prevailed. You will do so again, of that I have no doubt.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_THANCRED_000_000: To complete the twin vessel in so short a time, and with limited materials... The people of Naldiq & Vymelli's have won an admirer in me.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_YSHTOLA_000_000: It will require no small amount of helmsmanship to tow the Whorleater. I daresay delivering you safely to Leviathan will be a battle in itself.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_YUGIRI_000_000: When first Master Eynzahr proposed the twin vessel, I must confess that I had my doubts. Only now that the Whorleater is complete do I see the elegance of this solution.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: Ah...I know that look. You are ready!
Having been constructed in some haste, the Whorleater may not be pretty, but I assure you she's capable.

She has been fitted with what our friends at Naldiq & Vymelli's are calling an “elemental converter.” Assuming the thing works, it will use the power of the corrupted crystals on board to rob Leviathan of his hold over water.
Depending on how the battle unfolds, you may well need to activate the device manually. Keep that in mind.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_MINFILIA_000_004: It is expected that the Sahagin and their thralls will attempt to come to Leviathan's defense. Accordingly, the Maelstrom will once again employ diversions. Thancred and Y'shtola, I would have you assist in this effort.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_YUGIRI_000_005: If it is to fulfill its purpose, your diversionary force must not want for numbers. By your leave, I too would volunteer my blade.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_MERLWYB_000_006: We would welcome it. Having seen you fight in Sapsa, I daresay the fishbacks will find your presence highly diverting. Thancred and Y'shtola, if you would join the 3rd Levy, and Lady Yugiri, the 5th.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_MERLWYB_000_007: ...But what words have I for the  who has made a sport of slaying gods? Only these: go warily, for the sea is an unforgiving place to wage war. May the Navigator guide you through the storm, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_MINFILIA_000_008: I would echo the Admiral's sentiments, and add a few words of mine own. Know that we all have the utmost faith in you, . May the Crystal bless and keep you!
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: When the battle is won and Leviathan's waves are stilled, we must partake of a barrel of something, you and I! I care not what, so long as it's strong enough to daze a primal, and plentiful enough to drown him! Har har!
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_STYRNLONA_000_011: Storm Sergeant Styrnlona, at your service! The Whorleater is loaded and ready, ! I'll give the signal for the towing vessel to weigh anchor as soon as you're aboard.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_STYRNLONA_000_012: There's not a soul among us who wouldn't lay down his life to ensure you reach your target, ─so you just concentrate on skewering that overgrown sea snake, and leave the rest to us!
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_STYRNLONA_000_013: By the Navigator...you did it! You defeated Leviathan in his own domain! I witnessed the battle from afar, saw the beast sink lifeless beneath the waves...and still I labor to believe it!
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_STYRNLONA_000_014: The Admiral had hoped to thank you the moment you came ashore, but she thought it meet to accompany the fleet back to Limsa. Pray present yourself to her at your earliest convenience. She will be eager to hear your account of the day's events!
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: A number of things did not go exactly to plan, I will admit. Leviathan denied us the luxury of ramming him, for one. But let's not quibble over the manner of the victory, eh? If Limsa is safe, and we are yet undrowned, I conclude that it has been a good day. Now go and bask in the Admiral's gratitude, will you? You have certainly earned the right!
