TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_MINFILIA_000_100: So often do you achieve the impossible that I fear my words of congratulations will begin to sound repetitive─if, indeed, they have not already... With this in mind, I shall say only that I am glad of your safe return.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_THANCRED_000_100: Another notch on the old belt, is it? Well done, my friend! Were I a god, I daresay I would tremble at your summoning.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_YSHTOLA_000_100: My congratulations, . This victory will serve to quiet the Sahagin...for a time, at least.
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_YUGIR_000_100: That such beings can be defeated runs contrary to all I know... Whence comes your strength and sense of purpose?
TEXT_GAIUSE217_01361_ZANTHAEL_000_110:
Knowing the urgency of your business, I thought it best to refrain from making conversation during your past few visits. But today I will permit myself a few words. Ahem. I feel truly privileged to have had the honor of admitting a hero such as you. You are an inspiration to us all, ! And on that note...
The Admiral awaits you in the command room. <wink>
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_SEQ_00: Zanthael has orders to point you in the direction of the Lominsan underworld.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_SEQ_01: Zanthael gives you a letter of introduction from Merlwyb, which should grant Yugiri access to the Lominsan underworld. Take the letter to the southern area of the lower decks, and show it to the inconspicuous man.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_SEQ_02: Despite Zanthael's earlier warnings, the inconspicuous man extends Yugiri the warmest of Lominsan welcomes. Duly heartened, she declares her intent to study the fighting techniques employed by his fraternity, and expresses her hope that you will be her student when the time is ripe.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_TODO_00: Deliver the Admiral's letter of introduction to the inconspicuous man.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_ZANTHAEL_000_000: The Admiral has informed me of the arrangement. I have in my keeping a letter of introduction for Lady Yugiri.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_ZANTHAEL_000_001: To the south stands a gate leading to a pier for smaller fishing vessels. Look for an inconspicuous Hyuran man there, and present the letter to him. He serves as a gatekeeper of sorts.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_ZANTHAEL_000_002: Now, before you go, I am obliged to remind you that the members of the, ahem, fraternity to which you would be introduced abide in the shadows of Lominsan society.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_ZANTHAEL_000_003: They value their independence more highly than pirates, and are united by a bond stronger than mythril. To wit, they are invariably wary of new faces.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_ZANTHAEL_000_004: Though it be penned by the Admiral herself, mere words on parchment will get you only so far into their confidence. You must work for every onze of trust they place in you.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_ZANTHAEL_000_005: But here is the letter. Go to the aforementioned place, and show it to the aforementioned man. Oh, and...good luck.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_UNDERGROUNDB01362_0: What? Didn't your mammy teach you it's rude to stare?
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_UNDERGROUNDA01362_0: So you're the  the Admiral sent word of.
I was hopin' I might catch a glimpse of Thancred, too─been a while since I saw his shite-eatin' grin. But what with all the doe-eyed wenches about, I 'spect he's got his hands full.
Ah, and you must be the Far Easterner what Merlwyb says wants to train with us. Welcome to Limsa, milady!
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_YUGIRI_000_023: I am Yugiri of Doma. 'Tis an honor to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_YUGIRI_000_024: I must confess, when first I learned of your organization, I had certain...preconceptions as to the nature of your membership. It would seem I was mistaken.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_UNDERGROUNDA01362_0: You're not the first person to say that, lass. Limsa's a city of pirates, to be sure, and pirates don't give two farts about keepin' a spotless reputation. They hardly need a secret society to do their dirty work.
Might be as my people and I keep to the shadows, but we've got nothin' to be ashamed of. It's simply better for business that we remain unseen.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_YUGIRI_000_027: And so you have developed fighting techniques suited to this purpose. I see. Know that the practitioners of my art, too, are denizens of shadow. 'Tis in stealth that our strength lies. There is much we might learn from one another, I think.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_UNDERGROUNDA01362_0: Then what in the seven hells are we waitin' for? If you'd come with us, Yugerry of Do-whatsit, we can get acquainted in more private surrounds... Hah, that didn't come out right, did it!?
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_YUGIRI_000_029: . I shall remain with these people for a time, that I might study their ways.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_YUGIRI_000_030: Though I am loath to be separated from my countrymen, I take solace in the knowledge that they are in the best of hands.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_YUGIRI_000_031: You have been a true friend to us Domans. No words would suffice to express my gratitude.
TEXT_GAIUSE218_01362_YUGIRI_000_032: Ere long, I hope to begin imparting my martial knowledge to the people of Eorzea. When that time comes, it would be my honor to welcome you as a student.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_SEQ_00: Yugiri has the air of a woman bursting with gratitude.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_SEQ_01: Before parting ways with you to study the secret fraternity's combat techniques, the ever-courteous Yugiri bids you relay her gratitude to Minfilia. For want of anything better to do, return to the Rising Stones at Revenant's Toll, and convey her sentiments to the Antecedent.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_SEQ_02: You arrive at the Rising Stones, resolved to pass on Yugiri's words of thanks, but before you are able to do so, Minfilia proceeds to externalize her thoughts with regard to recent events. Based on the phenomenon she observed in the moments prior to Leviathan's summoning, the Antecedent is convinced that the true nature of the Echo and the secret to defeating the Ascians now lie within reach. Even as she resolves to take action, however, Urianger bursts into the solar bearing grim tidings: the Isle of Val, home to the Students of Baldesion, has been destroyed by a spell like in power to Ultima...
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_TODO_00: Speak with Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_YUGIRI_000_000: Much and more has occurred since first I beheld Eorzea from the galleon's deck. Suffice it to say, I did not envisage being invited to play a part in your noble struggle.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_YUGIRI_000_001: But forgive me, I have kept you overlong. Doubtless you have pressing business of your own. Rest assured that I no longer require an escort in this land.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_YUGIRI_000_002: When next you meet Lady Minfilia, pray relay to her my humblest thanks. Would that I could do so in person, but I must needs fulfill my promise to the Admiral. Till we meet again, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_YUGIRI_000_010: When next you meet Lady Minfilia, pray relay to her my humblest thanks. Till we meet again, Warrior of Light.
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_UNDERGROUNDA01362_0: Cor, it's been ages since Thancred up and left the Sisters. What I wouldn't give to run with the old scoundrel again, just like back in the old days...
TEXT_GAIUSE219_01363_UNDERGROUNDB01362_0: Far Eastern combat art, eh? I must say, my curiosity's fairly piqued!
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_SEQ_00: Minfilia's thoughts keep returning to the fate of the Students of Baldesion.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_SEQ_01: Though she is deeply troubled by the fate of the Students of Baldesion, Minfilia concedes that idle speculation will achieve nothing, and resolves to turn her thoughts to matters closer to home. But even as she begins to brief you on recent events in the Twelveswood, F'lhaminn enters the solar and announces that refugees hailing from Ul'dah have come to Revenant's Toll in search of asylum, like the Domans before them. In the ensuing exchange, it becomes apparent that the Scions lack the resources to accommodate additional numbers, however grave the need. In spite of this, Minfilia declares her intention to hear the refugees' petition, and asks that you accompany her to the Seventh Heaven.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_SEQ_02: As Minfilia struggles to turn away the petitioners, Tataru interrupts the meeting to report that Alphinaud was injured during a riot precipitated by refugees in Ul'dah, and is now receiving care at the Hourglass. Fearing for the lives of his fellow refugees, the chief petitioner begs the Antecedent to intervene─only to be told that those responsible will have to answer for their actions. Paying the man no further heed, Minfilia orders you to make haste for Ul'dah, in case Alphinaud is in need of assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_SEQ_03: At the Hourglass, you are relieved to find that Alphinaud's condition is not so grave as you were given to believe. Sadly, the same cannot be said of Ul'dah. The riot, it seems, was the result of deep-seated tensions between refugees and Ul'dahn citizens, brought to the fore in the wake of the Domans' failed bid for asylum. To make matters worse, a large contingent of the Immortal Flames is currently engaged in joint training exercises, rendering the Grand Company undermanned at this critical juncture. By the time all forces have been recalled, Alphinaud fears that the situation may have deteriorated beyond mending.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_TODO_00: Speak with the refugees in the Seventh Heaven.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_000: Our friends...the very isle itself...everyone and everything...
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_001: ...No. No, it avails us naught to speculate. Urianger will send word if there are any developments. Until such time as he does, we must remain firmly focused on that which is within our power to change. With that in mind, I would speak of a different matter. One closer to home.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_002: It concerns aetheric fluctuations which we had previously attributed to Good King Moggle Mog XII.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_003: That the king is no more is a blessing for which we have you to thank.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_004: Yet all is not well in the Twelveswood. Our latest readings reveal an ongoing aetheric disturbance of considerable magnitude. They may even suggest the presence of a primal.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_005: Needless to say, the mere possibility warrants immediate investigation, and I would have you─
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_FLHAMINN_000_006: Ascilia? I do not wish to interrupt, but we have a problem.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_FLHAMINN_000_008: A band of refugees─hailing from Ul'dah, this time─are come to Revenant's Toll seeking asylum.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_FLHAMINN_000_009: It would seem they expect us to afford them the same treatment we gave the Domans. At present, they are in the Seventh Heaven, awaiting a formal response.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_010: ...I see. Mayhap this was to be expected. I shall meet with them at once.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_FLHAMINN_000_011: Ascilia. You know full well we haven't the resources to accommodate many more people. Consider what will happen if you do this. Word will spread, and more will follow.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_012: ...Your opinion is duly noted─but I will hear their suit.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_013: ─I should be grateful for your presence at this meeting.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_020: I am well aware that our resources are finite, but we have a responsibility to protect the people of Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_030: I apologize for keeping you waiting. My name is Minfilia, and I lead the Scions of the Seventh Dawn.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_REFUGEE01442_000_03: Twelve be praised, it is you!
We're ready and willin' to work, same as the Domans! Just give us a task, and we'll see it done!
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_033: Pray calm yourselves! I appreciate your enthusiasm, but I know naught of your situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_REFUGEE01442_000_03: Beg your pardon, Antecedent. I...I ain't so good with words.
We've been livin' off the scraps of Ul'dah for years now. Tryin' to piece together a life to replace the one what got took.
They say there's work, but there's naught for an honest man. Naught as wouldn't sully his soul sooner than his palms, anyroad. The Flames do what they can for us, o' course, but it ain't near enough.
And it's only gettin' worse. When the Calamity brought us to our knees, those rich bastards in the city didn't help us up─they climbed on our backs.
I don't pretend to be clever, but even I can see what's comin'. I knew we had to run, the only question was where. And then it came to me: Revenant's Toll!
I mean, you took them foreigners in, didn't you? So you'd surely do the same for us!
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_040: I... I fear the situation is rather more complicated. While it is true that we accepted the Domans' petition for aid, that decision was the product of extraordinary circumstances.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_041: I sympathize deeply with your plight, but pray understand that it is not possible for an organization of our means to aid all who have been affected by the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_042: And so it is with great regret that I must deny your request.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_REFUGEE01442_000_04: But... But we've nowhere else to go! You're turnin' your back on us!?
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_TATARU_000_044: If I might have a word...
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_TATARU_000_046: Ill tidings from Ul'dah, my lady. Alphinaud has...Alphinaud has been wounded!
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_TATARU_000_047: I cannot say for certain, but I fear it might be. According to the Flames, the refugees started a riot. They went wild, apparently─lashing out at any and everyone!
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_REFUGEE01442_000_04: That can't be right! Why would they? They must've been provoked! The demonstration was meant to be peaceful!
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_REFUGEE01442_000_05: Seven hells... Now the Blades have an excuse, they'll round us up and kill anyone who tries to resist!
Antecedent, please! If you won't help us build a new life, at least help us keep the ones we've got!
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_053: We are not ones to stand idly by and watch innocents suffer.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_054: However, until we know more of the circumstances surrounding this riot, I am not certain what aid, if any, we can provide.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_055: If the authorities determine that the refugees attacked without provocation, then those responsible will have to answer for their actions.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_REFUGEE01442_100_05: How can you be so blind...?
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_056: Find Alphinaud, and quickly. If he is in danger─or worse─I would have you and none other by his side.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_MINFILIA_000_057: Thank you. Pray do not concern yourself with the matter we were discussing earlier. Yda and Papalymo will see to it.
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_TATARU_000_058: Alphinaud is being treated at the Hourglass. Hurry, !
TEXT_GAIUSE301_01442_REFUGEE01442_000_06: Don't believe what they say! I know these people. They would only take up arms to defend themselves! If there was a riot, I swear to you they didn't start it!
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_00: Alphinaud wishes to investigate the circumstances surrounding the riot.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_01: Suspecting that the riot in which he was injured was not, in fact, a spontaneous outpouring of popular discontent, Alphinaud is eager to discuss the incident with General Raubahn. Follow him to the Hall of Flames and speak with the Flame General.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_02: During your conversation with General Raubahn, Alphinaud observes that the refugees were surprisingly well armed and suggests that the riot may have been instigated by outside forces. Before he can finish his thought, however, the Flame General interjects that the restoration of order is paramount, and that any official investigation will have to wait. Undeterred, Alphinaud resolves to conduct an investigation of his own. He suggests that you begin by finding out which settlements the Flames suspect may be harboring belligerents. Perhaps Commander Swift will be willing to share such information with you.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_03: After a moment's hesitation, Commander Swift reveals that the Brass Blades have reported suspicious activity in the vicinity of Lost Hope. Journey to the settlement in central Thanalan and investigate their claims.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_04: Leofric and Amalberga both make mention of a traveling merchant who recently left Lost Hope accompanied by a band of refugees. Apparently, another refugee by the name of Zazawaka was especially concerned by the merchant's behavior. Speak with him to learn more.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_05: You learn that the merchant was a fanatical revolutionary who came to Lost Hope in search of new recruits. Apparently, he offered the refugees a chance to hold the rulers of Ul'dah to account, and attracted no shortage of volunteers. Zazawaka, however, was unconvinced, and refused to go with the other refugees─a decision vindicated when one of them returned, traumatized by the slaughter he had barely escaped. Zazawaka believes there may be more survivors, and implores you to find them before the Flames do. Ask the terrified refugee if he knows where his comrades are.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_06: The survivor mutters to himself and does not respond to your inquiries. Clearly he is still haunted by the atrocity to which he bore witness. Were you to make an effort to /soothe his suffering, he might become more cooperative.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SEQ_07: Restored to lucidity by your soothing touch, the survivor reveals that the merchant furnished his fellows with weapons so that they might defend themselves against Ul'dahn forces, and then split them into two groups. Unfortunately for them, the survivor's group encountered an Immortal Flames patrol, who swiftly gave the refugees cause to rue their lack of training. Recalling that the other group has yet to return to Lost Hope, he begs you to seek them out and convince them to return.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_TODO_00: Speak with Raubahn at the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_TODO_02: Speak with the Brass Blades at Lost Hope.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As I told you before, it was all but inevitable that an incident of this kind would eventually occur given the rising tensions within the sultanate. Nevertheless, I have reason to believe that this particular riot may not have begun spontaneously.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Have I piqued your curiosity? Good. Then you will accompany me to the Hall of Flames. I would hear what General Raubahn has to say upon the matter.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_RAUBAHN_000_010: Now is not a good time, . My hands are full dealing with the refugees.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Precisely the matter we wish to discuss, General.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_RAUBAHN_000_012: Alphinaud... Back on your feet already?
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_013: You may credit my swift recovery to your chirurgeons.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_014: My memories of the riot are still somewhat muddled. I trust you managed to regain control of the situation?
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_RAUBAHN_000_015: Not entirely. We secured the city soon enough, but not before the unrest had spread to the surrounding territories. Pockets of resistance remain throughout Thanalan.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_RAUBAHN_000_016: We have sent what forces we can spare to root out the last of the belligerents, but progress is slow. They are damnably elusive.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_017: I can well imagine. Given that the majority of refugees live outside the walls, it stands to reason that they would know the lay of the land...
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_018: What I do not understand is how they came to be so well prepared. Before my little accident, I observed that several of the refugees were armed─and not with butcher's knives or pitchforks, but with martial weaponry. I need hardly add that such equipment is costly.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_019: None can deny that tensions between the Ul'dahn citizenry and the refugee population have increased since the Domans were turned away, but would that motivate a starving man to purchase arms in lieu of food? I think not.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_020: And what of those who have not even a single gil to spend, who could not survive without the aid provided by the Immortal Flames? Surely they would sooner sell a weapon than bring it to bear against their benefactors.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_022: ...Very well. My point, General, is that this powder keg of discontent was not set alight by chance. These events were deliberately set in motion, and─
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_RAUBAHN_000_023: And now order must be restored. That is my first duty. Until it is done, any investigation can wait.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_RAUBAHN_000_024: I do not have time to discuss this. My scouts will be returning anon.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_025: The General is no fool. He keeps his own counsel─and with good cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_026: Were he to claim, without the necessary proof, that these riots were instigated by outside forces, the Monetarists would accuse him of attempting to shirk responsibility. After all, he and the sultana have been the most outspoken proponents of refugee aid.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_027: Regardless, they will face harsh criticism in the days ahead...
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_028: Our allies may stumble upon the truth in time, but I have far more faith in your abilities, . Therefore, I propose we conduct our own investigation, independent of the authorities.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_029: To that end, I would have you make inquiries in the settlements suspected of harboring belligerents. Commander Swift will know which they are. He may balk at a request for such information, but I've no doubt that you can persuade him with your silver tongue.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ALPHINAUD_000_030: I, meanwhile, shall seek answers in my own way, after which we can regroup and share our findings. Well then, shall we?
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SWIFT_000_040: You look as though you have something to say, . Do you?
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SWIFT_000_041: What you ask is no simple favor. Were such information to fall into the wrong hands, the lives of countless soldiers would be at risk. Even so...there is wisdom in your words. An able individualmay be better suited to this task than a regiment.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SWIFT_000_042: Very well. The Brass Blades have reported suspicious activity in the vicinity of Lost Hope. It may be unrelated to recent events, but we doubt it. I suggest you begin by speaking to the Blades posted there.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_SWIFT_000_050: If you mean to investigate Lost Hope before  comrades arrive, you had best do it quickly. Forces will be dispatched to the region as soon as the situation allows.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_AMALBERGA_000_060: And what brings you here, adventurer? A search for refugees? Well, then you've come to the right place!
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_AMALBERGA_000_061: Ah, you mean those refugees! Oh no, you won't find them here. Most of the people of Lost Hope have come to accept their situation, and are content to pass their days in peace and quiet.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_AMALBERGA_000_062: Outsiders have trouble understanding that─like that merchant who passed through recently. Gregarious fellow, but awfully opinionated. Can't say I was sad to see him go.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_AMALBERGA_000_070: There's nothing to see here, adventurer. What few troublemakers we have know better than to try anything with Leofric and myself around.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_LEOFRIC_000_080: I take it this means someone has read my report.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_LEOFRIC_000_081: The refugees who left with the merchant have yet to return, and I am increasingly concerned that Zazawaka's suspicions were correct.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_LEOFRIC_000_082: ...You haven't the foggiest what I'm talking about, do you? Never mind. Speak with Zazawaka. He will explain everything.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_LEOFRIC_000_090: Do not judge these people too harshly. For them, every day is a struggle. Were you in their position, can you truly say you would have done otherwise?
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_100: Ah! Don't hurt me! I'm not one of them!
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_101: Wait, I know your face. Are you not the  from the Church of Saint Adama Landama?
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_102: A thousand pardons, my friend! I mistook you for one of the thugs who have been tormenting us.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_103: I beg your pardon?  I see...
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_104: If Leofric bid you speak with me, then I take it you've agreed to help. Twelve be praised for that, because we haven't a moment to waste. Everyone knows the Flames are on the march.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_105: The others have fallen under that fanatic's spell, but not I! Promises of revolution and retribution, of holding the ruling class to account and taking that which is owed─hah! A childish fantasy.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_106: I did everything I could to dissuade the others from leaving, but few would heed my words. Now that one of our idealists has returned, however, the madness of the merchant's plan is plain for all to see. Look behind yonder tent and you will understand why.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_107: Even now, he babbles incoherently, so traumatized is he by the bloodshed he witnessed. Try as I might, I can make little sense of his words beyond the fact that he was not alone in surviving. Yet I've no doubt that merchant will lead the remainder to their doom. I beg of you, find them before he does!
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_ZAZAWAKA_000_110: The man said naught of his surviving comrades' whereabouts─naught I could understand, at least. Mayhap you will be able to extract some sense from him. I wish you good fortune.
TEXT_GAIUSE302_01443_TREMBLEMAN01443_000: Wh-What are you doing? Don't...don't draw. Don't draw, don't draw, don't draw─ DON'T DRAW!
...Why didn't you run away with me? We could've escaped together. Then you'd be here, with me─be here to soothe me. Why...why did you have to stay and leave me alone?
It's not f-fair. You should be here to soothe me. Why didn't you listen to me?
You didn't have to stay and fight! If you hadn't, you'd be here to soothe me, instead of...instead of... <sob>
Wh-Who are you? What do you want!?
Aye, it's true. I followed the merchant, and may the gods strike me down for my folly.

“What they will not give, you must take,” he said. When we asked how, he revealed a cache of weapons he had brought and implored us to “seize control of our fates.” I thought about running then and there, but the others were so excited... He split us into two groups, sent us off on our own─

B-But when the Flames found us, we didn't know what to do! Our leader tried to parley with theirs, but then they started arguing, and then fighting, and then everyone was fighting, and the Flames were shouting to give no quarter, and─
Oh gods, the other group! They're still out there! If we don't stop them, they'll be massacred like mine was!
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_SEQ_00: Swift has a message for you from General Raubahn.
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_SEQ_01: General Raubahn has summoned you to a private meeting in the Fragrant Chamber, at which he wishes to discuss the results of your investigation, as well as his own. Alphinaud has already been notified, and will be waiting for you outside. Proceed to the Royal Promenade and speak with Bartholomew.
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_SEQ_02: There are men and women who will not scruple to set the world ablaze in the pursuit of power. Teledji Adeledji is one such man, having orchestrated the refugee uprising from the start. General Raubahn and the sultana believe that he intends to exploit the chaos in order to gain control of the Carteneau Flats, in which an Allagan creation not unlike the Ultima Weapon has been discovered. Were someone to harness the power of this relic, they would have the strength to subjugate all of Eorzea─or so it is feared. Yet despite having learned of Teledji Adeledji's schemes, it would seem that your allies are not yet ready to move against him...
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_TODO_00: Speak with Bartholomew on the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_SWIFT_000_000: The Flame General left word that you were to proceed to the Fragrant Chamber as soon as you returned. He wishes to discuss your recent discoveries, as well as the results of our own investigation.
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_SWIFT_000_001: Master Alphinaud has already been informed and should be waiting for you outside. Pray proceed to the Royal Promenade with all haste and speak with Bartholomew.
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_SWIFT_000_010: The sultana will be in attendance as well. Pray do not keep Her Grace waiting.
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Excellent work, . The information you brought us helped me persuade General Raubahn to call this meeting. Mayhap now we can discuss matters openly and honestly.
TEXT_GAIUSE305_01446_BARTHOLOMEW_000_020: We have been expecting you, . Please proceed inside.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_SEQ_00: Recent revelations weigh heavily on Alphinaud's mind.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_SEQ_01: As you and Alphinaud discuss your next course of action, you are reunited with the young girl from Stonesthrow. Having learned of your desire to find the merchant who recruited her parents, she sought you out in the hopes that you might lead her to them. Although he clearly has no desire to do so, Alphinaud offers to assist the girl with her search. Soon after you are contacted by Minfilia, who requests you return to the Rising Stones immediately. The situation in the Twelveswood has taken a turn for the worse, and you will likely be asked to intervene.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_SEQ_02: Minfilia is pleased to hear that you and Alphinaud are well, and states that she is ready to brief you on the latest threat. Inform her when you are ready so that she might summon the other Scions to the solar.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_TODO_00: Speak with Minfilia at the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I should be glad to know the truth, and yet...the thought that all this chaos was the product of one man's lust for power sickens me.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_001: How long do you think they intended to hide the existence of Omega from the Scions? That they even felt the need to do so is most troubling.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_002: It would be in our best interests to learn more of the military activities in the disputed territories. You are, of course, the Scion best suited to this task,  . Do take a moment to visit  and make inquiries at the earliest available opportunity.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_003: It would be in our best interests to learn more of the military activities in the disputed territories. Fortunately, you are already well positioned to do so,  . Pray keep us informed of any developments in Carteneau.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_GUARD01447_000_004: (-Sultansworn Squire-)Begone, whelp! This is no place for children!
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ELE_000_006: I... <sniffle> I was looking for you, . You said you were looking for the man who left with my parents. <sob>
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_008: So he visited Stonesthrow as well? I see.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ELE_000_009: Did you find the man? Were my parents with him?
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_010: They were not, I am afraid.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_011: ...However, I can think of several places they might be. If you like, we can go and look for them together.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ELE_000_012: Really? You'll help me look, mister?
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Of course. But first, I must needs finish speaking with my friend. 's telling me a secret, you see, so no one else is allowed to listen. Mayhap you could wait for me by that pillar over there? We require but a moment.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_015: ...I'll take her to the Quicksand. Mayhap Momodi will know what to do.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_016: <sigh> A legion of Garleans, an aether-starved primal─even dealing with an Ascian would be preferable to this charade.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Sometimes I fear Minfilia is too ambitious. We rush hither and yon in response to threats as they arise, without concern for the strain it places on our limited resources─and ourselves.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_018: Mayhap the time has come for a change...
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_MINFILIA_000_019: , this is Minfilia. I know this is sudden, but I must ask you to return to Revenant's Toll with all due haste.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_MINFILIA_000_020: The situation in the Twelveswood has taken a turn for the worse. I will explain in detail once you arrive.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_021: The Twelveswood? Then the primal threat she spoke of before has been confirmed? I have received no reports of Ixali activity, which leaves...the sylphs?
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Go, . You know as well as I that the appearance of a primal takes precedence over all else.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Oh, and when you arrive, do inform the Antecedent that while I am grateful for her concern, she needn't fear for my safety. I am more than capable of protecting myself.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_MESSENGER01447_000_: I am come on behalf of the Elder Seedseer to petition the aid of your order. The Antecedent has been apprised of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_MINFILIA_000_030: It is a relief to see you healthy and hale, . The latest news from Ul'dah was most disturbing.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_MINFILIA_000_031: ...Clearly, the only injury Alphinaud suffered was to his ego. Doubtless it will heal ere long.
TEXT_GAIUSE306_01447_MINFILIA_000_032: The other Scions will need to be present for this meeting. If you are ready to begin, I will summon them now.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_SEQ_00: Minfilia wishes to discuss the latest threat to arise in the Black Shroud.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_SEQ_01: According to Minfilia, the Order of the Twin Adder believes that the primal Ramuh has been summoned within the borders of the Black Shroud. The Antecedent bids you answer the request of the Elder Seedseer, and offer your aid to the people of the forest. Travel to Gridania and report to Serpent Commander Vorsaile Heuloix at the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_SEQ_02: Serpent Commander Heuloix seems much relieved at your arrival. Though eager for you to begin your mission, he asks that you first meet with Kan-E-Senna at the Lotus Stand to discuss diplomatic alternatives. Speak with the silent conjurer at Nophica's Altar to gain admission.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_SEQ_03: The Elder Seedseer confirms that the primal Ramuh has indeed been summoned forth by the natives of the Sylphlands. Loath to sacrifice the hard-won peace with the sylphs, she asks that you attempt to parley with the Lord of Levin before resorting to force. Travel to Little Solace in the East Shroud and report to the serpent lieutenant who will brief you on how to proceed.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_SEQ_04: After welcoming you to Little Solace, the serpent lieutenant informs you that an investigation is already underway to determine where the primal Ramuh might be found. Bide your time until such time as the report is delivered, then speak with the lieutenant once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_TODO_00: Speak with Vorsaile Heuloix at the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_TODO_01: Speak with Kan-E-Senna at the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_TODO_02: Speak with the serpent lieutenant at Little Solace.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MESSENGER01447_100_: I am come on behalf of the Elder Seedseer to petition the aid of your order. The Antecedent has been apprised of the situation.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MINFILIA_000_000: Thank you for responding to my call with such haste.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MINFILIA_000_001: Rest assured, I should not have summoned you were it not urgent. To business, then: I have received some most disturbing news from the Order of the Twin Adder. They have reason to believe that the sylphs may have called forth their revered guardian─the primal Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_THANCRED_000_002: I'm sorry, “may have”? Then it is not certain?
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MINFILIA_000_003: The Elder Seedseer informs us that the elementals themselves murmur of the Lord of Levin's return to the forest. The Sylphlands, however, display no signs of undue commotion.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_004: Forgive me, Antecedent, but that fact need not contradict the elementals' testimony. Unlike his more bellicose compeers─Garuda and so on─Ramuh is reputed to act only in the defense of his children.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_005: I imagine he would soon make his presence known if any were foolish enough to directly endanger the sylphs or their territory.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YSHTOLA_000_006: The abruptness of this development concerns me. Were we not keeping a close watch on the “touched ones” and their movements?
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YSHTOLA_000_007: If preparations for a summoning ritual were indeed underway, 'twould surely not have escaped your notice.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YDA_000_008: Oh, it didn't. I was pretty sure it was going to happen─just not this soon.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YSHTOLA_000_009: I beg your pardon? You foresaw this eventuality and did naught to prevent it!?
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YDA_000_010: I-I told Papalymo! I suppose I could have reported things to Minfilia earlier...but there honestly wasn't much we could do except wait and see.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YDA_000_011: You know how the sylphs feel about people poking around in their territory.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YDA_000_012: They already summoned Ramuh once right after the Calamity, but that was because the Garleans came tramping through the forest...
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_013: ...And so long as Castrum Oriens stands, the sylphs cannot be blamed for wishing to have their guardian deity on hand.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_014: In short, Yda and I are in agreement. The actions of the forest folk were inevitable and unavoidable.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_015: And I maintain that observation would have remained the best policy had it not been for the sudden influx of strangers into the Black Shroud. That, alas, we did not foresee...
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_016: By all accounts, the recent violence in Ul'dah drove a number of refugees to seek safety under the concealing canopy of the trees.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_017: 'Tis like that the sylphs perceived this panicked migration as yet another invasion, and quickened their efforts to summon their god.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YSHTOLA_000_018: I am put in mind of Titan and the kobolds. Once again, it is the affairs of men which have paved the way for a primal's coming.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_019: Indeed. One cannot help but wonder what manner of place Eorzea would be without the “civilizing influence” of mankind... Be that as it may, this regrettable development does afford us a unique opportunity.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_020: ─through your dealings with the sylphs of Little Solace, you once succeeded in preventing an untimely conflict with Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_021: I wonder...might one who has treated with the sylphs so fruitfully in the past not achieve similar success with their patron deity?
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_022: If Ramuh can be convinced of our intentions, it may be the first step to breaking the cycle of primal summoning.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YSHTOLA_000_023: ...A fond hope. Were such a thing possible, we would not have been at war with the beastmen since time immemorial.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YDA_000_024: But maybe this time we can─
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MINFILIA_000_025: Let us continue this discussion anon. We must needs first consult with the nation most affected by Ramuh's presence.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MINFILIA_000_026: The Elder Seedseer has requested your personal involvement, . Pray report to Commander Heuloix at the Adders' Nest as soon as you are able.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MINFILIA_000_027: Steel yourself for the worst. While I hope for a peaceful resolution to this matter, experience suggests that your meeting with the Lord of Levin will prove less than amicable. In such an event, your fellow Scions will of course lend you whatever support you require.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_MINFILIA_000_030: The Elder Seedseer has asked for you by name. Pray report to Commander Heuloix at the Adders' Nest in Gridania with all haste.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_VORSAILE_000_040: , your arrival has been most anticipated. The appearance of a primal is ever cause for alarm and unease.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_VORSAILE_000_041: Though my men stand ready for any eventuality, I know of none more qualified than you to snuff out this threat. Indeed, I would have you do so without delay. The Elder Seedseer, however, would speak with you first.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_VORSAILE_000_042: She is of the opinion that your diplomatic─rather than martial─skills may better serve our cause. I will leave further explanation to our learned leader. Pray make your way to Nophica's Altar. The conjurer in attendance will admit you to the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_VORSAILE_000_050: The Elder Seedseer wishes to speak with you ere you confront the Lord of Levin. Pray make your way to Nophica's Altar, and a conjurer will admit you to the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_DOORMANLOTUS_000_06: The other Scions have already arrived, . May I show you in?
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YDA_000_070: Whatever the Elder Seedseer is planning, I want you to know that I'll be right there by your side. And I'm sure Y'shtola won't be far behind─even if she does think everything's mankind's fault!
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_PAPALYMO_000_075: It is said that once Ramuh passes judgment, his wrath is implacable. 'Twould be best to conclude this discussion ere Gridania and its people are placed upon his scales.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_THANCRED_000_080: I see the sylphs have sent their own representative. There can be no doubt, then...
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_YSHTOLA_000_085: I am most curious to hear how the Elder Seedseer means to treat with Lord Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_SYLPH01448_000_090: Oh! Hello, walking one! It is good to see a friend of elder one!
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_DOORMANLOTUS_000_09: Your meeting with the Elder Seedseer is concluded? Then I wish you good fortune in your task.
TEXT_GAIUSE307_01448_LIEUTENANT01448_000: ? I was told to expect you.
I understand you go to treat with the primal Ramuh himself─an unenviable task, but one for which I have no doubt you are well suited.

I have been told that your fellow Scions are conducting an investigation of the area as we speak, that we might ascertain the location where the Lord of Levin might be found. I would ask that you abide here until they return with their findings.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_SEQ_00: The serpent lieutenant is ready to send you on your way.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_SEQ_01: After hearing the account of your battle with Ramuh, the serpent lieutenant urges you to make your report directly to Kan-E-Senna. Return to Gridania, and speak with the silent conjurer to gain access to the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_SEQ_02: You describe your encounter with the sylphs' guardian deity to the Elder Seedseer. The words of Ramuh appear to resonate with Kan-E-Senna, and she is unable to refute the Lord of Levin's claim that wherever man wanders, darkness follows closely behind. You exit the Lotus Stand at the conclusion to your audience, leaving Gridania's leader troubled and thoughtful despite the news of your victory. Report the details of your meeting to Papalymo who awaits you at Nophica's Altar.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_SEQ_03: Unlike the Elder Seedseer, Papalymo appears satisfied with the outcome. Return to the Rising Stones and report to Minfilia.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_SEQ_04: After listening to your report, Minfilia alludes to some news of her own. Before divulging anything more, however, the Antecedent suggests you first listen to Urianger's latest discovery concerning the nature of the Ascians' immortality. Could it be that the scholar has stumbled upon a means to bring about the permanent destruction of the Paragons?
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_TODO_00: Speak with Kan-E-Senna at the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_TODO_01: Speak with Papalymo at Nophica's Altar.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_TODO_02: Speak with Minfilia in the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_LIEUTENANT01448_000: The Elder Seedseer will wish to hear of your experiences firsthand.
Pray return to Gridania and make directly for the Lotus Stand─the conjurer at Nophica's Altar will be expecting you. Fare you well, .
Pray return to Gridania and make directly for the Lotus Stand─the conjurer at Nophica's Altar will be expecting your arrival. Fare you well, .
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_DOORMANLOTUS_000_02: Welcome back, honored Scion. We who knew of your mission have been most anxious to see you return. The Elder Seedseer awaits you within.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_YDA_000_030: You should have seen Maxio when we got back to Little Solace. Grateful is an understatement! I thought he was going to shake Papalymo's hand off!
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_PAPALYMO_000_035: Ah, the hero of the hour! Let us not keep the Elder Seedseer waiting.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_THANCRED_000_040: I fancy my presence was more help than hindrance during our troubles with Leviathan, but this time around... Well, even I have my off days!
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_YSHTOLA_000_045: 'Twould seem that Yda's appraisal of the situation held some merit after all. Mayhap I should not be so swift to discount her intuition...
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_PAPALYMO_000_60: Thus ends another daunting mission, eh, ?
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_PAPALYMO_000_061: I'd hoped Lord Ramuh could be persuaded with words alone, but nonetheless, I can only admire the adroitness with which you responded to the primal's sudden challenge.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_PAPALYMO_000_062: And it seems that Urianger, too, was pleased with the outcome. What say you, ? Shall we gather back at the Rising Stones and ponder the lessons of the day?
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_PAPALYMO_000_070: I am sure that Minfilia will be eager to hear more of your adventures. Let us return to the Rising Stones and put our thoughts in order.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_MINFILIA_000_080: Welcome back, ! Word of your momentous encounter with Lord Ramuh precedes you!
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_MINFILIA_000_081: I would fain share news of mine own, but Urianger's discoveries must take precedence.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_MINFILIA_000_082: Upon witnessing your defeat of the Lord of Levin, our learned companion was struck with a profound insight regarding the nature of the Ascians' immortality. Let us assemble and discuss his observations together.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_ASCIANA01453_000_20: (-Igeyorhm-)The Lord of Levin is returned to the aether, as was Leviathan before him.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_ASCIANC01453_000_20: (-Emmerololth-)Inferno, vortex, crag, whorl, and levin. All have now been humbled by the Bringer of Light.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_ASCIAND01453_000_20: (-Altima-)The limitless potential of man... Hydaelyn's servant grows mightier by the day.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_ELIDIBUSEORZEA_000_: (-Elidibus-)Yet  prospers at great cost to  mistress...whose strength is all too finite. Seven times have the masses survived the Rejoining, but their souls are grown weak and wan...
(-Elidibus-)Yet even as it enervates, the Ardor empowers our master. All that remains is to nurture the strength of the gifted─to forge the final key.
TEXT_GAIUSE312_01453_LAHABREAEORZEA_000_: (-???-)...And that is the task to which we bend our every effort.
Divine seeds were ever wont to quicken in Eorzea's fertile soil. We need only lead men to the field, and by their eager hands shall a new deity arise.
That which was shattered shall be made anew...and the one true god shall come again.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SEQ_00: Minfilia has some correspondence she wishes to share with you.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SEQ_01: Minfilia informs you that a letter has arrived expressing gratitude for the Scions' efforts in quelling the primal threat. Though the realm is not yet free of strife, the Antecedent stresses that your deeds inspire countless Eorzeans to continue along the difficult road to peace. Conscious that you cannot be expected to spend your every waking moment attending to realm-shaking matters, however, she encourages you to stay awhile in Revenant's Toll. Just when it seems as if you have been granted leave to rest, Minfilia asks that you spare a moment to indulge the attention of the Doman children. Speak with Yozan within the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SEQ_02: Elated to see you returned to Revenant's Toll, Yozan and his fellow “Doman adventurers” beg you to give them a special training session. Hoary Boulder, the Roegadyn who has taken charge of the children's daily instruction, instead proposes a sparring match between you and himself. Head to the east of Revenant's Toll and speak with Hoary Boulder to signify your readiness to begin the demonstration of martial skill.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SEQ_03: You have bested Hoary Boulder in the sparring match. The gathered onlookers cheer your victory, and praise your hard-won strength. Following the bout, Alphinaud approaches you and asks that you meet with him to discuss the future of Eorzea. Head to the Rising Stones and speak with the young Elezen.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SEQ_04: You return to the Rising Stones, and Alphinaud outlines his proposal to form a new organization. Join the determined Scion as he endeavors to fulfill his role as a guardian of Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_TODO_01: Meet Hoary Boulder to the east of Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_TODO_02: Speak with Alphinaud in the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_000: Now the matter of Ramuh has, for the present, been put to rest, there is something I would show you, .
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_001: It is a letter of thanks, signed by the leaders of the Eorzean Alliance, acknowledging the Scions' tireless service to the realm.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_002: It mentions, in particular, the names of all of the defeated primals─Ifrit, Titan, Garuda, Good King Moggle Mog XII, Leviathan, and now Ramuh.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_003: Needless to say, there is only one among our number to have faced them all.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_004: And though these words of gratitude were addressed to our order as a whole, I feel that they were meant for you above all others.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_005: I, too, must offer my heartfelt thanks for all that you have done. In the course of your duties, you have never once failed to answer my call to arms.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_006: You are a true hero, , and Eorzea is that much the safer for your presence.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_007: Pray do not misunderstand me─I said “safer,” not “safe.” I know only too well that we can ill afford to lower our guard. The Ascians may be relied upon to sow chaos in this realm until such time as they are forced to stop.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_008: Why, even without their encouragement, you may be assured that man would foment strife on his own. And that is to say nothing of the beast tribes. Unless we learn to live in harmony, the primals, too, will return to plague us again and again and again...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_009: And yet...despite all of this, your deeds serve to inspire the people─to give them hope for a better tomorrow. And there is no greater gift.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_010: That we have the courage to strive for what might otherwise seem an impossible peace, we owe in no small part to the dangers you have faced on our behalf, and the people you have won over to our cause in so doing. Our list of enemies has ever been long, but think of the allies with whom we are now blessed...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_011: Of the beastmen who wish naught of conflict, and who now call you friend.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_012: Of the sylphs of Little Solace, who wish naught of conflict.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_013: Of Alisaie, who strives to unearth the terrible secrets of the Calamity.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_014: Of the Ala Mhigans and the Domans who stand with us, determined to halt the dread march of the Empire.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_015: And then there is Cid and the fellowship of NOAH, racing to unlock the mysteries of ancient Allag that we might be spared the horror of another Ultima Weapon.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_016: And then there are the many unsung individuals who have gathered here in Revenant's Toll─honest men and women who seek to employ their skills for the good of all.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_017: ...Of course, when speaking of our greatest allies, we must not forget those closest to us, by which I mean our fellow Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_018: Thanks to their many and varied talents, our order is uniquely equipped to combat the far-reaching corruption of the Ascians─and combat it we shall!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_100_019: (-???-)Your enthusiasm is truly heartwarming, Antecedent. Given our embarrassing wealth of allies, I trust it will not inconvenience you unduly if I absent myself for a time?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_020: Alphinaud! I take it the troubles in Ul'dah no longer require your attention?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_100_021: There are yet some rumblings of discontent, but the air of simmering violence is largely dissipated. 'Tis to report such that I stand before you now.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_100_022: That...and to speak with you concerning the new organization we discussed.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_100_023: Ah, I have a message for you from Ele─ Ahem. You recall the refugee girl? The one whose parents were missing? They were found unharmed. She wished me to pass on her thanks to you.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_024: Why, Alphinaud! Am I to understand that you made the effort to remember the poor girl's name? I look forward to reading all about her in your report. I do hope you left nothing out!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_025: ─you have been away from Revenant's Toll for some time now, I believe. Might I suggest that you put the affairs of the realm to one side for the moment and take this opportunity to reacquaint yourself with the town?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_026: ...Which reminds me─one of the Doman children recently inquired as to your whereabouts. Yozan was his name. I believe he has some small matter he wishes to share with you. Why not oblige him with a visit?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_100_030: I realize that you must be quite tired from your travails, but I would most appreciate it if you could find a moment to speak to young Yozan. He has been through much in his own right, I am sure.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_021: We heard you were off fighting “primals,” and that they're some of the strongest enemies you could ever face! I wish I could've seen you in battle...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_022: Anyway, we all want to be heroes, too─so we finally formed our very own Doman Adventurers' Guild to protect all the Domans!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_023: Oh! Do you think you could train us today,  ? Maybe you could show us how you fought the primals!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_025: Mister Boulder and Mister Coultenet! Did you know that   is back!?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_02: So it would seem. Welcome home, . My companion and I but recently became full members of the Scions, and I believe proper introductions have yet to be made.

I am known as Hoary Boulder, and this bookish fellow is Coultenet. Though we remain largely unproven as adventurers, we have taken it upon ourselves to instruct the Doman younglings in the arts of combat.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_028: Ugh, I told you, Mister Boulder: we are not younglings anymore─we are adventurers!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_029: And we were just asking   if  could give us some special training. I think we're ready to hunt monsters alongside , don't you?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: Well, you've certainly been diligent with your drills...but I'm afraid the fiends of Mor Dhona are still ever so slightly too dangerous for you.
I have a counter-proposal: what if I were to cross swords with ? A demonstration of skill at arms, if you will.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_000_032: Hoary. If I didn't know you better─and I do─I'd say you were merely seeking to test yourself against a legend.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: Ahahaha, well, mayhaps I am. But what matters the motive when the children stand to learn so much from the lesson?
What say you, ? Would you consent to spar with me?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_035: Hurrah! We're to have a tournament! Come on, everyone─we must prepare our gear for an outing!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_000_036: ...Do try not to disappoint them, hm?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: Have faith, Coultenet! I shall summon every last onze of my strength to make of this a worthy contest.
The fields to the east of town should prove suitable for our purpose. I very much look forward to our bout.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_000_040: Since becoming a Scion, I have had much opportunity to hear news of your epic deeds. I must confess, then, that my excitement rivals that of the children's at the prospect of seeing you in action firsthand.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_045: is here! Let the battle begin!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_KOHARU_000_050: As we left the Rising Stones, Mister Thancred asked us where we were going. I told him we were off to watch you and Mister Boulder fight, and he looked very surprised. I hope we haven't made him cross...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ROKKA_000_055: Is sparring...dangerous? I don't think I want to see anyone else being hurt...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SHIUN_000_060: We had a Master of Lessons back in Doma, and the way he taught us was very different from Mister Boulder. I'm not sure which way is better, but I think I like them both!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: 'Twas good of you to agree to this, . I trust you are ready to begin?
Very well. Let us not keep the younglings waiting any longer!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_000_072: Ahem. Hoary? Are you certain you wish to fight  alone? That is  you face.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: What better way to test my mettle? Pray allow me to attempt the first round unaided.
After all, 'twas this hero's legend that led me to join the Scions to begin with. Without  to inspire my efforts, I would not be half the warrior I am today.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_000_075: Your point is well made. But remember: this is for the children's sake as well as your own. Should it appear the contest will end too swiftly, I shall add my spells to your bladework.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YDA_000_076: (-???-)Hello! You haven't begun yet, have you?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_07: Yda!? What─ Who are all these people!?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YDA_000_078: When I heard about your sparring match, I told everyone I could find. Thought you could use a crowd to cheer you on!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_THANCRED_000_079: Yes, and there are still more to come. When I mentioned 's name, the reaction was quite enthusiastic.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_THANCRED_000_080: Why, my own popularity seems but a sickly shade in comparison! You'd best claim victory, Bringer of Light─your burgeoning reputation is at stake!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_081: Well, our teacher won't be beaten so easily! He's a master swordsman!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_08: We shall soon see. On your guard!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_09: You... <gasp> You have bested me... <huff> I yield!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_092: ...That was incredible!  beat them both at the same time!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SPECTATORMAN01456_0: We knew you couldn't lose, ! None can defeat the guardian of Eorzea!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SPECTATORWOMAN1456_: Now I see why they send you to deal with the primals! I've much work to do if I'm ever to attempt the same...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_095: Impressive as always, . 'Tis ever a pleasure to witness the spectacle of your martial prowess.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_096: And judging by the smiles on these many faces, they, too, appreciate the hard-won strength that keeps the perils of the realm at bay.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_097: “Guardian of Eorzea”... Yes, that is a most fitting title.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_098: Do you recall when first we met? 'Twas at the memorial service for the Battle of Carteneau...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_099: At the time, I was yet attempting to understand this land of Eorzea. I sought to grasp the reason why Grandfather willingly sacrificed himself to protect it.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_100: I shall speak plainly: my initial impressions were less than favorable. Dire problems abounded, and yet the effort I saw expended towards their solution was haphazard and half-hearted. I thought Eorzeans a foolish and childish people.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_100_100: Considering the shambles their home was in, I would not have been surprised if some had chosen to swear allegiance to Gaius and the order he proposed to enforce. The legatus's single-minded military invasion precluded any such switching of loyalties, of course.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Were it not for a desire to continue Grandfather's legacy, I would have abandoned the realm to its fate long ago. The threats were too many, the nations too self-involved and unstable.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_102: 'Twas you who convinced me the salvation of Eorzea was possible.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_103: 'Twas you who taught me─through countless acts of bravery─that what my grandsire sought to preserve was not the land, nor its history, nor any single nation...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_104: It was the people. These wonderful, oft infuriating, stubborn people that suffer blow after terrible blow only to drag themselves back to their feet to face another day.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_105: Though he never put such feelings into words, I believe Grandfather's admiration for this inextinguishable courage grew into a fervent wish─a wish to aid Eorzea and its inhabitants in charting a course for the future.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_106: A wish that has now become my own.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_107: I, too, will endeavor to take up the mantle of guardian of Eorzea, and champion these people who toil towards a better world.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_108: Our cause, however, is not a simple one: the troubles that plague us are of a scale that cannot be solved by the Scions of the Seventh Dawn alone.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_109: No, what is needed to tackle the root of the primal threat─and effectively counter the schemes of the Ascians─is a new, expanded organization that operates beyond the limitations of nations and borders.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_110: If you would aid me in building such an organization, then pray let us continue this discussion back within the walls of the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Thank you for coming, . The world shifts and alters, and we, my friend, must ever be one step ahead of the chaos.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ALPHINAUD_000_121: What I propose is the formation of a new organization─a group that shall pave the way for a truly united Eorzea...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_000_130: With the primal threat presently subdued, now is the perfect time to focus on new endeavors.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_MINFILIA_000_131: Alphinaud has long been laying the groundwork for this organization of his, and he looks to you to help turn his proposal into reality. Pray lend him what aid you can.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_THANCRED_000_135: Your bout with Hoary Boulder was more stirring than a hundred lines of my most passionate poetry. Mayhaps I should arrange a sparring match of my own...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YDA_000_140: I can't wait for Alphinaud to start his new company. I love making new friends!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_PAPALYMO_000_145: I wish Yda were not so eager to look to the future when we have so many problems in the here and now...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YSHTOLA_000_150: I fear Yda's boundless optimism is beginning to affect my better judgment. And your tendency to triumph against the most terrible of foes is certainly not helping matters.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_TATARU_000_155: No, this won't do at all! And then I'll have to─ Oh, hello, ! If you don't mind, I'm terribly busy at the moment!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_FLHAMINN_000_160: 'Tis not enough that I am here for my daughter─I must do what little I can to help you all succeed in your monumental tasks.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_000_16: ! I must thank you again for agreeing to our bout.
...And I must thank the gods 'twas not a duel to the death! I will, however, cherish the lesson of each scrape and bruise as I work to better my swordplay.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_000_170: I thought the idea foolish at first, but it seems that sparring match well served its purpose. Why, I can hardly wait to return to my studies and seek to improve upon my technique!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOUZAN_000_175: My people's spirits were thoroughly crushed by the loss of our homeland, but thanks to your courage and generosity I see their inner flames once more flicker back to life. I, too, have felt my strength of will make a gradual return.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_DOUWARE_000_180: Our Doman farming methods have been adopted here on the frontier. 'Tis too early yet to know if they will prove to be effective...
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HIGIRI_000_185: This place has become as a hive, and its bees flit about in constant motion. Perhaps a soothing pot of tea will coax one or two to alight and take a moment's rest.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_190: Mister Boulder fought well, but he was no match for you,  !
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_000_191: Just you wait! One day I'll be good enough to knock you from the top of your mountain!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_KOHARU_000_195: Mister Boulder is sore and beaten, but he said he'd return straight to his training. Heh heh, I don't think he likes to lose!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SHIUN_000_200: We need to decide who in our Adventurers' Guild will do what. I'm fairly sure Yozan will have to be the swordfighter─he always has to be in the thick of the action.
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ROKKA_000_205: I like the way Mister Coultenet fought─no swords or fists. I wonder, if I studied hard, would I be able to cast spells like that too?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_BATTLE:
Day and night I've honed my skills.
Now comes the time to test them!

Ugh... Such power!
The tales barely do you justice!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_ROKKA_BATTLETALK_00: Mister Boulder won't lose, will he?
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_SHIUN_BATTLETALK_00: It's not over yet! It can't be!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_BATTLETAL: Aye, the children have the right of it.

'Tis time I joined the fray.
On your feet, Hoary!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_YOUZAN_BATTLETALK_0:
is so strong...
But you can't give up, Mister Boulder!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_HOARYBOULDER_BATTLE:
Never have I faced such strength!
...But the lesson must continue!

'Tis your example I follow!
Surrender not to the implacable foe!
TEXT_GAIUSE315_01456_COULTENET_BATTLETAL:
I must admit defeat.
'Twas an honor and a privilege...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_00: Alphinaud wishes to request your assistance for his new endeavor.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_01: Alphinaud lays before you the plan to establish a realm-wide Grand Company. The Scion goes on to lament that though the three nations' leaders are not opposed to the idea itself, endless deliberations over its implementation have slowed progress to a crawl. In order to demonstrate the efficacy of such a company and thus encourage the leaders to come to an agreement, Alphinaud explains that he has proposed the creation of a smaller, precursor organization─the vanguard to a future united Eorzea. The young Elezen requests that you join him on his journey to each of the three nations that you might begin scouting potential members for this trial company while he is engaged with finalizing the bureaucratic formalities. Head first to Limsa Lominsa and rendezvous with Alphinaud at Bulwark Hall.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_02: After giving you a brief explanation on the recruitment process, Alphinaud heads up to the Bridge to speak with the Admiral. Make your way to the upper decks and begin scouting for potential company members.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_03: You speak with a number of possible candidates for the trial organization, but are only successful in gaining the interest of Riol, a member of the now defunct Company of Heroes. Head to the airship landing and report to Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_04: You have reported the fruits of your labor to the young Scion. He is impressed by the caliber of your first recruit, and bids you join him on the second leg of his journey. Travel next to Gridania, and find Alphinaud at Nophica's Altar.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_05: You meet with Alphinaud just as he is due to begin his audience with Kan-E-Senna. Continue your recruiting efforts within Old Gridania while the determined Elezen speaks with the Elder Seedseer.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_06: You succeed in recruiting Laurentius and Alianne to the trial company. Make your way to the airship ticket counter and report to Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_07: The young Scion appears curious but nevertheless pleased at the addition of a former Wood Wailer and a seasoned adventurer to the ranks. Travel next to Ul'dah, and rendezvous with Alphinaud at the Royal Promenade.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_08: Alphinaud is ready to bow before Sultana Nanamo Ul Namo and ask her permission to operate freely within Ul'dah's borders. Make your way to the lower level of the Steps of Thal, and complete the initial stage of the trial company's recruitment efforts.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_09: Though your efforts to recruit any native Ul'dahns have failed, you are able to capture the interest of the young Ala Mhigan Wilred. Return to the Royal Promenade and report to Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_10: Somewhat disappointed but otherwise unsurprised by the overall number of recruits, Alphinaud is genuinely grateful for the few valuable members you were able to secure. After reporting his own success with the sultana and attempting to dispel any doubt you might have over the Syndicate's involvement, the young Scion suggests a swift return to Revenant's Toll. Make your way back to the Rising Stones and speak with Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SEQ_11: Upon returning to the Scions' headquarters, you find Alphinaud exhausted from the journey but eager to begin preparations for his trial company's inaugural ceremony. He thanks you for your recruiting efforts, and hints that the Antecedent may wish to assign you new duties. Speak with Minfilia and learn what events have transpired in Revenant's Toll in your absence.

TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Pray forgive me if I tread over old ground, but I would first speak of the grand plan.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Since the advent of the Seventh Astral Era, the leaders of the three nations have been deliberating over an accord that seeks to bring the disparate forces of Eorzea together into a single entity.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_002: A realm-wide Grand Company, if you will. The military might of such an institution would be drawn from every corner of the land, and directed against threats that no single nation could hope to overcome alone.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Yet while the purpose of this hypothetical organization is undisputed, the logistics of its formation have become the source of endless debate...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_004: And the longer these discussions continue, the more I sense the impetus towards unification draining away. Thus have I been campaigning for the creation of what might be considered a trial company.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_005: It will be on a much smaller scale than what we hope to eventually achieve, but capable of the same manner of unrestricted operation accorded to the Scions. 'Tis my hope that the successful utilization of such a force will lend momentum to the lagging deliberations.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_006: Also, being a primarily military outfit, I mean to assuage fears of its misuse by placing the fledgling organization under the authority of the Antecedent.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_007: The Scions work tirelessly to protect Eorzea and its people.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_008: ...But as you yourself have witnessed with the refugee revolt, there are limitations to what even we can achieve.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_009: With this new company under the Scions' command, however, we will be capable of responding to a wider range of difficulties without straining our resources or overtaxing your formidable talents.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_010: The goals of my proposed organization and those of the Scions are ultimately identical─a point conceded by all concerned.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_011: But before I can move forward with establishing this precursor to the true, border-spanning Grand Company, 'tis yet necessary that I visit the three leaders and gain their official approval.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_012: A tiresome and time-consuming task... Which is why I would ask that you accompany me on the journey, and attend to the business of recruiting our inaugural members while I am otherwise engaged with bureaucratic formalities.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_013: ...Thank you. 'Tis reassuring indeed to know that the Bringer of Light and  discerning eye will be selecting our future allies.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Our first destination will be Limsa Lominsa. Let us rendezvous at Bulwark Hall.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Ah, there you are. I am ready to ascend to the Bridge and speak with Admiral Bloefhiswyn.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_021: While the Admiral and I are finalizing permissory boundaries and signing parchments, I would have you begin the recruitment process in earnest.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_022: I have, of course, endeavored to spread the word of our organization through various channels, but I believe a personal approach will reach many who may otherwise remain ignorant of the opportunity.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_023: As for potential members, 'tis of no matter should they already be pledged to another institution, only that they are willing to lend their strength when the situation demands it. And you needn't range into the countryside─the upper decks alone are populated with sufficient candidates to suit our purpose.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Once you are satisfied with your recruiting efforts, meet me at the airship ticket counter that we might prepare for the next leg of our journey.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_RIOL_000_030: Well, if it ain't ! I'd not forget a 'venturer brave enough─or daft enough─to seek the shortcut into Titan's bedchamber!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_RIOL_000_031: Ye remember ol' Riol, don't ye? Formerly o' the Company of Heroes? Three whistles at Bronze Lake? Aye, it ain't often I drag me arse out to Limsa for a drink, but I'm right glad I did! How fare ye these days?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_RIOL_000_032: Hm? Yer lookin' to put together a new crew? Top-tier work? Hah, sounds like a right lark, it does!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_RIOL_000_033: Alrighty, , count me in. The Heroes may've gone their separate ways, but I ain't ready to climb into me grave just yet!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_REYNER_000_040: Master Alphinaud's new organization? Yes, I had heard the formation of his trial company was in the offing.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_REYNER_000_041: 'Tis with regret, however, that I must decline your invitation. As commander of the Yellowjackets, the protection of Limsa Lominsa must needs receive my full attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_REYNER_000_050: I wish you well in your endeavors, but the Yellowjackets─and the defense of Limsa Lominsa's people─must remain my sole priority.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_CARVALLAIN_000_060: An organization with the freedom to operate with territorial impunity? I must say, your proposal intrigues me.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_CARVALLAIN_000_061: But the Krakens well know that there is a time to act, and a time to watch. And I'm afraid this...“trial company” of yours falls into the latter category.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_CARVALLAIN_000_070: The Krakens do not stir before the currents can be read. For the present, my answer must be a respectful “no.”
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_RHOSWEN_000_080: Eh? Who in the bloody 'ells do ye think yer talkin' to, drylander!? I'm a pirate, not some soddin' knight in shinin' plate! If yer lookin' fer a self-righteous fop, try knockin' on that dandy Carvallain's door!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_RHOSWEN_000_090: Do I need to fetch me hook? I told ye, go bother Carvallain with yer talk o' do-goodin'.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_HNAANZA_000_100: A precursor to a united Eorzean Grand Company? Hmmm. While I do admire the scope of your ambition, my responsibilities here at Naldiq & Vymelli's keep me close to the forge.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_HNAANZA_000_101: I have not the time to be traipsing hither and yon across the realm. Should you require my skills as an armorer, however, I might be willing to accept some special commissions...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_HNAANZA_000_110: As noble as your cause may be, I have a duty to Naldiq & Vymelli's, and to the forge. I can, however, be persuaded to furnish you with any metalwork you might require. Come back with a list of materiel, and we'll talk.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_120: , your recruiting went well, I trust? I am curious as to how my proposal was received by the rough-and-ready folk of Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Ah, a member of the legendary Company of Heroes indicated his interest? Astonishing. I knew enlisting your aid was the right choice─few could boast the acquaintance of such an elusive character.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_122: I, too, was successful in my task: the Admiral consented to sign all the documents requiring her approval.
