I can only hope that my visit with the Elder Seedseer proceeds as smoothly. Pray continue on to Gridania at your own pace─I shall await your arrival at Nophica's Altar.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_130: My audience with the Elder Seedseer is due to commence momentarily. I would be grateful if you would once more see to the task of recruitment here in Gridania.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_131: After you deem the well of potential candidates has run dry, let us rendezvous at the airship ticket counter as before.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_140: Oh gods, can it truly be you!? By what fickle fortune must the first face I see upon my release be yours!?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_141: ...Eh? Could it be that you don't remember me? It is I, Laurentius, the man whose crimes you exposed. I was a Wailer, and a regular patron at Buscarron's...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_146: Well, of course you do! I was beginning to wonder if gaol had changed me more than I realized. ...Not that I have any particular wish to be recognized after my shameful conduct.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_147: Laurentius! I...I was selling maps and supplies to the Garleans, before you and those Redbelly poachers mopped the forest floor with my erstwhile employers. ...Here now, just how many criminals have you dealt with that my ignominious tale ignites not the slightest flicker of recognition!?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_148: Will you say nothing!? Does my presence disgust you so? Or do you simply not care to remember our encounter at all?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_149: Hmph. The less said of my past, the better, I suppose. And what of you, adventurer? What business brings you to this part of Gridania?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_150: Recruiting, eh? And what is your policy on reformed convicts?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_151: As matters stand, the Wood Wailers will have naught more to do with me. This...this may be just the second chance I was looking for...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LAURENTIUS_000_152: Revenant's Toll, you say? I shall leave at once! You shall not regret this, I promise you! I am a changed man!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALIANNE_000_160: Grandfather, you must call it a day! Let us return to the guild and rest ere your tormented back gives up on you for good!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALIANNE_000_161: I'm terribly sorry, we were just─ Oh, , isn't it? It has been some time since our paths crossed outside of Copperbell Mines.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALIANNE_000_162: Why, you were barely more than a novice adventurer then, but look how far you've come... Mother Miounne tells me 'twas you who felled the fearsome Black Wolf!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALIANNE_000_163: And now you seek stout-hearted souls to fill the ranks of a new order? Hmmm, well your cause is undoubtedly just, and my old companion here would be much relieved to see me in good hands...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALIANNE_000_164: Yes. Yes, I'll do it! This is the very thing I've spent my entire adventuring career working towards! I shall join your company just as soon as I've seen Isildaure safely home.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALIANNE_000_170: If you would have me, I would be glad to join your new company. I shall make for Revenant's Toll once I've escorted my dear friend back home.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ISILDAURE_000_175: My back is perfectly fine, I tell you! You'll have to tie me to my bed if you think to prevent me from─ <gasp> Ow. Well, mayhaps I will rest for just a short while...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_CEINGULED_000_180: Hmmm. 'Tis not often a guild officer such as myself gets recruited. And this company of yours certainly sounds to have some promise... But its duties appear less than focused. I must refuse your invitation until such time as your organization is more...organized.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_CEINGULED_000_190: While I find sympathy with your cause, I must confess to some confusion as to this company's place in the grand scheme of things. For the moment, I prefer to devote my energies to the clear-cut responsibilities of the Wailers.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_URSANDEL_000_200: ...You would offer this old man a place in your company of champions? I am both puzzled and honored by your invitation.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_URSANDEL_000_201: Pray forgive me, , but I cannot accept. I have sworn to abide here for whatever scant years remain to me, and bear responsibility for the evils my lady has wrought upon this land...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_URSANDEL_000_210: I must respectfully refuse your invitation. Your proposal promises new beginnings, but I am shackled to the sins of the past. By my own oath am I made prisoner, my chains forged of guilt and unforgivable cowardice...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_220: What news, ? For my part, the Elder Seedseer was most amenable to our requirements.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_221: ...A former Wood Wailer, and a seasoned adventurer? Our company will not lack for variety, that much is certain. An interesting harvest, indeed.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_222: Shall we strike into Ul'dah whilst the iron is hot? Let us meet at the Royal Promenade and endeavor to conclude our remaining business. Our journey draws to a close...
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_230: Ul'dah, the gilded city, where one's fortune defines one's worth. I hope some manner of fortune is with us, and that this final leg proves as successful as the previous two.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_231: Might I suggest descending to the lower level before beginning your recruitment efforts? I do not think the sultana will take kindly to us poaching from her personal guard.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_232: Let us meet back here at the Promenade when our respective tasks are complete. Good hunting, .
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_WILRED_000_240: Hm? Wait, you're the  who came to Little Ala Mhigo looking for that masked devil.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_WILRED_000_241: Who knows what might've happened if you hadn't... I'd probably be dead, and a whole lot more of my friends besides. We were such fools.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_WILRED_000_242: Anyroad, that disaster really got me to thinking─about our homeland, and about the outsider who saved us from ourselves. I realized how easily I'd been manipulated, and vowed to make of myself a more worldly man. So here I am.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_WILRED_000_243: ...A new company of champions? And you say it will take me to all corners of the realm?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_WILRED_000_244: That sounds exactly like the kind of opportunity I need. And don't worry: I'm not the same stripling you met in Little Ala Mhigo. I've prepared myself to fight the evil I now know is out there.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_OURCEN_000_250: Oh, what a happy coincidence! Do you remember me, perchance? I am Ourcen, of the Church of Saint Adama Landama. Thank you again for your timely rescue.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_OURCEN_000_251: And I must also thank you for preventing that fraudulent priest from preying on Drybone's less fortunate. A most upsetting business. Are you here with your companion─Thancred, wasn't it?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_OURCEN_000_0252: ...Ah, 'tis new companions you seek, then. Your proposed organization sounds a powerful force for good, but my place is at the church with the children. Nevertheless, I wish you well in this undertaking.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_OURCEN_000_260: I could never abandon the children, or my work at the lichyard. I will, however, pray for your success.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SYNTGOHT_000_270: A company that looks to cure the ills of the realm entire? Listen, friend, I can scarce bear the complaints of the next stall over, let alone the conundrums of a neighboring nation!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_SYNTGOHT_000_280: I cannot help you. My fortunes have fallen far enough without investing in a company with no margin for profit.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LANDEBERT_000_291: ...Aye, you'd be surprised what rumors drift down to Pearl Lane. I know of this glorious new company of yours, and just how far I'd go to avoid getting involved with it.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LANDEBERT_000_292: Whispers on the street say your organization is funded by corrupt coin─by Syndicate money. If you think you're recruiting for a just cause, then you're a bigger fool than I took you for.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_LANDEBERT_000_300: My advice, soldier? Cut your ties and run. Your shining company'll be naught but a puppet that dances to the Syndicate's tune.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_YELLOWMOON_000_310: I'm sorry? You wish to “recruit” me? Is this some new-fashioned manner of propositioning a lady?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_YELLOWMOON_000_311: Well, I'm afraid you are wasting your time─this lady is already spoken for! Good day to you, !
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_YELLOWMOON_000_320: Pray take your crude affections elsewhere! Bitter Snow's is the only love I require!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_330: How fared you, ? What hidden gems did the streets of Ul'dah offer up to your unrelenting gaze?
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_331: Hmmm... A single Ala Mhigan youth? Well, you've certainly given us an admirable start, even if our ranks are yet somewhat thin.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_332: In these troubled years following the Calamity, talk of Eorzea's salvation must seem akin to grasping at clouds.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_333: But there are those who have risen to the challenge, nonetheless. And the hope that inspires these people was born in no small part from the victories you yourself have won.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_334: Thank you, . I will not squander the precious gift you have placed into my keeping─these recruits will become the foundation of a new beginning.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_335: And yes, we are free to begin. As you have no doubt surmised, the sultana also graced my trial company with her blessings.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_336: Our first wave of recruitment is over, the documents signed, and the finances secure. There is naught to prevent me from taking the next step.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_337: ...You are concerned by the Syndicate's involvement? As was I. Thus was the origin of every coin of their contribution carefully scrutinized and recorded. This organization will not be built on corruption.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_338: Naturally, I would prefer not to rely upon outside sources at all, but even my family's substantial coffers could not sustain a venture of this magnitude.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_339: And as for the rumors and doubt surrounding this enterprise... Well, such things shall plague us until the company has had a chance to prove its worth.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_340: It will not be an easy process, but we will earn people's trust one success at a time.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_341: ...Speaking of time, we should waste no more of it. Let us return to the Rising Stones, and lay the first stone for a united Eorzea!
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_350: <sigh> ...That is not a journey I soon wish to repeat.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_351: But I cannot pause to rest─the culmination of all our effort is at hand. I must see to the preparations for the inaugural ceremony.
TEXT_GAIUSE316_01457_ALPHINAUD_000_352: Thank you for allowing me to monopolize your services, . I am certain the Antecedent will be relieved to see you free for other duties.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SEQ_00: Minfilia appears eager to welcome you back to Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SEQ_01: Minfilia expresses concern that the bustling chaos surrounding the official commencement of Alphinaud's trial company has placed undue stress on Slafborn and his efforts to supervise the growing population of Revenant's Toll. Head outside and offer your aid to the veteran soldier.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SEQ_02: Seemingly unfazed by the arrival of the recruits, Slafborn claims to be more worried about your unending workload. While he is dismissing your concerns, however, your conversation is interrupted by the arrival of an injured group of adventurers. You soon learn that the adventurers─and the provisions they were charged with escorting─were set upon by a band of Coerthan heretics near the border to Mor Dhona. Slafborn asks that you travel to Coerthas and aid House Fortemps in tracking down the stolen shipment meant for the frontier hands of Revenant's Toll. Make your way to Camp Dragonhead and call upon Lord Haurchefant.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SEQ_03: You arrive in Camp Dragonhead to find Lord Haurchefant yet unaware of the reason for your visit. Explain the situation to the head of House Fortemps, and discuss what must be done...
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_TODO_00: Speak with Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_TODO_01: Speak with Haurchefant at Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_MINFILIA_000_000: Greetings, . Alphinaud tells me all is in place to begin his trial company─the Scions shall certainly be grateful to have the support of such an organization.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_MINFILIA_000_001: The inaugural ceremony is set to take place here at the Rising Stones. Tataru is cooperating with Alphinaud to see that all is in readiness, so I'm afraid the recruits themselves have been left to their own devices for the time being.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_MINFILIA_000_002: Quite a number of new faces have arrived in Revenant's Toll of late, and I wonder if Slafborn might not find himself overwhelmed. Would you speak with him and see if there is aught he requires?
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_MINFILIA_000_010: Would you speak with Slafborn and offer to ease his burdens? The town was already fit to burst with adventurers and refugees and the like, and I fear the addition of Alphinaud's recruits has only added to the chaos.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_020: What can I do for you, ? I thought you'd have your hands full helping out with this new arm of the Scions.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_021: Ha! I barely noticed your recruits arrive─'twas barely a trickle compared to the flood of treasure hunters we have pass through here every day.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_022: While I appreciate your offer of aid, 'tis more your burden that concerns me. I'm told this trial company will answer directly to the Antecedent, so I trust that means less work for you in the long run.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_HONBUBOUKENSHA01354: We─ <cough> We were bringing a shipment to Revenant's Toll─provisions earmarked for the frontier effort.
But just as we sought to cross over into Mor Dhona, we were set upon by brigands. I─ <cough> <cough> I believe they may have been heretics.
They were many... Too many. We only escaped with our lives by abandoning the supplies. Pray forgive us!
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_028: There is naught to forgive. Provisions can be replaced, but smart soldiers are hard to find. Take your rest and I'll have someone along to tend to those wounds.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_030: If heretics are involved, then this is like to be more than a case of simple thievery. Ishgard will need to be informed.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_HONBUBOUKENSHA01354: House Fortemps─we collected the provisions from Camp Dragonhead proper.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_033: Understood. I shall see that they are apprised of this development.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_034: , were you not on good terms with the knights of House Fortemps?
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_035: I will be sending them a missive immediately, of course, but I would also have you travel there and offer your considerable talents.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_036: ...Yes, I realize I contradict my earlier hopes to lighten your load, but I need someone who can help bring this incident to a satisfactory conclusion─our favorable relations with Ishgard are far too important to risk half measures.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_037: Thank you for your understanding. I am certain Lord Haurchefant will be glad of your assistance.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_SLAFBORN_000_040: I will send a missive to Camp Dragonhead and let Lord Haurchefant know of the attack, as well as your impending arrival. Fair fortune go with you, .
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_HONBUBOUKENSHA01354: I've never so completely failed in a task. But those heretics, they fell upon us like wintry demons...
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_HAURCHEFANT_000_050: Well, well, if it isn't my fine friend, ! Would you care for a plate of roast karakul? Some mulled wine?
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_HAURCHEFANT_000_051: No? Ah, I see you have not come into my hall merely to escape the biting cold.
TEXT_GAIUSE317_01458_HAURCHEFANT_000_052: I was, in fact, on the verge of opening an urgent missive from Revenant's Toll, and I suspect the timing of your arrival is no coincidence...
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_00: Lord Haurchefant awaits confirmation of the reason for your visit to Camp Dragonhead.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_01: A staunch supporter of the frontier effort in Mor Dhona, Lord Haurchefant eagerly shares with you what little information he has regarding the heretics and their mysterious leader, the Lady Iceheart. Reasoning that your best chance to track down the supply thieves lies in Whitebrim and its heretic-infested environs, the garrison commander suggests you bring the matter before Lord Drillemont. Make your way west to Whitebrim Front, and speak with the head of House Durendaire.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_02: Upon explaining your mission to Lord Drillemont, he responds with an ominous description of the heretics' heightened fanaticism and rigid discipline. As fate would have it, it appears a recent victim of a heretic attack is presently resting within the outpost's infirmary. Visit the injured merchant and listen to his tale.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_03: You listen to the merchant's matter-of-fact account of the heretics' brutal robbery, and learn where his attackers were likely headed with their haul. Travel into the wilds near Snowcloak, and defeat any heretics you come across.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_04: You have slain the heretic ambushers. Head towards the frozen wall of Snowcloak and speak with the knight of House Durendaire.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_05: As the knight tells you of his patrol's travails, you spy a woman gazing down from near the top of the cliff. Though she quickly disappears from sight, you have some suspicions as to the figure's identity. Speak with the knight of House Durendaire once more.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_06: The knight appears shaken by your glimpse of whom he assumes to be Iceheart herself, and wonders what terrible dangers lie hidden behind the frozen facade of Snowcloak. Take the young gallant's advice and return with your discoveries to Lord Drillemont.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_07: Perturbed by the defeat of his elite soldiers, Lord Drillemont cautions you against rushing into what may well be a veritable den of heretics for the sake of a few provisions. Return to Camp Dragonhead and report this turn of events to Lord Haurchefant.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_08: After hearing your tale of what transpired at Snowcloak, the head of House Fortemps insists that the matter be turned over to the authority of the Temple Knights. Before sending you on your way, however, Lord Haurchefant promises that another shipment of supplies will be sent to Revenant's Toll. Travel back to Mor Dhona and report to Slafborn.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SEQ_09: Slafborn appears relieved to hear of Lord Haurchefant's generosity. He warns, however, that the growing prosperity of Revenant's Toll will require that everyone─Alphinaud's new recruits included─remain vigilant against the schemes of the unscrupulous.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_TODO_00: Speak with Drillemont at Whitebrim Front.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_TODO_02: Search the wilds of Snowcloak and defeat any heretics you encounter.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_TODO_03: Speak with the House Durendaire knight.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_TODO_04: Speak once more with the House Durendaire knight.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_TODO_07: Report to Slafborn at Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_HAURCHEFANT_000_000: Furtive bands of men have been spied by patrols out of Whitebrim Front. Mayhaps Lord Drillemont will know more of the brazen heretics we seek.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_010:
, welcome, welcome. You'll be pleased to know that the repairs to Stone Vigil proceed apace. We shall rebuild sure and strong, that the Dravanians might batter themselves senseless against our shield in the west.
...I would venture, however, that matters of masonry are not what brought you to Whitebrim.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_011: , is there aught you would ask of me? Pray speak plainly─I am a man of action and need no honeyed words.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_012: ...On the trail of a band of thieving heretics, you say? By the Fury, but you do seem destined to cross paths with those villains.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_013: I must confess, then, 'tis a sad truth that the wilds hereabouts have indeed grown thick with their number. They strike swiftly, without warning, and are canny enough to evade our most able trackers.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_014: But 'tis not merely their newfound organization that confounds us: the heretics themselves seem somehow changed.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_015: I know not what manner of influence this Iceheart wields, but the men we face seem utterly lost in the grip of righteous fervor. 'Tis an unsettling and unnatural zeal.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_016: Mayhaps you would care to question one of their recent victims? As fate would have it, your arrival came moments after a trader was waylaid on the road.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_017: A patrol found the unfortunate fellow lying senseless in the snow, and carried him to our infirmary. Assuming he has regained the use of his faculties, the merchant might recall some small detail that could aid you in your task.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_020: Will you speak with the merchant in our infirmary? The account of his unpleasant experience may aid you in chasing down your quarry.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_MERCHANT01459_000_0: Tell you what happened? Why, yes, of course! I am quite recovered enough for that! Anything to help catch those cowardly blackhearts!
I was traveling my usual route to Whitebrim Front when a sudden blow sent me reeling...
The next thing I knew I was on the ground, and several heretics were rifling through my cargo─arms, armor, crystals...they were taking everything.

'Twas then that one of them noticed my bleary gaze, and stalked over to better acquaint my head with his mace. Before darkness claimed me, however, I distinctly heard the words, “return to Snowcloak.”

I daresay that is where they were hauling my goods, but you'll not catch me rushing off in pursuit! They tell me 'twas a miracle I survived at all, and I'll not trust my thick skull to save me a second time!
'Tis likely they've taken my cargo to Snowcloak─hardly the most hospitable of places at the best of times. No, I believe I'll cut my losses rather than risk meeting with those bloodless fiends again!
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_LANCEFER_000_050: Thank the Fury you've come! I saw them, the heretics! They were just over yonder. Please, you must help our knights in their hunt!
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_OURDILIC_000_055: Shhh! Hold your tongue! Would you bring the heretics down upon us!?
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_CAVALRYMAN01459_000: Gah! Draw your weapon, foul─ Wait, I recognize you, adventurer. You are come seeking heretics?
Then we share a common purpose. We were on patrol when we chanced across one of their raiding parties, and pursued them here.
By rights, we should have had them cornered in this ravine...and yet, they are gone. Vanished, like icy wraiths.
You glimpsed a woman atop the cliff? Could it be Iceheart herself come to sneer at our folly!?
And to where did she disappear? The heretics must have discovered a passage through the frozen wall─some hidden tunnel that escaped our notice.
We have not the men to risk further investigation. 'Twould be best were we to return to Whitebrim Front, and lay our suspicions before Lord Drillemont.
We cannot risk rushing blindly into ambush. Lord Drillemont must be informed before we proceed any further.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_090: , it appears I owe you my thanks once again. The surviving knights spared no detail in their report.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_091: The men you found out near Snowcloak were some of my finest. That they should be bested so handily... I fear I have woefully underestimated the threat these heretics pose.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_092: While I understand you might balk at the notion, I must ask that you put aside your mission and consider the stolen provisions lost to us for now. 'Twould be ill-advised to blunder unprepared into what may well be the very lair of our enemy.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_093: Pray return to Dragonhead and inform Lord Haurchefant of your discoveries. He will wish to plan contingencies of his own.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_094: As for Iceheart and her fanatics...the freezing heights of Snowcloak will not shield them from our justice for long!
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_DRILLEMONT_000_100: Return to Camp Dragonhead and report all you have learned to Lord Haurchefant. He must know of Snowcloak's secrets...
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_HAURCHEFANT_000_110: Pray tell the frontier hands to fret not over stolen supplies. 'Tis but a pittance compared to the rewards we shall reap for having a solid stronghold in Mor Dhona.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SLAFBORN_000_120: ! 'Tis good to see you return to the Toll! How fared you in the frozen wastes of Coerthas?
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SLAFBORN_000_121: ...House Fortemps is to send us a second shipment? I must send thanks to Lord Haurchefant for his continued generosity.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_SLAFBORN_000_122: Yet even as our town grows in prosperity, I fear it will attract ever greater numbers of those who would do us harm in the name of greed or power. All of us, Alphinaud's new recruits included, must remain vigilant against such threats.
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_POPMESSAGE_000_000: The snow crunches under the tread of heavy boots...
TEXT_GAIUSE318_01459_BALLOON_000_030: My life belongs to the Lady...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SEQ_00: Slafborn has news on the progress of the inaugural ceremony.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SEQ_01: Slafborn informs you that the preparations for the inaugural ceremony are almost complete. He is concerned, however, that Tataru yet seems buried under a mountain of small details. Head into the Rising Stones and offer your aid to the harried receptionist.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SEQ_02: Tataru appears overjoyed at your offer of help, and wastes no time in assigning you a task. Track down the recruits waiting around Revenant's Toll, and present them with their new uniforms.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SEQ_03: You have delivered the ultramarine uniforms to the waiting recruits, some of whom you meet for the first time. Return to the Rising Stones and report to Alphinaud.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SEQ_04: You return to Alphinaud, and the young Scion proclaims the inaugural ceremony ready to begin. After taking his place before the assembled─and newly garbed─recruits, Alphinaud launches into an impassioned speech. He reiterates their mission to protect Eorzea, and at last reveals the name he has chosen for the trial company: the Crystal Braves. As the cheers die down, Minfilia congratulates Crystal Brave Commander Leveilleur on the culmination of his hard work. Speak with the Antecedent and discuss what is to come.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SEQ_05: Though enthusiastic about the formation of the Crystal Braves, Minfilia's jubilance is muted by a grave concern─the prolonged silence of the Mothercrystal. After confirming her suspicions, the Antecedent realizes that Hydaelyn has spoken to neither of you since the final battle with the Empire. Just as it seems Eorzea will at last win free of the Calamity's stifling shadow, another darkness gathers to cast its ominous pall across the land...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TODO_00: Speak with Tataru in the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TODO_01: Present the uniforms to the recruits.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TODO_02: Speak with Alphinaud in the Rising Stones.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SLAFBORN_000_000: While you were away in Coerthas, preparations for the inaugural ceremony were all but completed. ...Although Tataru does yet seem somewhat flustered.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SLAFBORN_000_001: I've taken enough of your time. Why don't you head into the Rising Stones and see if your frantic receptionist could do with a hand?
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_SLAFBORN_000_010: Tataru yet seemed buried in details for the upcoming ceremony. I imagine she might appreciate the aid of a reliable adventurer...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TATARU_000_020: These parchments need to be sorted, and these documents...why are they even here!? Oooh! I am sorely tempted to file the lot in my wastepaper basket!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TATARU_000_021: Ah! ! You startled me! You...you wish to lend a hand? Splendid!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TATARU_000_022: Would you be a dear and hand these uniforms to the new recruits? They're scattered about Revenant's Toll and I haven't the time to track them all down!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TATARU_000_023: The recruits know to don their garb immediately and assemble here in the Rising Stones. You'll want to report directly back to Alphinaud if you don't wish to miss the ceremony!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TATARU_000_024: I wonder if the Scions will ever have matching uniforms... A well-funded organization is a well-dressed organization, I suppose!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_TATARU_000_030: Once you are done delivering the uniforms to the recruits, pray report back to Alphinaud. The ceremony is almost ready to begin!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_LAURENTIUS_000_040: I thought it best to mimic my fellows here, but I admit that I have no idea what we're supposed to be doing...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_LAURENTIUS_000_041: Ah! Our new uniforms! I am reminded of my induction into the Wood Wailers...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_LAURENTIUS_000_050: Hmmm... No, I fail to see what so engages their attention.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_YUYUHASE_000_060: Those who believe this company will see no riches are shortsighted fools. The giving of oneself 'tis an investment in the future─thus did I sign my name to the cause.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_YUYUHASE_000_061: These uniforms were a splendid idea. Once our organization has made a name for itself, there shall be wealth aplenty in selling replica costumes to the adoring masses.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_YUYUHASE_000_070: I began as a humble aetheryte guard, yet as you have witnessed, I stand poised to join the rise of a glorious new order. Where before my pockets were empty, now shall they bulge with coin!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_AERGMHUS_000_080: This scarlet garb marks me as a proud member of the Maelstrom, and a hearty defender of Limsa Lominsa! Yet in truth, I stand for the betterment of the realm, and thought this new company a fine opportunity to contribute on a grander scale.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_AERGMHUS_000_081: Oho, now that's a striking shade of blue! Put alongside my Maelstrom uniform, my wardrobe will certainly not lack for color!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_AERGMHUS_000_090: Forgive me for shedding the red, Admiral! But I must devote my efforts to the greatest good!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ILBERD_000_100: I don't believe we've met. I am Ilberd, and I will have the honor of leading my fellow recruits as captain. Much did I lose to the Calamity, and I look forward to aiding others in rebuilding their lives.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ILBERD_000_101: The uniforms are a shrewd decision. There is no easier method of creating a common bond among what is, essentially, a band of strangers.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ILBERD_000_110: I was barely more than a refugee myself for a time, and I know what it is to be without hope. I shall do my utmost to see this company succeed...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_EPHEMIE_000_120: !? Gods, I did not expect to meet you strolling about town! The tales of your primal battles were what inspired me to come to Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_EPHEMIE_000_121: 'Tis an honor to receive this uniform from your hands. I shall wear it with pride!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_EPHEMIE_000_130: I have followed the deeds of the Scions with the greatest awe and admiration. To fight at your side has long been a dream that I can scarce believe is coming true.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_WILRED_000_140: Little Ala Mhigo could learn much from Revenant's Toll. That this town can be so alive in the midst of such desolation...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_WILRED_000_141: ...I've never worn aught quite so voluminous. Well, I'm sure I'll grow accustomed to the extra cloth in time.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_WILRED_000_150: 'Tis not that I enjoy baring my skin, you understand. Thanalan was simply very hot. <sigh> Never mind...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_RIOL_000_160: Hello there, . Lookin' for me, was ye? I'd suggest givin' a whistle, but I'm not sure as I'd hear it amongst all the bustle.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_RIOL_000_161: Oho! Proper uniforms an' all! This thing'll cut off the blood to me head... Not to worry, though! I'm sure she'll be fine after makin' a few adjustments!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_RIOL_000_170: Here's hopin' I don't run across any o' me old mates wearin' this outfit. I'll have their laughter ringin' in me ears for days!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ALIANNE_000_180: Isildaure has at last retired from the adventurer's life. Though I shall miss his wisdom and irrepressible spirit, I am excited to forge my own path forwards.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ALIANNE_000_181: Ah, yes, the uniform! Thank you! Truth be told, the thought of pledging myself to such a lofty organization is somewhat intimidating...
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ALIANNE_000_190: Do the others have their uniforms already? I should really be on my way before the ceremony begins. I will make you proud, Isildaure!
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ALPHINAUD_000_200: Yes, ? Ah, Tataru mentioned you were handing out the new uniforms. I assume you've now met the rest of the recruits?
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ALPHINAUD_000_201: Some few answered the call to arms I put forth through the established Grand Companies and such. We are not yet an army, but there is much a small corps of elite warriors can achieve.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ALPHINAUD_000_202: ...Did I mention I'd thought of a name for the company? 'Tis my hope that it shall soon be known across the breadth of Eorzea.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_ALPHINAUD_000_203: The moment of truth draws near, . Once the last of the recruits have gathered, I shall make the official announcement.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_HAURCHEFANT_000_300: Very good. See that the provisions are prepared for transport. Let us hope that this shipment is spared the fate of the last.
TEXT_GAIUSE319_01460_HAURCHEFANT_000_301: The winds are uncommon fierce this day...
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_00: Once again, Minfilia appears to be lost in thought.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_01: Desiring to be left alone with her thoughts, Minfilia bids you assist Alphinaud with an unspecified task. Respect the Antecedent's wishes and join Alphinaud outside the solar.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_02: According to Alphinaud, the Antecedent's blind refusal to contemplate leaving Ul'dah stems from the empty hope that her late mother F'lhaminn still lives. For whatever reason, rumors have recently begun to circulate that the famed songstress did not perish in the fires of the Calamity. Convinced that Minfilia will not see sense until these rumors have been proven false, Alphinaud has resolved to determine their origin, and asks that you assist him. Speak with Gegeruju in Costa del Sol to inquire about one such rumor.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_03: A heartbroken Gegeruju is further dismayed to learn that the object of his affections, who only recently left, was none other than the famed Songstress of Ul'dah. Though he recalls her expressing a desire to go west, he assures you that F'lhaminn will soon tire of her rough style of living and return to his waiting arms. Providing you do not share his optimism, journey to Wineport and question the local residents.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_04: Your cursory investigation yields a promising lead, provided by the incorrigible Wine Baron of Limsa Lominsa. Apparently, a woman matching F'lhaminn's description visited Byrglaent's winery very recently, but, finding her perfume to be intolerable, he expelled her from the premises. Though he has no inkling as to where she went next, the Wine Baron suggests that you solicit the aid of Shamani Lohmani, reasoning that his unique talents may enable him to track the perfumed lady.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_05: Shamani Lohmani vividly recalls the woman's scent, as well as the conversation he had with her. After observing that her perfume was reminiscent of a local species of flower, she asked him where she might find the most pristine specimens, and he duly told her. Assuming she followed his directions, she would then have proceeded south into Raincatcher Gully. With luck, she may still be there.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_06: You succeed in locating your quarry mere moments before a ravenous goobbue emerges from the forest, seemingly intent on devouring you both. Undeterred, you set about the beast, and it soon succumbs to your onslaught. All that remains is to verify the identity of the perfumed lady.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_07: Your attempts to ascertain the perfumed lady's identity succeed only in arousing her suspicion, but when Alphinaud subsequently enters the scene, she has no choice but to admit that she is indeed F'lhaminn. With much to discuss, the three of you agree to adjourn to Wineport, where you may continue your conversation in safety.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SEQ_08: Thanks to your efforts, the stage is now set for a long-overdue reunion between Minfilia and F'lhaminn. Proud to do your part, you look forward to what is sure to be an emotional meeting between the two.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_TODO_01: Speak with Gegeruju in Costa del Sol.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_MINFILIA_000_000: Leave Ul'dah... Has it truly come to this?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_MINFILIA_000_002: He is engaged in some business or other and requires your assistance.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_MINFILIA_000_003: Pray be on your way. Alphinaud waits upon you, and I have much to think about.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_MINFILIA_000_004: Oh, and...tell him he shall have my answer in due time.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Confound it. She knows what must be done, and still she hesitates.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_011: All because of these fanciful rumors.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Hm. I should explain. Minfilia's mother─well, adoptive mother─was among the great many who perished during the Calamity.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_013: F'lhaminn was her name, though you may know her better as the “Songstress of Ul'dah.” She was a performer of singular talent, and much beloved by the people of Eorzea─not to mention a certain Sharlayan minstrel.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_014: As you may imagine, the news of her passing was greeted with shock and disbelief by her adoring followers, many of whom refused to acknowledge what had happened. That her body was never found only served to encourage speculation.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Minfilia, too, struggled at first to accept the truth, but as F'lhaminn's absence stretched from months into years, she saw that there could be no other explanation.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_016: Until recently, at any rate. For whatever reason, rumors have once again begun to circulate that F'lhaminn is alive and well.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_017: One of our informants, Father Iliud, has sent word that a woman matching the songstress's description has been seen of late at the seaside resort of Costa del Sol.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_018: If we could succeed in tracking her down, I have no doubt that any worries that now plague Minfilia's heart might be assuaged.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_019: I mean to set forth for La Noscea at once. Let us reconvene there and inquire with Master Gegeruju as to the veracity of these rumors.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Ah, you've arrived. Let us see if Master Gegeruju can shine any light onto the rumors regarding F'lhaminn.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_GEGERUJU_000_030: <sigh> O sweet siren of the sands, my Miqo'te muse! Why have you forsaken me...?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_GEGERUJU_000_031: T-Titan's Bane! I mean, ! What brings you to my humble resort?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_GEGERUJU_000_032: F'lhaminn!? You mean to tell me the goddess made flesh who dwelt among us until so very recently was the Songstress of Ul'dah!? Egads, ─if I had known that, I would've chained her to my bedpost and never let her leave!
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_GEGERUJU_000_033: Oh, for shame! To think that she now plies her trade for the riffraff off to the west or wherever she said she was going! It's a tragedy, I say! A tragedy!
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_034: West, is it? Thank you, Master Gegeruju. Your information will serve us well.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_035: That said, there are any number of places she could be. I shall begin my search by the docks and see if any witnesses might have some knowledge to spare. I would be most appreciative if you could travel on to Wineport and do the same.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_JUNGHBHAR_000_040: ...Eh? You want to know if I've seen a Miqo'te lass by the name of F'lhaminn? I wish! I haven't seen a lass of any description for far too bloody long...
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_BYRGLAENT_000_050: Well, if it isn't , the savior of Wineport! To what do we owe the pleasure?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_BYRGLAENT_000_051: Ah, yes, we did receive a customer matching that description. She was a delight to behold, to give the woman her due, but her perfume was so ghastly, I had no choice but to eject her from the premises. Interfering with tastings, you understand.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_BYRGLAENT_000_052: If she is your quarry, why not consult your blind associate? His olfactory perception is without peer. Given that I could smell the woman from a malm away, I daresay he could smell her from ten.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_SHAMANILOHMANI_000_: <sniff> <sniff> I see you have had many grand adventures since last we spoke, . You must share them with me sometime.
The girl from a little while ago? One does not forget a perfume like that. So robust and intoxicating...yet simultaneously familiar. Reminiscent of a bloom native to these parts, in fact.
I said as much when we spoke. She complimented my powers of observation and asked me where she might find some of the flowers.

So I told her to follow the road south into Raincatcher Gully and then head east after crossing the second bridge. The flowers which grow in the shade of the cliff have the strongest scent, you see. If you make haste, you may yet find her there.

So I told her to follow the road south into Raincatcher Gully and then head east after crossing the second bridge. The flowers which grow in the shade of the cliff have the strongest scent, you see. If you make haste, you may yet find her there.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_080: I am in your debt, stranger. I did not realize my activities had aroused the goobbue's ire until it was too late.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_081: Their oils can be used to make a perfume, you see, and I─
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_083: Who are you? Whom do you serve?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_084: It appears you've already found our woman. Consider me impressed, my friend.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_085: The Songstress of Ul'dah, I presume? Minfilia─or should I say, Ascilia─is looking for you.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_087: You are the very picture of health, milady─yet the world thinks you dead.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_088: I can only conclude that this was by design. The question is: why?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_089: Not everyone who endeavors to find me does so with the best intentions, child.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_090: You will be pleased to know that I fully intend to reveal myself to Minfilia─when the time is right.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Oh! Well...that does please me. More than you know. But tell me: sojourns in the forests of La Noscea aside, when exactly will the time be right?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_092: When I deem it so. Do you imagine I traveled all this way on a whim? As I was telling your associate prior to your intrusion, I came here to harvest these flowers for use in a perfume. Does that satisfy your curiosity, or would you interrogate me further?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_093: M-My apologies for the interruption. Anyway─now that we all have that which we came for, might we continue this conversation in a safer locale? Wineport, say?
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_100: Rescued yet again from the jaws of a ravenous goobbue. How quickly we forget the lessons of the past.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_FLHAMINN_000_101: <sigh> Though I was not solely to blame for that foolishness...
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_110: This...this is not at all how I had envisioned it.
TEXT_XXAUSE103_03874_ALPHINAUD_000_111: I can scarce begin to imagine what emotions will go through Minfilia's heart when she reunites with her mother after all these years.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_SEQ_00: F'lhaminn has made her peace and is ready to reunite with her adopted daughter.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_SEQ_01: After five long years, the time has come for F'lhaminn to reunite with her daughter Minfilia. You resolve to accompany the songstress to Vesper Bay and watch over what should prove to be an emotional reunion.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_SEQ_02: Upon seeing Alphinaud escort F'lhaminn into the solar, Minfilia rushes forward to embrace her long-lost mother, overjoyed to learn that reports of her death were indeed exaggerated. During their tearful reunion, Minfilia explains that her father was once a member of the Ala Mhigan Resistance, and that following his death in a tragic accident, F'lhaminn raised her as her own. After praising Minfilia for her victories over the Empire, F'lhaminn states that the Scions must leave Ul'dah behind if they are to continue their work. Agreeing at last to Alphinaud's proposal, a reinvigorated Minfilia declares that the order will quit Vesper Bay and establish a new headquarters in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_TODO_00: Report to Minfilia at the Waking Sands.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_ALPHINAUD_100_001: Despite her years of nomadism, it would seem Lady F'lhaminn has kept a close eye on the affairs of our order. Surprisingly close, in fact. Suffice to say, she is nothing if not resourceful.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_ALPHINAUD_100_002: One does not develop such skills without effort─or without reason.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_FLHAMINN_000_000: You say my daughter awaits us in Vesper Bay, yes?
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_FLHAMINN_000_001: I have kept her waiting long enough. Let us be off on the next ferry. I can finish fashioning the perfume along the way.
TEXT_XXAUSE104_03875_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Understood. Come with me─it would be my pleasure to escort you to the Waking Sands.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SEQ_00: Minfilia would share with you the latest news on the Scions' imminent relocation.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SEQ_01: Alphinaud's efforts having proved successful, the Scions have secured a new location for their headquarters: Revenant's Toll in Mor Dhona. Minfilia would begin preparations for the move immediately, as there is much that still must be done. Pay visit to her and see if there is aught you might do to be of service.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SEQ_02: Minfilia has entrusted you with a number of documents pertaining to the forthcoming move to Mor Dhona. You are to deliver them to Slafborn at Revenant's Toll, in accordance with the agreement between the Scions and the Adventurers' Guild.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SEQ_03: Slafborn is pleased that you were the Scion chosen to represent the order in Revenant's Toll, and waggishly declares that he intends to impose the work of a dozen men upon you, though he subsequently claims to be jesting. At any rate, it would appear the Scions' long-awaited relocation effort can finally begin in earnest.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_TODO_01: Deliver the documents to Slafborn in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_000: It is all well and good that we have found ourselves a new home in Revenant's Toll. But there is so much to be done─and in so little time.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_001: Our first step will be to secure the cooperation of the Adventurers' Guild representatives there.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_002: Were it not for the guild's considerable efforts, the original Camp Revenant's Toll would have never been established, much less its more heavily fortified successor.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_003: However, with construction still ongoing, and resources in short supply, it seems certain that the guild will require something in return for their support, sympathetic to our cause though they may be.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_004: Whatever they ask, I shall not begrudge it. To be plain, we need them more than they need us. Without their assistance, such essential tasks as securing new facilities, cultivating relationships with local merchants, and recruiting adventurers would prove difficult, if not impossible.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ALPHINAUD_000_005: You need not concern yourself with such matters, Antecedent.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_006: Really, Alphinaud─if I need concern myself with anything, it is surely matters such as these.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ALPHINAUD_000_007: Indirectly, perhaps. I submit that you might instead concern yourself with a different matter: namely, to whom the resolution of such matters might best be entrusted. And here I am! Nor do I come alone. May I present the esteemed emissary of the Adventurers' Guild at Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ADVEMISSARY_000_008: It is an honor, Antecedent. Upon receiving word of your intentions from Master Alphinaud, we thought it best to begin talks at the earliest available opportunity.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ADVEMISSARY_000_009: Know that my associates at Revenant's Toll hold the Scions of the Seventh Dawn in the highest regard. We should be honored to welcome your organization.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ALPHINAUD_000_010: There are, of course, certain provisions which must needs be negotiated. If it please you, I would do so.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ADVEMISSARY_000_012: , unless I am much mistaken, you are the one known as , are you not? May I say what a pleasure it is to make your acquaintance.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ADVEMISSARY_000_013: Slafborn spoke of you in the most glowing terms. To steal an imperial reaper and then use it to infiltrate a Garlean castrum is an undertaking few would contemplate─and fewer still survive.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_ADVEMISSARY_000_014: You shall always be welcome at Revenant's Toll. We hope you will favor us with your presence again ere long.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_015: Well, well! It would seem your reputation precedes you, ! Mayhap I should dispatch you to Revenant's Toll with all haste, as first intended...
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_016: But before that, I daresay you have earned yourself a rest. After all, you have traveled so far, and there is already so much you have done for us...and for me.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_017: We will speak again anon. Till then, take care.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_110: Do you ever wonder how he does it? Alphinaud, I mean. It was almost predictable that he should appear with an emissary of the Adventurers' Guild mere moments after I had expressed the need to forge ties between our organizations. Truly, his sense of timing rivals even your own...
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_111: Setting such mysteries aside for the present─I have a task for you.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_MINFILIA_000_112: I would like you to deliver these documents to Slafborn. They concern our forthcoming move. Do take care on the road, and represent us well, .
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SLAFBORN_000_120: I was told to expect a Scion, but I didn't expect it to be you. It has been far too long, . You have something for me, yes?
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SLAFBORN_000_121: Let's see, now... Yes, everything appears to be in order.
TEXT_XXAUSE106_03876_SLAFBORN_000_122: You'll be staying with us for a while, yes? Would that we had a dozen more like you. Since we don't, though, we'll just give you the work of a dozen men. Heh! I jest, I jest...
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SEQ_00: Slafborn would show you around the Scions' soon-to-be home in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SEQ_01: Your conversation with Slafborn is interrupted by the panicked voice of Tataru over linkpearl. It would appear that a situation most dire has struck, and your presence is required back in Vesper Bay at once. Return to the Waking Sands and inquire with the ever-wary administrator how you might be of aid.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SEQ_02: According to Tataru, a messenger from the Adders' Nest visited the Waking Sands a short while ago, and whatever news he bore appears to have greatly unsettled Minfilia. Perhaps you should ask her what is amiss.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SEQ_03: Evidence suggests that a primal─or an entity resembling one─has been summoned in Gridania, and the Scions are duty-bound to investigate. High Serpent Commander Heuloix of the Order of the Twin Adder has requested you by name, and Minfilia bids you answer his summons. Make for the Adders' Nest with all haste.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SEQ_04: Your arrival the Adders' Nest is welcomed by High Serpent Commander Heuloix. With time of the essence, he dispenses with pleasantries and immediately proceeds to explain the extenuating circumstances which compelled him to summon you. And so you steel yourself for grim news of what may lie ahead...
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_TODO_02: Speak with Vorsaile Heuloix at the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_000: Back to do the work of a dozen men, I see? Hah! But I jest...
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_001: Even I can appreciate that an important  such as yourself has little time for menial tasks.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_002: But since you're here, mayhap you'd be keen on having a look around the Scions' new home. See that impressive structure over there? That's the place.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_003: It was originally built to house a branch of the guild, you see. As such, it comes complete with a tavern where adventurers can rest from the road, fill their bellies with good food and drink, and their ears with tales of fortunes to be had about the realm.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_004: It may get a bit raucous at times, but I imagine it'll be as good a place as any to recruit capable men and women to your cause. Come with me, I'll show you around─
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_TATARU_000_005: Is that you, !? I'm quite sorry to interrupt, but I have most urgent news!
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_TATARU_000_006: We received grim tidings from Gridania, and it would appear our aid is required at once. I must ask you to report back to the Waking Sands with all due haste!
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_007: Is everything quite all right, friend?
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_008: I can't say I'm privy to the details, but it would appear this is no time for a leisurely tour. But no worries─you can rest assured that I'll see to all necessary arrangements. Pray return any time after you've seen to your more pressing matters.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_SLAFBORN_000_010: Are you sure that you should be dawdling about here? That linkpearl call you received seemed terribly urgent...
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_TATARU_000_020: A messenger from the Twin Adder came to the Waking Sands while you were in Mor Dhona. I wasn't privy to his conversation with the Antecedent, but I did see the look on her face after he took his leave. Something is definitely amiss.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_TATARU_000_021: Could it be that the Ixal have summoned Garuda again!? Or mayhap imperial forces have been sighted within the Shroud!
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_TATARU_000_022: Well, whatever it may be, I'm absolutely certain it's nothing you can't handle. Now go and ask the Antecedent if there's anything you can do!
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_TATARU_000_030: Pray do not tarry, ! The Antecedent needs you!
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_MINFILIA_000_040: I knew this day would come, yet I prayed it would not come so soon.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_MINFILIA_000_041: We have reason to believe that another primal─or an entity resembling one─has been summoned in Gridania.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_URIANGER_000_042: Thine arrival is customarily timely, . The aetheric waves leave little room for doubt; thy talents will be needed ere long.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_URIANGER_000_043: If there be truth in my suspicions, 'tis a familiar foe we face, though one quite unlike the Lady of the Vortex...
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_MINFILIA_000_044: We dare not draw conclusions without evidence, but as Urianger says, the readings bear a strong resemblance to ones observed more than five years ago.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_MINFILIA_000_045: <sigh> Though I had hoped the Mogglesguard beyond such follies...
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_MINFILIA_000_046: Suffice it to say, this disturbance warrants a full investigation.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_URIANGER_000_047: Thy presence hath been requested by Commander Heuloix. He awaiteth thee at the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_MINFILIA_000_048: Pray hasten to Gridania, . Yda and Papalymo will rendezvous with you there. May you walk in the light of the Crystal.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_MINFILIA_000_050: We cannot ignore this aetheric disturbance, . Journey to Gridania and speak with Commander Heuloix of the Twin Adder. Yda and Papalymo will rendezvous with you anon.
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_VORSAILE_000_060: A pleasure to see you as always, .
TEXT_XXAUSE114_03877_VORSAILE_000_061: I could think of no one more qualified to─ Ah, but we're getting ahead of ourselves. Allow me to explain...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SEQ_00: Minfilia has a final favor to ask of you.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SEQ_01: Minfilia's father, Warburton, was a Garlean spy whose true loyalties lay with the Ala Mhigan Resistance. Before his untimely death some fifteen years ago, he stole a wealth of imperial research on the primals, and compiled the findings in his private journal. Though this journal has served to guide Minfilia ever since, she has resolved─after no small amount of soul-searching─to entrust it to Urianger, in the hope that he may succeed in unraveling its remaining mysteries. Present Warburton's journal to Urianger on Minfilia's behalf.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SEQ_02: By curious coincidence, Minfilia contacts you via linkpearl immediately after you deliver the journal to Urianger. She has departed for Revenant's Toll, and bids you follow as soon as you are able. Travel to Mor Dhona and speak with Tataru to gain entrance to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SEQ_03: Tataru welcomes you to Revenant's Toll and the Scions' new headquarters, and explains that Minfilia awaits you inside. Join her and see how you might be of aid to your companions as they settle into their new home.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SEQ_04: Even as the Scions of the Seventh Dawn celebrate the inauguration of their new headquarters, Urianger arrives unannounced, bearing troubling news. The distant yet dependable Students of Baldesion are no longer responding to his messages. Fearing the worst, Minfilia bids Urianger do everything he can to determine the cause of their uncharacteristic silence. For the time being, however, the Scions have no choice but to continue their work without the aid of one of their closest allies.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TODO_01: Speak with Tataru in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TODO_02: Speak with Minfilia in the Rising Stones.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_000: Let us set aside the matter of this Ascian until after we have completed our move to the Rising Stones. There is but one final favor I would ask of you before I depart.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_001: I believe I mentioned before that my father was a member of the Ala Mhigan Resistance. The truth, however, is more complicated than that.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_002: As far as the Empire knew, he was their spy. He maintained the deception for nigh on half a decade, furnishing the Resistance with vital imperial secrets while feeding his paymasters subtly conceived misinformation.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_003: When he died some fifteen years ago, my father left behind his journal, which I have closely guarded ever since. It contains every shred of information he and his agents could steal on what they believed to be the single greatest threat to Eorzea: the primals.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_004: Its wisdom has guided me through the years, though there is much within I still do not understand...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_005: It is my hope that Urianger will fare better.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_006: Tell him to treat it with care. It is all I have left of my father.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_007: Please, before I reconsider, give my father's journal to Urianger.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_URIANGER_000_010: I thought thee departed. To what end dost thou linger?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_URIANGER_000_011: The father's final bequest...the daughter's lifelong labor.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_URIANGER_000_012: It is no small thing to surrender such a cherished memento. Well can I imagine the Antecedent's pain. Upon mine honor, I swear to spare no effort in the study of these materials, lest my lady's sacrifice be in vain.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_021: Forgive me, but I could wait no longer─I have departed for the Rising Stones.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_023: ...Once you have given the journal to Urianger, I bid you come to the Seventh Heaven in Revenant's Toll. Tataru will be there to show you inside our new headquarters.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_MINFILIA_000_024: Assuming you have already attuned to it, you may wish to make use of our new aetheryte in Revenant's Toll. After all, it is right on our doorstep!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_URIANGER_000_025: Thou hast been summoned to the Rising Stones, yes? Then keep not thy fellows waiting.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_026: Ah, there you are. Your friends are waiting for you inside.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_100: Oh, ! You're here! Good, good. We were all wondering when you'd show up!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_101: As I was just telling your restive receptionist here, I'm pleased to inform you that all the documents have been prepared and all signatures signed. The Rising Stones is officially yours!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_102: Splendid! From this day forward, I will spare no effort in seeing that it is as welcoming and comfortable a home for us as the Waking Sands ever was!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_103: That said, this is all somewhat intimidating, is it not? So many unfamiliar places, and unfamiliar faces...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_110: Take that odd-looking fellow over there, for example. He's been eyeing us most suspiciously ever since we arrived. I cannot help but wonder if we are truly safe here...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_111: Ah, that man. I can't say I've spoken to him myself, but rumor has it he's come to hunt for ancient treasures in the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_112: You've seen the structure I speak of, no? It'd be hard to miss it. That massive pillar of shining crystal that looms high over the land just to the southeast of here.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_113: If the tales are to be believed, it's a remnant of some ancient civilization. The details remain a mystery, and that's no doubt why it's drawn adventurers and scholars from all over looking to unearth its secrets.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_114: The man over there is no exception─and if my instincts are true, he knows more than most. If you're curious about the tower yourself, you could do worse than to talk to him and see what he knows.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_115: Why, if I weren't otherwise occupied with my duties here, I'd have half a mind to join you. I mean, just look at it! I can scarce begin to imagine what wonders lie inside...
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_120: Revenant's Toll is populated mostly by adventurers, which means─as you might expect─that there's quite a bit of coming and going.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_121: Emphasis on the coming─at least of late, what with the investigation of the Crystal Tower hitting full stride. I've lost track of how many fortune-seekers and scholars have shown up in the past few days alone, hoping to unearth ancient secrets.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_122: I don't suppose the tower's piqued your interest as well?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_123: You've already offered your aid to the effort, you say? You certainly move quickly, my friend.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_124: If I weren't otherwise occupied with my duties here, I'd have half a mind to join you. Alas, I'll have to settle for hearing the tales of all you've seen upon your return. Be safe in there, yes?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_130: Most of the men and women you see around you here in Revenant's Toll are adventurers who come and go as they wish. I daresay that should make it easier for you to go about your business here.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SLAFBORN_000_131: And it shouldn't hurt that  here has already made something of a name for  here. Isn't that so, ?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_140: Why, that's wonderful to hear! Rest assured that this receptionist will work just as hard to see that our efforts do not skip a beat despite the relocation.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_141: And with that, , I do believe it's time you officially announced your presence to everyone inside.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_142: The Antecedent and the others will surely be overjoyed to see you.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_116: The Crystal Tower quest series is now available from the outlandish man.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_117: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_118: While you are granted a respite from your duties as a Scion, use your time to probe the depths of the Crystal Tower and see what ancient secrets may be gleaned!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_125: In order to progress in the main scenario, you must first complete certain quests in the Crystal Tower series.
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_SYSTEM_000_126: While you are granted a respite from your duties as a Scion, use your time to probe the depths of the Crystal Tower and see what ancient secrets may be gleaned!
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_150: Welcome to our new home─the Rising Stones! Isn't it lovely?
TEXT_XXAUSE119_03878_TATARU_000_151: But why are you standing around here talking to me? Everyone's waiting for you inside!
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_SEQ_00: Minfilia has a new assignment for you.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_SEQ_01: During a recent audit, it was discovered that the crystal stores of Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern have been covertly pillaged. Fearing that the culprits may have ties to the Amalj'aa, the Scions have agreed to assist in the investigation. Proceed to Horizon in western Thanalan and report to Y'shtola.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_SEQ_02: You find Y'shtola preoccupied and unwilling to converse at length. Speak to Fufulupa, the Brass Blade leading the investigation, to learn more about the thefts.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_SEQ_03: Fufulupa relays to you news about a carriage that broke through one of their checkpoints and bolted off down to eastern Thanalan, where they were taken into custody by the Brass Blades. He is all but convinced that the thieves have been apprehended and the crystals recovered, until your conversation is interrupted by Thancred, who reveals that the fugitives were no more than common somnus smugglers. Regroup with your friends at Horizon to review the current state of affairs and assess your options.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_SEQ_04: According to Thancred, there is nothing to suggest that the Amalj'aa have come into possession of significant quantities of crystals. As he communicates his findings to Urianger via linkpearl, you cannot help but wonder who is behind the crystal thefts, and what their designs might be.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_000: Truly, there is no rest for the weary. Scarce had I begun to make myself at home when I received a request for assistance from Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_001: It would appear their storehouse in Horizon has been the target of a series of covert robberies.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_002: Minor as they seemed in isolation, occasional discrepancies in the manifests were long dismissed as clerical errors. It was only during the Concern's annual audit that a pattern became apparent...
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_003: Significant quantities of crystals─and only crystals─were missing.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_004: I need hardly tell you what that may imply.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_005: The Brass Blades charged with investigating the thefts believe that someone within the Concern is selling the crystals for profit. Alas, they have as yet been unable to identify a likely suspect, and the Concern's proprietors have grown frustrated by their lack of progress.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_006: Needless to say, I would not have agreed to intervene had the stolen goods been of merely monetary value. If there is even a possibility that the thief acts not out of self-interest but in service to a primal, we can ill afford to wait for the Blades to realize their mistake.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_007: Pray depart for Horizon at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_008: Rendezvous with Y'shtola when you arrive. She and Thancred have already begun a preliminary investigation.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_009: I have every confidence that the three of you will get to the bottom of these thefts. I only hope our fears prove unfounded when you do.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_MINFILIA_000_010: When you arrive in Horizon, be sure to speak with Y'shtola. She will inform you as to the latest developments. For my part, I shall continue to speak with the Concern's representatives. They may have additional information which could be of use.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_010: Ah, . Your assistance is most welcome.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_011: I have already spoken at length with the Brass Blades of the Rose─albeit to little avail. It would seem that the thieves took great pains to conceal their activities.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_012: I could go into further detail, but your time might better be spent in conversation with Fufulupa. He is the officer charged with leading the investigation, and I would only be repeating that which he related to me. If aught eluded my attention, mayhap it will not elude yours.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_021: Terrible business, these thefts. We have yet to confirm the quantity of crystals stolen, but I daresay it may be greater than─
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_022: Ah, but never mind that! I have news to share! A short while ago, the driver of a heavily laden carriage refused to halt for inspection and broke through one of our checkpoints on the Royal Allagan Sunway.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_023: The cart bolted off toward eastern Thanalan, where─thank the gods─I hear that our colleagues were able to apprehend them without further incident.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_024: ...A speeding carriage? That would seem a curious choice for thieves of such proven cunning. Yet the Amalj'aa do have a foothold in eastern Thanalan. Hmmm.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_025: And what of their cargo? Did they carry the crystals we seek?
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_026: We should be receiving a report any moment now, but I fail to see what else it could─
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_027: Did you miss me, friends? I'm back, but I fear I come bearing disappointing news. Or, on second thought, perhaps it's good news, after all...
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_028: ...Thancred. Wherever have you been off to?
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_029: I figured you had everything under control here, so I just took a brief excursion to the east to check up on our Amalj'aa friends.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_030: And wouldn't you believe it? I happened upon a runaway carriage on the way, and even was able to do my small part to help my friends in the Brass Blades intercept it.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_031: In all my years, I have never seen such a prodigious quantity of somnus. The Blades were calling it one of the greatest hauls they've ever seen. The stolen crystals, on the other hand, were nowhere to be found.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_FUFULUPA_000_032: Is that so? Alas...I suppose we have no choice but to resume our search elsewhere.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_033: We should reassess our options as well. Come with us, .
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_YSHTOLA_000_040: ...And so we find ourselves back where we began. <sigh> What have I overlooked...?
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_050: Against all expectation, it would seem the Amalj'aa are innocent of this particular spate of crimes. By all indications, they have yet to replenish the stores of crystals exhausted during their last attempt to summon Ifrit.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_051: What I can't fathom is why anyone else would go to such lengths to obtain crystals─and in such quantities.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_052: It cannot be that we are dealing with simple thieves. If their motive were profit, why would they limit their trade to crystals alone...? Plainly, we are missing something.
TEXT_XXAUSE201_03879_THANCRED_000_053: While you think about what it might be, I shall inform Urianger of our progress─or lack thereof.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_SEQ_00: Raubahn would like to discuss how to handle the Doman refugees.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_SEQ_01: Regardless of the Syndicate's decision, Raubahn is not content to ignore the Domans' plight. He bids you and the others accompany him to the Hall of Flames to discuss what options remain available.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_SEQ_02: Concluding that the other city-states are unlike to accept the refugees, Alphinaud proffers an alternative solution. Rather than petitioning another nation for aid, the Domans might instead travel to the outpost of Revenant's Toll, where they could work as frontier hands in exchange for food and shelter. Though Yugiri is amenable to the idea, the matter of how the refugees would make a journey of so great a distance remains. Believing that the Ul'dahn Adventurers' Guild may be of assistance, Alphinaud departs for the Quicksand and invites you to follow.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_SEQ_03: Momodi has agreed to provide temporary accommodations for the Domans, so that they might regain their strength before embarking on their journey. Alphinaud bids you rest your own legs for a moment, then return to Vesper Bay to meet your guests and escort them to the place they will sojourn.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TODO_00: Speak with Raubahn at the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_SYSTEM_100_000: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_000: As Lord Lolorito goes, so goes the Syndicate...
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_000: My people could not endure another long sea voyage. But if Ul'dah will not accept us, what choice have we?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KASASAGI_000_000: “Prone to violence and criminal activity”!? Who is he to speak of us thus? Are we to be punished for sins we may never commit?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KIKYOU_000_000: Did they not hear Lady Yugiri's pleas? How can they turn us away, knowing what we have endured?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: It bears repeating that Lord Lolorito does not speak for the Syndicate.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_100: The others harbor doubts, I will allow, but in time they shall see the error of their ways.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_000: As you observed, Lolorito is not afraid to speak his mind─nor is he like to change it.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_001: Oft have I wondered how a man so skilled at weighing the worth of things should be so incapable of seeing the value in people...
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_002: Bah. I will waste no more words on him─not when the Domans are yet in need of aid. Everyone, follow me to the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Hmm... Mayhap I should have considered the likelihood of failure more deeply beforehand.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_YUGIRI_000_010: A galleon is no place for my people─for any people─to call home. This cannot continue.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KASASAGI_000_010: Is there naught we can do to earn the approval of these Ul'dahns?
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_KIKYOU_000_010: We do not wish to live by the grace of others. We want to work; we want to contribute!
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_TELEDJIADELEDJI_000: I will not deny that certain portions of the refugee population have been a burden on the sultanate─but I take issue with my counterparts' contention that they account for the majority. In this they are plainly mistaken. Even so, we must not think ill of them for wishing to protect our great nation.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_RAUBAHN_000_011: The Syndicate has spoken, and I see no point in moving that the matter be reconsidered. The Monetarists have made their position clear.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_012: Agreed. Ul'dah is not an option.
TEXT_XXAUSE204_03880_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Nor are Limsa Lominsa or Gridania, I judge, given the state of their internal affairs.
